descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Possess 4-8 years of Salesforce development experience to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Implement process automations, build scalable custom solutions, and collaborate with team members to interpret and translate business requirements into technical capabilities.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Salesforce security and object model setup.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 4-8+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with a Clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $135,000-$165,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Salesforce Developer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position will be in Herndon, VA. The qualified applicant will become part of Peraton's Department of State (DOS) Consular Systems Modernization (CSM) Program, for the Bureau of Diplomatic Technology (DT). This initiative will modernize and consolidate the operational environment under a common technology framework in order to better support the services provided to CA's customers.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Perform app development, prototyping, testing and demonstrating capabilities to users.
  • Perform code merges, resolve conflicts, deploy repositories to sandboxes and test environments, as well as assist deployments to higher environments and production.
  • Build custom applications using declarative customization capabilities, e.g. flows and using App Builder.
  • Design and provide solution recommendations and roadmaps for service modernizations using Salesforce Platform, both out-of-box capabilities and customized solutions.
  • Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with customers to architect Salesforce solutions to meet business requirements.
  • Use your technical proficiency with the Salesforce platform to design and develop business functionalities using inbuilt CRM/CX technologies and functionalities.
  • Map Salesforce capabilities, features and best practices against business and technical requirements by performing fit-gap analysis against Salesforce cloud, service, community, available tools available within AppExchange and Salesforce Platform.
  • Document, maintain, and govern Salesforce solutions, both out-of-box capabilities and customized, to meet business requirements for service modernizations across their respective lifecycles. Work with systems architects and support team members to address security and compliance (e.g. section 508, FISMA) requirements related to the setup of Salesforce platform sandbox and development environments.
  • Work on design and development of interfaces APIs and integrations from Salesforce to external systems.
  • Ensure that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance and security requirements are closely monitored by working with development teams.

Work Location: Herndon, VA

#DOSCSM

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 2 years' of experience.
  • At least 1 years' direct experience in Agile software development lifecycle.
  • At least 1 years of experience in development of enterprise-level Salesforce projects throughout implementation of lifecycles with demonstrable success.
  • Fluent in performing code merges of Salesforce git repositories, including conflict resolution.
  • Experienced in deploying repositories to sandboxes and test environments.
  • Experience in writing Visualforce, Apex classes/controllers, triggers, SOQL and SOSL.
  • Proficiency in related tools (Data Loader, Workbench, Salesforce Platform IDE, and integrations of third-party tools with Salesforce).
  • Experience designing, building, and implementing custom applications using the declarative customization capabilities of the Salesforce Platform
  • Must be able to obtain or have an Active Secret (or higher) clearance. Interim clearance acceptable.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Force.com/Salesforce Platform Advanced Developer (DEV 501).
  • Certified Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent experience.
  • Experience developing/deploying applications written in open languages on Heroku and integration with Salesforce platform.

Details

Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

Position Overview

The Salesforce Developer will design, build, and implement Salesforce solutions that support business processes and digital transformation initiatives. The role includes customizing Salesforce applications, developing integrations, and collaborating with business and technology teams. Experience in the Banking & Financial Services (BFSI) domain is a strong added advantage, enabling deeper understanding of customer journeys, compliance workflows, and financial products.

Salesforce Core Skills

  • Apex (Classes, Triggers, Batch/Scheduled Apex)
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components
  • Visualforce page development
  • Salesforce Flows, Process Builder, Workflow Rules
  • SOQL & SOSL queries, Salesforce data modeling
  • Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP) and integration frameworks
  • Understanding of Salesforce Security Model
  • CI/CD tools (Gearset, Copado, Git, Azure DevOps)

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud
  • Familiarity with Mulesoft, Boomi, or other integration middleware
  • Agile/Scrum delivery exposure
  • Knowledge of SQL, relational databases

Must-Have Functional Skills

  • Ability to understand and convert business requirements into technical designs
  • Strong understanding of CRM processes and customer lifecycle
  • Troubleshooting and issue-resolution capabilities
  • Working with business partners for requirement clarification

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce customizations and integrations
  • Build scalable apps using Apex, LWC, and declarative tools
  • Collaborate with product owners, analysts, and QA to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Maintain data integrity, security rules, and access models
  • Optimize performance and troubleshoot platform issues
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to technical planning
  • Ensure adherence to Salesforce and industry best practices
  • Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to work in cross-functional teams
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Time management and multi-tasking abilities
  • Leadership skills for senior or lead roles
  • Strong documentation skills

Experience Or Understanding Of BFSI Domain Concepts, Such As

Banking Processes

  • Retail/Commercial banking workflows
  • Customer onboarding & KYC processes
  • Loan origination, mortgage lifecycle, and underwriting
  • Case management for disputes, service requests

Regulatory & Compliance Awareness

  • KYC/AML standards
  • Risk assessment and fraud monitoring flows
  • Audit and data governance requirements

Product Knowledge&

  • Deposits, credit cards, loans, mortgages
  • Financial transaction handling and dispute resolution
  • Call center/service workflows for banking customers

BFSI-Specific Salesforce Use Cases

  • Integration with core banking systems
  • Customer 360 views tailored for financial advisors
  • Service Cloud for banking contact centers
  • Lead-to-Opportunity flows specific to financial products

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Salary Range: $130,000 - 140,000 a year

The Salesforce Developer will work closely with Salesforce Architects, Administrators, Business Analysts, QA Engineers, integration teams, and program stakeholders to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, integrations, and modern Salesforce development practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Salesforce applications and enhancements.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce Flow.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies.
  • Translate functional and technical requirements into efficient Salesforce solutions.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Architects to implement solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.
  • Develop reusable components, services, and frameworks that improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established Salesforce development standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, data, and performance issues.
  • Support unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate technical documentation.
  • Support Salesforce releases, deployments, environment management, and production implementations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to support automated build, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Work with administrators and business teams to determine when declarative versus custom development is appropriate.
  • Ensure solutions align with applicable federal security, privacy, accessibility, and governance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of software development experience, including significant hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of SOQL, SOSL, Salesforce data models, and platform security.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external applications using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience developing solutions within Salesforce Lightning Experience.
  • Experience with version control and source-driven development.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce testing, releases, and production deployments.
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming and software development best practices.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to meet applicable federal background investigation requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting federal government, federal healthcare, or health IT programs.
  • Experience with Salesforce Government Cloud or Salesforce implementations within highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or other enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX and modern DevOps/CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub, or similar delivery tools.
  • Experience supporting enterprise modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder
  • Salesforce JavaScript Developer I
  • Other relevant Salesforce certifications
  • Disclaimer: This position is contingent upon ELYON’s receipt of contract award, Government acceptance of the proposed candidate, completion of required onboarding, and continued contract funding.**

Paid sick leave, Medical/Dental (optional), 401 (k) Retirement Plan (optional), Employer Paid Life Insurance, Employer Paid Short Term Disability, Optional Life Insurance.

ELYON International, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Title: Salesforce - Developer  
 
You are a Salesforce Developer with experience solving complex problems on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce developer you have knowledge of the technical domains of Salesforce including the various cloud platforms, programmatic development, declarative solutioning and integrations. You are a self-driven individual with a "get it done" attitude and a passion to solve complex business and technology problems.

  • Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that bestleveragethe Salesforce platform and products 
  • Participate in technical design sessions; develop technical solution documentation aligned with the business objectives 
  • Develop, test, and document custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation 
  • Utilize AI-driven accelerated engineering framework todeliverhigh productivity during project implementations
  • Develop custom solutions and interfaces on top of the Salesforce platform 
  • Execute test plans to ensure quality delivery 
  • Follow coding standards andparticipatein code reviews during projects to ensureappropriate designpatterns are followed 
  • Provide estimates and work breakdown structures for assigned tasks 
  • Absorb new product and technical capabilities from Salesforce during new product releases and acquisitions 

Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years Salesforce platform experience 
  • Proven ability to develop andoptimizeintegrated business processes across disparate systems 
  • Understanding of the Salesforce platform including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud,ExperienceCloudand common AppExchange solutions 
  • Development experience using Apex, Triggers, Batch Apex, integrations, and other programmatic solutions on the Salesforce platform (Add LWC, JavaScript and Salesforce Flows soften experience) 
  • Configuration experience using the Salesforce point-and-click application interface
  • Ability to perform automated testing and write unit tests 
  • Understanding of E2E lifecycle of Salesforce development collaborating with multiple engineers 
  • Knowledge of and experience using AI-enabled engineering approaches for enhancing Salesforce platform implementation
  • Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Metadata, etc.) 
  • Front-end development experience with Lightning Web Components 
  • Knowledge of integrations, 3rd party integration tools, ETL with Salesforce 
  • Knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, databasedesignand software development lifecycle 
  • Experience in Agile Methodology 
  • Experience and exposure in Einstein and Salesforce AI product capabilities 
  • Experience in CI/CD Salesforce services and processes 
  • Problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally either on a team or as an individual contributor 
  • Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire 
  • Excellent client-facing written, presentation and verbal communications skills

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 

 

Compensation and Benefits

Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.

 

Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: 

East Bay, San Francisco, Silicon Valley:

Consultant: $126,000-$154,000

Senior Consultant: $154,000–$189,000

San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Seattle, Boston, Houston, New Jersey, New York City, Washington DC, Westchester:

Consultant: $115,000-$141,000

Senior Consultant: $141,000–$173,000

All other locations:

Consultant: $106,000-$129,000

Senior Consultant: $130,000–$159,000


 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. We will accept applicants until 10/31, or until the position is filled.


We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.

Job Summary

Our Fortune 500 client located in New York, NY is seeking a Salesforce Developer to support the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of Salesforce solutions that support business operations and customer-facing processes. The successful candidate will work closely with business analysts, administrators, developers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable and high-quality Salesforce solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements and assist in developing technical solutions on the Salesforce platform.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce customizations, enhancements, and integrations.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce components using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and standard platform capabilities.
  • Support integrations with internal and external applications using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data quality controls.
  • Participate in system testing, defect resolution, and release deployments.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration documentation, and support materials.
  • Assist with Salesforce platform upgrades, enhancements, and environment management activities.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and provide production support as needed.
  • Follow Salesforce development best practices, coding standards, and security guidelines.
  • Collaborate with QA and DevOps teams to support CI/CD deployment processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of Salesforce development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and SOQL.
  • Experience developing and supporting Salesforce integrations using REST and/or SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with Git-based source control and CI/CD tools such as Copado.
  • Understanding of Salesforce security models, including roles, profiles, and permission sets.
  • Experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboard development.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.

Required Cerrification

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Salesforce App Builder certification.
  • Copado Fundamentals I

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce Platform
  • Apex
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Salesforce Flow
  • SOQL/SOSL
  • REST/SOAP APIs
  • Git
  • Copado
  • CI/CD
  • Salesforce Reports and Dashboards

We're seeking a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and implement scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform, working across Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow. The role blends strong coding skills with declarative configuration expertise, supporting mission‑critical public sector missions. You should also have strong data migration experience and be comfortable extracting from third party tools. Throughout, you'll apply best practices to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant implementations. Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Project Managers, you'll deliver tailored, compliant solutions for clients, focusing on Public Sector.

Responsibilities

  • Configure and enhance Salesforce solutions using primarily out-of-the-box capabilities, with an emphasis on scalable, maintainable platform design.
  • Support implementation of Salesforce Service Cloud for investigative case management, including case intake, case routing, workflows, queues, approvals, service processes, and reporting.
  • Configure and support a Salesforce Experience Cloud portal to enable secure external-user access, engagement, and self-service functions.
  • Build and maintain declarative Salesforce solutions using Flow, validation rules, approval processes, page layouts, Lightning record pages, custom objects, fields, reports, and dashboards.
  • Assess requests for custom development and clearly identify when Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, or other custom-code solutions are required.
  • Develop, test, deploy, and maintain Salesforce functionality in accordance with approved change-control, security, and release-management processes.
  • Own data migration, and data quality tasks, creating a Data Migration plan prior to executing migration.
  • Support data governance, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and production readiness activities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including configuration workbooks, solution designs, release notes, test evidence, and user-support materials.
  • Work directly with customer stakeholders in a fast-moving, small-team environment and communicate technical decisions in clear business terms.
  • Manage DevSecOps pipeline
  • Partner with the Project Manager, Cloud Architect, business analysts, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into Salesforce configuration and technical solutions.
  • Participate in requirements refinement, solution design, user-story development, backlog grooming, and sprint planning as needed.
  • Support security, authorization, and compliance activities as needed, including documentation and evidence required for the Authority to Operate (ATO) process.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Develop efficient and scalable code following best practices and industry standards.
  • Integrate Salesforce with other systems and platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and system interoperability.
  • Perform code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and debug Salesforce applications, identifying and resolving issues in a timely manner.
  • Stay updated on Salesforce releases, new features, and industry trends, and provide recommendations for enhancing development processes and applications.

Compensation & Benefits

Starting Salary Range for Salesforce Developer: $120,000 – $135,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights Include

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Basic Qualifications

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

  • Must demonstrate experience supporting Salesforce platform(s) within Department of Defense (DoD) environments.
  • 1-3 years of strong data migration experience, extracting data from third party tools and mapping it cleanly into Salesforce objects.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned.
  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of Salesforce Development

Work Environment

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. When you join MetLife’s Global Technology team, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking group dedicated to shaping the future of digital solutions for customers worldwide. You’ll develop, maintain and support technology applications and delivery, leveraging AI, automation, and contemporary ways of working to enhance experiences and drive business outcomes. Your work will simplify complex processes, improve tech resiliency, and ensure high-performing, seamless solutions that power life’s most important moments. In this dynamic environment, you’ll collaborate with talented peers across teams and functions, expanding your skills in impactful ways. Ready to push boundaries and set new industry standards? Join us and help drive the future of technology forward.

The Opportunity

The Tech Lead, Sales Technology is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and governing Salesforce-based capabilities that support the GB360 Sales platform and broader Sales Technology ART. This role partners with product, architecture, functional analysts, developers, QA, DevSecOps, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions across Salesforce and connected enterprise systems. The role requires Salesforce technical depth and the ability to lead implementation through SAFe delivery while improving quality, platform stability, and internal engineering capability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical design and development for GB360 Sales capabilities on Salesforce.com, ensuring feasible, secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Create and review solution designs, technical specifications, integration designs, data flows, component designs, and release-ready engineering artifacts.
  • Lead hands-on Salesforce development and configuration decisions across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, APIs, data model, security model, and platform automation as appropriate.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, Functional Analysts, Solution Architects, QA, and DevSecOps to translate business capabilities into technical stories, estimates, design options, and delivery plans.
  • Design and guide integrations connecting GB360 Sales with enterprise platforms such as US Data Hub, Seismic, underwriting, pricing, MetIQ, Teams/Outlook, Power Automate, and other Sales Technology ecosystem components.
  • Lead peer reviews of solution designs, configuration, code, test approach, and release artifacts to ensure Salesforce and enterprise engineering best practices are followed.
  • Support SAFe delivery ceremonies, including PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, dependency management, release planning, and production readiness reviews.
  • Guide development teams and vendor partners, including reviewing technical work products, resolving design issues, and mentoring engineers and configurators on Salesforce patterns and platform guardrails.
  • Lead incident analysis, defect triage, performance tuning, platform stability improvements, technical debt remediation, and production support readiness for complex GB360 Sales capabilities.
  • Evaluate Salesforce Einstein-enabled features and approved AI-assisted CRM patterns where they improve seller productivity, prioritization, recommendations, workflow automation, and user adoption.
  • Maintain awareness of Salesforce platform releases, limits, security requirements, integration options, and emerging Sales Technology patterns that could improve GB360 outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience designing and building enterprise-scale applications, platforms, or CRM solutions.
  • Extensive Salesforce implementation experience with hands-on technical delivery across Sales Cloud or comparable Salesforce CRM capabilities.
  • Experience designing and delivering Salesforce platform solutions.
  • Experience designing integrations using REST/SOAP/Bulk APIs, event-based patterns, middleware, ETL/ELT, data virtualization, or enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience leading technical design, development, peer review, testing readiness, and implementation for complex features or product increments.
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery, including story estimation, backlog refinement, PI/sprint planning, demos, and release readiness.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical options, design tradeoffs, implementation plans, and risk/issue recommendations.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and mentoring skills across business, technology, vendor, and distributed delivery teams.
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or equivalent Salesforce certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce Apex, Lightning Web Components or Aura, Flows, SOQL/SOSL, data model design, security model concepts, APIs, and Salesforce platform limits.
  • Working knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD, source control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, secure coding, monitoring, and production support practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce Einstein, CRM Analytics, Salesforce Connect, external objects, managed packages, Agentforce or other Salesforce AI-assisted capabilities.
  • Experience with AutoRabit, Azure DevOps, Git, SFDX, Copado, Jenkins, or comparable Salesforce release and DevOps tooling.
  • Experience with Seismic, US Data Hub, MetIQ, underwriting, pricing, marketing automation, or sales enablement integrations.
  • Experience in insurance, group benefits, commercial sales, broker/customer platforms, or enterprise CRM transformation.
  • SAFe for Teams, SAFe Scrum Master, Azure, MuleSoft, or integration architecture certification.

Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in office.

The expected salary range for this position is $122,950 - $181,800. This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.

Benefits We Offer

Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please click here.

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. As required by our governmental client, this position requires being a U.S. Citizen AND the ability to obtain and maintain a Government Public Trust Clearance.

The Salesforce Developer will design, build, and deliver solutions on the Salesforce platform. You will work across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and Flow to turn business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions. This role blends strong coding skills with sharp declarative instincts. Our best developers know Flow inside and out and know exactly when to configure and when to write code. If you take pride in clean, efficient, well-tested Salesforce solutions and want to support meaningful public sector missions, this is your seat.

Compensation & Benefits

Estimated Starting Salary Range for Salesforce Developer: $130-150k

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full-time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Salesforce Developer Responsibilities Include

  • Design, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and other code-based Salesforce technologies.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, stakeholders, and development teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Use Flow to solve complex requirements, with the ability to bridge out to code when necessary.
  • Develop efficient and scalable code following best practices and industry standards.
  • Build Lightning Web Components and Visualforce pages that meet business requirements.
  • Integrate Salesforce with other systems and platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and system interoperability.
  • Perform code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and debug Salesforce applications, identifying and resolving issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other developers, administrators, and QA testers, to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases, new features, and industry trends, and recommend enhancements to development processes and applications.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Salesforce Developer Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities Requested

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or II.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of general work experience.
  • Three (3) years of experience developing Lightning Web Components and Visualforce pages.
  • Full-stack engineering experience (proficient in database development and integration), including three (3) years deploying Salesforce production enterprise applications.
  • Strong expertise in the Salesforce platform and applications, with a deep understanding of Salesforce development best practices and standards.
  • Proficiency in the Apex programming language and declarative tools such as Flow or OmniStudio.
  • Experience using AWS Connect APIs, the Salesforce CTI adapter, and Omnichannel configuration/API.
  • Familiarity with front-end web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns and technologies, including REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with development projects using DevOps, Salesforce configuration, and/or Apex.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into efficient solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a Government Public Trust Clearance.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public sector experience, or multiple Salesforce project implementations.
  • Deep Flow expertise, with strong judgment on when to configure and when to write code.
  • Experience with version control systems and continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines such as Harness.io.
  • OmniStudio development experience.

descriptionHtml:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.

With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

We are looking to speak to candidate who are remote / USA or near one of our offices (e.g. New York City, San Francisco, Austin, Palo Alto)

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions across the core CRM platform, including custom development, automation, and integrations
  • Partner with business stakeholders, program managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions
  • Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
  • Collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and well-governed solutions in an Agile environment
  • Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies, and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Agentforce, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, privacy, and responsible AI usage

Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices
  • Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across Salesforce applications and related integrations
  • Investigate technical and integration issues and work closely with development, operations, admin, and business teams to resolve them effectively
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution options
  • Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
  • Research new platform capabilities, prototypes, and engineering approaches that can improve the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
  • Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization in Salesforce environments
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems using APIs, ETL tools, and automation platforms
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification strongly preferred; additional certifications such as JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect are a plus
  • Good understanding of AI-powered and agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution delivery

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
  • In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
  • In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. Job Type

Full-time

Description

At Commence, we’re the start of a new age of data-centric transformation, elevating health outcomes and powering better, more efficient process to program and patient health. We combine quality data-driven solutions that fuel answers, technology that advances performance, and clinical expertise that builds trust to create a more efficient path to quality care.

With human-centered, healthcare-relevant, and value-based solutions, we create new possibilities with data. We provide proof beyond the concept and performance beyond the scope with a focus on efficiencies that transform the lives of those we serve. With a culture driven by purpose, straightforward communication and clinical domain expertise, Commence cuts straight to better care.

Requirements

As a Senior Salesforce Developer you will take a leadership role in driving the design, development, and architecture of our Salesforce ecosystem. This position is critical in ensuring our Salesforce platform is scalable, optimized, and aligned with our business strategies. You will make high-impact technical decisions and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver solutions that support case and payment-dispute workflows at scale.

Salesforce Architecture (as Directed)

  • Define and implement robust architectures for Salesforce solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise goals and scalability requirements.
  • Evaluate and recommend best practices, tools, and strategies for Salesforce development and integration.
  • Lead the design and implementation of complex, multi-system integrations involving Salesforce and other platforms, particularly AWS.

Salesforce Development

  • Develop advanced Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning components, and Flow to meet complex business needs.
  • Build custom applications and enhancements, focusing on scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.
  • Establish and enforce development standards, including code quality, testing, and deployment practices.

Cloud Integration And Data Management

  • Implement seamless integrations between Salesforce and other cloud services, ensuring secure and efficient data exchange.
  • Design and implement data management strategies, including migration, integration, and data cleansing, to maintain platform integrity.

Technical Leadership (as Directed)

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions.
  • Lead technical discussions, resolve complex issues, and drive consensus on architectural decisions.

Process Optimization

  • Identify and drive improvements in development processes, tooling, and team collaboration to enhance delivery efficiency.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce advancements and industry trends to recommend and implement cutting-edge solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Proven experience in Salesforce architecture, with a track record of designing and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Deep proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning components, and advanced Salesforce configuration.
  • Expertise in Salesforce data management, including large-scale data migrations, integrations, and cleansing.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, using tools like REST APIs and middleware.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to design creative, enterprise-level solutions.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.

Description

The Salesforce Developer will support the design, build, and maintenance of Salesforce features for the Department of Veteran Affairs (VA) Loan Guaranty Service (LGY). This role will be hands-on with Salesforce object mapping defects, validating Apex callouts and Named Credentials, implementing hotfixes, validating permission set configurations, monitoring Salesforce debug logs, and assisting in production deployments. This role supports both ongoing sustainment and incremental enhancements to an existing enterprise Salesforce implementation, requiring strong judgment, code quality, and the ability to work within established architectural and compliance constraints.

Key Functions

  • Develop custom Salesforce applications, components, and integrations using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and API services.
  • Collaborate with consultants and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Implement complex business logic, workflows, triggers, and automation.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable integrations with external systems.
  • Ensure solutions adhere to Salesforce best practices and federal security and compliance standards.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and release management.
  • Maintain documentation, technical designs, and deployment procedures.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education & Experience (must meet one of the following):
    • Bachelor’s degree + 5 years of Salesforce or relevant software development experience, OR
    • Associate’s degree + 7 years of Salesforce or relevant software development experience, OR
    • High School Diploma/GED + 9 years of Salesforce or relevant software development experience.
  • Ability to obtain VA Public Trust Clearance.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I and Salesforce Administrator (or ability to obtain within 90 days).
  • OmniStudio - hands-on experience. OmniStudio Developer Certification.
Preferred Qualifications Or Skills

  • Platform Developer II, Advanced Administrator, or Salesforce App Builder.
  • Experience supporting federal government agencies or working in a consulting environment.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce deployments using structured DevOps and CI/CD practices (e.g., Copado, Gearset, Git-based workflows).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce security, compliance, and FedRAMP requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in collaborative, cross-functional teams.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am-5pm ET
  • Start date: ASAP
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance

The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.

With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

We are looking to speak to candidate who are remote / USA or near one of our offices (e.g. New York City, San Francisco, Austin, Palo Alto)

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions across the core CRM platform, including custom development, automation, and integrations
  • Partner with business stakeholders, program managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions
  • Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
  • Collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and well-governed solutions in an Agile environment
  • Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies, and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Agentforce, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, privacy, and responsible AI usage

Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices
  • Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across Salesforce applications and related integrations
  • Investigate technical and integration issues and work closely with development, operations, admin, and business teams to resolve them effectively
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution options
  • Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
  • Research new platform capabilities, prototypes, and engineering approaches that can improve the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
  • Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization in Salesforce environments
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems using APIs, ETL tools, and automation platforms
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification strongly preferred; additional certifications such as JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect are a plus
  • Good understanding of AI-powered and agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution delivery

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
  • In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
  • In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are seeking a Salesforce Developer to join our Information Technology Business Applications team. This is a Remote within the United States (with a hybrid preference for Santa Clara,CA/Bellevue, WA), reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Application Engineering.

In this role, you will drive the design, development, and scaling of robust Salesforce solutions that empower internal stakeholders and optimize business processes. By leveraging your expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and platform best practices, you will build critical applications, conduct rigorous testing, and maintain code quality to ensure high system performance and seamless data integrity across our environments.

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Develop and customize user interface components using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura, ensuring alignment with the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) and upgrading legacy Visualforce pages
  • Design and maintain highly efficient Apex Controllers, Triggers, and SOQL/SOSL queries while strictly adhering to Salesforce Governor Limits and development best practices
  • Champion overall code quality by refactoring existing Apex classes, ensuring context-aware execution, and utilizing JavaScript Helper functions to maintain clean controllers
  • Execute robust testing strategies by writing comprehensive Apex test classes to achieve high-quality test coverage, managing seamless deployments using VS Code and Git
  • Perform routine data administration, bulk uploads, and environment synchronization using Data Loader to maintain impeccable data integrity across all environments


Who You Are (Success Profile)

descriptionHtml:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.

With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

We are looking to speak to candidate who are remote / USA or near one of our offices (e.g. New York City, San Francisco, Austin, Palo Alto)

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions across the core CRM platform, including custom development, automation, and integrations
  • Partner with business stakeholders, program managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions
  • Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
  • Collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and well-governed solutions in an Agile environment
  • Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies, and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Agentforce, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, privacy, and responsible AI usage

Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices
  • Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across Salesforce applications and related integrations
  • Investigate technical and integration issues and work closely with development, operations, admin, and business teams to resolve them effectively
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution options
  • Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
  • Research new platform capabilities, prototypes, and engineering approaches that can improve the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
  • Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization in Salesforce environments
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems using APIs, ETL tools, and automation platforms
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification strongly preferred; additional certifications such as JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect are a plus
  • Good understanding of AI-powered and agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution delivery

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
  • In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
  • In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
