Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is seeking a Salesforce Engineer II to support its growing Power Utilization Management & Planning (PUMP) Business Process Automation (BPA) team. This rapidly-growing business within AWS offers a creative, fast-paced, entrepreneurial work environment. As the Salesforce Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for multiple user groups and global teams who require development, maintenance, configuration, reporting and training. You will also interface with various teams and produce reporting needed on a daily, weekly and monthly basis. You will work directly with the system/data, lead multiple technical projects or portions at one time, as well as provide solutions that are highly usable, scalable, extensible, and maintainable on the Force.com platform. You will also drive automation of processes, develop new applications, and manage the integrations to our various business systems for our Salesforce.com environment. This includes technical design, development, configuration, maintenance, administration, and integration with other Amazon databases/systems.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about their work, self-motivated, detail oriented and have excellent problem solving abilities. They will deal with highly ambiguous problems, taking full control and responsibility for finding solutions, and will drive towards simple solutions to complex problems.

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 1+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • 5+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
  • Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
  • Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
  • 3+ years of Salesforce.com development experience and certified Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience with Lightning Design System and creating custom components

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with PowerShell (preferred), Python, Ruby, or Java
  • Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II or equivalent experience
  • Enabling information security as a core competency in Amazon's use of third party cloud services
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and Visualforce development and the capability of dealing and developing solutions overcoming the Salesforce Governor Limits
  • Solid understanding of and experience with the Salesforce architecture and API
  • Strong verbal/written communication and data presentation skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/26/26.

Koniag Technology Solutions, inc a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Salesforce Developer to support KTS and our government customer. The position is remote.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

The Salesforce Developer will design, build, and test Salesforce features for the ERAS Platform. You will work closely with the USDA Product Owner, designers, and other engineers. Your work will support case management, workflows, and system connections (APIs) that track environmental reviews across many USDA agencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and configure Salesforce solutions for the ERAS Platform, including case management features.
  • Support a multi-tenant design that can handle cases from many USDA agencies, programs, and services.
  • Build and maintain APIs so USDA mission systems can send review requests and get results back.
  • Help create workflows that administrators can update, using tools like Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) or similar.
  • Connect Salesforce with other platform parts, such as the document library, policy-as-code engine, and geospatial systems.
  • Write clean, tested code. Meet the 90% test coverage standard and the project's linting rules.
  • Take part in sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work with user researchers and designers to turn user needs into working features.
  • Make sure work meets Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 (Levels A and AA) accessibility standards.
  • Follow secure coding practices, including OWASP standards, and fix security issues found in testing.
  • Use GitHub for version control and support automated builds and deployments through CI/CD tools.
  • Write clear documentation, including code comments, dependency lists, and system diagrams.
  • Protect government data, including Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and personally identifiable information (PII).
  • Report security concerns right away, within 60 minutes of discovery.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience developing on the Salesforce platform (confirm for "Mid" level).
  • Experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce flows.
  • Experience building and using REST APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience working on an agile team (Scrum or similar).
  • Experience with GitHub and CI/CD practices.
  • Knowledge of secure coding and web accessibility standards.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to obtain and keep a Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) low-risk clearance, or moderate-risk if handling PII, and a PIV card.
  • Ability to use multi-factor authentication and a government-furnished laptop when needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications, such as Platform Developer I or II (not required by the PWS; add if desired).
  • Experience with Salesforce Government Cloud or other federal projects.
  • Experience with case management or workflow tools.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript, and with Python, Ruby, or similar languages.
  • Experience with cloud.gov or other FedRAMP-approved cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of NEPA, environmental review, or USDA processes.
  • Experience with AI-enabled tools, including safeguards for their use.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.

The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at accommodations@koniag-gs.com or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

Koniag Government Services (KGS) is an Alaska Native Owned corporation supporting the values and traditions of our native communities through an agile employee and corporate culture that delivers Enterprise Solutions, Professional Services and Operational Management to Federal Government Agencies. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Koniag, we apply our proven commercial solutions to a deep knowledge of Defense and Civilian missions to provide forward leaning technical, professional, and operational solutions. KGS enables successful mission outcomes for our customers through solution-oriented business partnerships and a commitment to exceptional service delivery. We ensure long-term success with a continuous improvement approach while balancing the collective interests of our customers, employees, and native communities. descriptionHtml:
The Senior Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and supports solutions on the Salesforce platform. This role turns business requirements into well-engineered Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and integration solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and the core platform, supporting lead-to-cash, customer service, and franchise operations across multiple brands. The successful candidate owns the technical delivery of the features they build, working within the platform architecture and engineering standards. Hands-on experience with Field Service, Revenue Cloud, and Experience Cloud is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Salesforce Engineering (55%)

  • Design, build, test, and deploy Apex classes, triggers, batch and queueable jobs, Lightning Web Components, and Flows in line with established platform standards.
  • Build bulk-safe, scalable solutions that respect governor limits, the sharing and security model, and large data volume considerations.
  • Develop and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Named Credentials with AWS, ERP, accounting, and other enterprise systems.
  • Write meaningful unit tests, maintain code coverage, and take part in peer code and design reviews.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performance problems, and data defects for the capabilities they own.

Salesforce Solution Delivery (30%)

  • Configure and extend Sales Cloud and Service Cloud processes, including lead, account, opportunity, and case management and sales and service automation across multiple brands.
  • Design data models, security, and sharing configurations that scale across brands, business units, and user types.
  • Build and maintain automation with Flow and Apex, choosing between declarative and programmatic solutions appropriately and retiring legacy automation where needed.
  • Support and extend Field Service, Revenue Cloud, and Experience Cloud capabilities as business needs require.
  • Connect processes end to end across Salesforce and integrated systems so data and automation flow cleanly.

Delivery and Collaboration (15%)

  • Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to refine requirements, estimate work, and propose technical solutions.
  • Contribute to solution designs and technical documentation, and raise risks, technical debt, and platform constraints early.
  • Follow and help improve source control, CI/CD, testing, and release practices; take part in sprint ceremonies and release validation.
  • Share knowledge with administrators and other engineers through pairing, documentation, and demos.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of enterprise application development experience, including 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development.
  • Deep proficiency with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, asynchronous Apex, the Salesforce security and sharing model, and data model design.
  • Hands-on implementation experience with Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud in an enterprise environment, with multiple production releases.
  • Experience building and supporting integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and middleware patterns.
  • Working experience with Salesforce DevOps: Git, Salesforce CLI, source-driven development, sandbox strategy, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Field Service: hands-on implementation experience with work orders, service appointments, service resources and territories, scheduling policies, optimization, and the Field Service mobile app.
  • Revenue Cloud: experience with Salesforce CPQ and/or Revenue Cloud (Revenue Lifecycle Management), including product catalog, pricing, quoting, contracts, and orders; Salesforce Billing a plus.
  • Experience Cloud: experience building and securing customer and partner portals, including LWR and Aura sites, external and guest user sharing, and authentication.
  • Experience in multi-brand, franchise, or home services operating models.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with AWS services (API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge), MuleSoft, ERP, accounting, and payment platforms.
  • Exposure to Agentforce, Einstein, or Data Cloud capabilities.
  • Familiarity with DevOps tools (e.g., Copado, Gearset, GitHub Actions), static code analysis, and automated testing for Salesforce.

We believe our greatest assets are our employees, we offer competitive salaries and a full benefits package to include, PTO, paid holidays, 401(k) and more.

Authority Brands Inc. conducts drug screens and background checks on applicants who accept employment offers. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions however we do not sponsor Visa’s at this time.

Authority Brands Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

descriptionHtml:
A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens, you must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen. Public Trust eligible.

Position Summary

Seeking a skilled and experienced Salesforce Developer to design, build, and deliver solutions on the Salesforce platform. You will work across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and Flow to turn business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions. This role blends strong coding skills with sharp declarative instincts. Our best developers know Flow inside and out and know exactly when to configure and when to write code. If you take pride in clean, efficient, well-tested Salesforce solutions and want to support meaningful public sector missions, this is your seat.

Compensation & Benefits

Starting Salary Range for Salesforce Developer: $130,000 – $140,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights Include

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits Are Subject To Change And Eligibility Requirements Apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes The Following

  • Executes custom coding and complex technical builds using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and advanced automation engines.
  • Translates technical blueprints into functioning code, manages source control, and participates in unit testing to ensure robust deployment cycles.
  • Design, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and other code-based Salesforce technologies.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, stakeholders, and development teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Use Flow to solve complex requirements, with the ability to bridge out to code when necessary.
  • Develop efficient and scalable code following best practices and industry standards.
  • Build Lightning Web Components and Visualforce pages that meet business requirements.
  • Integrate Salesforce with other systems and platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and system interoperability.
  • Perform code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and debug Salesforce applications, identifying and resolving issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other developers, administrators, and QA testers, to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases, new features, and industry trends, and recommend enhancements to development processes and applications.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or II.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of general work experience.
  • Three (3) years of experience developing Lightning Web Components and Visualforce pages.
  • Full-stack engineering experience (proficient in database development and integration), including three (3) years deploying Salesforce production enterprise applications.
  • Strong expertise in the Salesforce platform and applications, with a deep understanding of Salesforce development best practices and standards.
  • Proficiency in the Apex programming language and declarative tools such as Flow or OmniStudio.
  • Experience using AWS Connect APIs, the Salesforce CTI adapter, and Omnichannel configuration/API.
  • Familiarity with front-end web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns and technologies, including REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with development projects using DevOps, Salesforce configuration, and/or Apex.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into efficient solutions.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a Government Public Trust Clearance.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.
  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public sector experience, or multiple Salesforce project implementations.
  • Deep Flow expertise, with strong judgment on when to configure and when to write code.
  • Experience with version control systems and continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines such as Harness.io.
  • OmniStudio development experience.

Company Information

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. HESFP, LLC, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

For applicants located in Colorado, New York, California, Washington, Illinois, Hawaii, Massachusetts, or other states with pay transparency requirements: the estimated annual salary range for this position is $130,000 – $140,000. Actual compensation varies based on qualifications, experience, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Cherokee Federal is a federal contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA). As required by VEVRAA, we take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans. Protected veterans are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Cherokee Federal takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Qualified individuals with disabilities are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact Human Resources at careers@cherokee-federal.com.

This position is subject to pre-employment drug testing. Cherokee Federal maintains a drug-free workplace in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and regulations.

This position may be contingent upon the successful completion of a background investigation. The scope of the investigation will be commensurate with position requirements and applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.

With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

We are looking to speak to candidate who are remote / USA or near one of our offices (e.g. New York City, San Francisco, Austin, Palo Alto)

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions across the core CRM platform, including custom development, automation, and integrations
  • Partner with business stakeholders, program managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions
  • Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
  • Collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and well-governed solutions in an Agile environment
  • Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies, and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Agentforce, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, privacy, and responsible AI usage

Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices
  • Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across Salesforce applications and related integrations
  • Investigate technical and integration issues and work closely with development, operations, admin, and business teams to resolve them effectively
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution options
  • Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
  • Research new platform capabilities, prototypes, and engineering approaches that can improve the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
  • Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization in Salesforce environments
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems using APIs, ETL tools, and automation platforms
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification strongly preferred; additional certifications such as JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect are a plus
  • Good understanding of AI-powered and agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution delivery

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
  • In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
  • In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

When you join MetLife’s Global Technology team, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking group dedicated to shaping the future of digital solutions for customers worldwide. You’ll develop, maintain and support technology applications and delivery, leveraging AI, automation, and contemporary ways of working to enhance experiences and drive business outcomes. Your work will simplify complex processes, improve tech resiliency, and ensure high-performing, seamless solutions that power life’s most important moments. In this dynamic environment, you’ll collaborate with talented peers across teams and functions, expanding your skills in impactful ways. Ready to push boundaries and set new industry standards? Join us and help drive the future of technology forward.

The Opportunity

The Tech Lead, Sales Technology is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and governing Salesforce-based capabilities that support the GB360 Sales platform and broader Sales Technology ART. This role partners with product, architecture, functional analysts, developers, QA, DevSecOps, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions across Salesforce and connected enterprise systems. The role requires Salesforce technical depth and the ability to lead implementation through SAFe delivery while improving quality, platform stability, and internal engineering capability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical design and development for GB360 Sales capabilities on Salesforce.com, ensuring feasible, secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Create and review solution designs, technical specifications, integration designs, data flows, component designs, and release-ready engineering artifacts.
  • Lead hands-on Salesforce development and configuration decisions across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, APIs, data model, security model, and platform automation as appropriate.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, Functional Analysts, Solution Architects, QA, and DevSecOps to translate business capabilities into technical stories, estimates, design options, and delivery plans.
  • Design and guide integrations connecting GB360 Sales with enterprise platforms such as US Data Hub, Seismic, underwriting, pricing, MetIQ, Teams/Outlook, Power Automate, and other Sales Technology ecosystem components.
  • Lead peer reviews of solution designs, configuration, code, test approach, and release artifacts to ensure Salesforce and enterprise engineering best practices are followed.
  • Support SAFe delivery ceremonies, including PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, dependency management, release planning, and production readiness reviews.
  • Guide development teams and vendor partners, including reviewing technical work products, resolving design issues, and mentoring engineers and configurators on Salesforce patterns and platform guardrails.
  • Lead incident analysis, defect triage, performance tuning, platform stability improvements, technical debt remediation, and production support readiness for complex GB360 Sales capabilities.
  • Evaluate Salesforce Einstein-enabled features and approved AI-assisted CRM patterns where they improve seller productivity, prioritization, recommendations, workflow automation, and user adoption.
  • Maintain awareness of Salesforce platform releases, limits, security requirements, integration options, and emerging Sales Technology patterns that could improve GB360 outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience designing and building enterprise-scale applications, platforms, or CRM solutions.
  • Extensive Salesforce implementation experience with hands-on technical delivery across Sales Cloud or comparable Salesforce CRM capabilities.
  • Experience designing and delivering Salesforce platform solutions.
  • Experience designing integrations using REST/SOAP/Bulk APIs, event-based patterns, middleware, ETL/ELT, data virtualization, or enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience leading technical design, development, peer review, testing readiness, and implementation for complex features or product increments.
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery, including story estimation, backlog refinement, PI/sprint planning, demos, and release readiness.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical options, design tradeoffs, implementation plans, and risk/issue recommendations.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and mentoring skills across business, technology, vendor, and distributed delivery teams.
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or equivalent Salesforce certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce Apex, Lightning Web Components or Aura, Flows, SOQL/SOSL, data model design, security model concepts, APIs, and Salesforce platform limits.
  • Working knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD, source control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, secure coding, monitoring, and production support practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce Einstein, CRM Analytics, Salesforce Connect, external objects, managed packages, Agentforce or other Salesforce AI-assisted capabilities.
  • Experience with AutoRabit, Azure DevOps, Git, SFDX, Copado, Jenkins, or comparable Salesforce release and DevOps tooling.
  • Experience with Seismic, US Data Hub, MetIQ, underwriting, pricing, marketing automation, or sales enablement integrations.
  • Experience in insurance, group benefits, commercial sales, broker/customer platforms, or enterprise CRM transformation.
  • SAFe for Teams, SAFe Scrum Master, Azure, MuleSoft, or integration architecture certification.

Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in office.

The expected salary range for this position is $122,950 - $181,800. This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.

Benefits We Offer

Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please click here.

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. Description

  • We are open to supporting 100% remote work anywhere within the continental US.*

Our team is a leading provider of Digital Transformation services for Federal agencies. Our services focus on enabling agency mission and business transformation using industry-leading low-code platforms, mobile applications, robotics process automation, and data analytics platforms. We are partnered with some of the world’s leading and most innovative companies like Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, and UiPath. We focus on offering a full range of architecture and planning, system implementation, integration, analytics, and O&M for our customers.

ICF is seeking Salesforce Developers to join our team! You will work with our highly qualified Salesforce Architects and Business Analysts to translate business requirements into technical solutions that utilize Salesforce platform best practices. We leverage SCRUM Agile methodology to iteratively develop and test Salesforce solutions.

As Senior Developer, you will lead integrations using Web Services and APIs and lead data migration efforts from legacy applications. You will be responsible for Salesforce declarative or programmatic development resources such as triggers, Flows, validations, approvals, Apex classes, and Lightning Web Components. Execute test plans to ensure quality delivery using test code and unit tests. Working with and supervising & assisting junior team members, to scope and implement complex business solutions. Follow coding standards and participate in architect code reviews during projects to ensure appropriate design patterns are followed.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in complete application life cycle from technical design, architecture, development, testing, and deployment of high-quality salesforce solutions using coding best practices
  • Identify and recommend creative solutions to build extensions to the out-of-the-box capabilities of the platform.
  • Communicate and collaborate with other technical resources like architects, admins, configuration experts, and stakeholders regarding status, risks, and any technical issues.
  • Implement multiple AppExchange tools like DocuSign, eSign Live, and others.
  • Develop salesforce to on-prem solution integrations using APIs and Web Services.
  • Ability to work well with customers both individually as well as in a highly collaborative team
  • Engage in code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices
  • Provide mentoring and technical leadership to other team members

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Salesforce.com custom development including Lightning Design Systems, APEX, Visualforce, Lightning Design System, Lightning Components, etc.
  • 4+ years of experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications such as Docusign & using web services like SOAP or REST API with OAuth.
  • 2+ years of experience with MuleSoft and Docusign
  • 2+ years of experience with GitHub and Jenkins
  • Must have lived in the US for the past 4 years and the work MUST BE PERFORMED in the United States (U.S.), as this work is for a federal contract and laws do apply
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust
  • Must be a US Citizen or Permanent Resident per contract requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Salesforce Certification(s)
  • Specialized Consultant Certifications like Sales, Service or Community (Preferred)
  • Experience with Public Sector Solutions or Service Cloud and Agentforce.

#DMX #icfsalesforce

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 

Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  

Pay Range

There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

The pay range for this position based on full-time employment is:

$81,499.00 - $138,549.00

Description

Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements that support Amazon's long-term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon's scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

The Worldwide Sustainability Salesforce Team is looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer to design, build, and integrate the Salesforce instances that support Sustainability teams across Amazon. You will work across Salesforce and AWS, and you will help set the technical direction for both.

We're building out our Salesforce instances to support Sustainability goals that reach every part of Amazon's business. In this role you will help define the long-term technical architecture for how Worldwide Sustainability uses Salesforce, AWS, and AI to improve productivity and operate more efficiently. You will use your engineering judgment and architecture experience to design and build secure, scalable products for internal customers across Amazon in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the technical architecture of the Sustainability Salesforce instances, including the data model, security and sharing model, automation strategy, and integration patterns across multiple orgs.
  • Evaluate when to build custom, configure native platform features, or adopt an AppExchange product, and recommend the right tool for each requirement.
  • Design, build, and maintain custom solutions with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and Salesforce platform APIs that hold up under large data volumes and platform governor limits.
  • Design and build integrations between Salesforce, AWS, and other internal Amazon systems, using API-based and event-driven patterns, secure authentication, and serverless services.
  • Build and operate the AWS components the platform depends on, defined as infrastructure as code, with logging, monitoring, alarms, and least-privilege access.
  • Build generative AI features into the platform on Salesforce and AWS, and use AI-assisted development tools to deliver faster without lowering quality.
  • Own the engineering lifecycle, including source control, code review, automated testing, static code analysis, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management from sandbox through production.
  • Protect platform security and data quality by enforcing object and field-level security, managing credentials and secrets, and resolving security findings.
  • Lead technical design reviews and code reviews, set development standards, and mentor developers and administrators on the team.
  • Partner with product owners, program managers, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into technical designs, estimates, and delivery plans.
  • Resolve escalated production issues across Salesforce and connected systems, find the root cause, and build mechanisms that prevent the same failure from happening again.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to use Salesforce, AWS, and AI in new ways to improve business processes, increase productivity, and support an organization scaling at a rapid pace.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
  • 2+ years of AWS experience EC2, S3, ECS, Lambdas, EventBridge, SNS, SQS, SES, CodeCommit etc. and proficiency in integration technologies (JSON, REST, SOAP, GraphQL)
  • Experience writing technical documents, project plans and progress reports to leadership and to stakeholders
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Experience Cloud

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with distributed systems at scale
  • 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect or equivalent experience
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architecture Designer
  • Familiarity with Amazon’s security certification processes (Amazon Security Review / Anvil, Kale)

About The Role

The Sr. Salesforce Developer builds and improves Perry Homes' Salesforce platform. Sales Cloud is the core of the role, centered on the lead-to-opportunity journey that connects homebuyers with our sales teams, with Service Cloud work as needed. This developer delivers Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flows, uses existing platform capability and configuration before custom code, and works with integration teams on connections to our custom quoting and configuration platform (SalesHub) and Azure/.NET middleware.

The role is part of building Perry Homes' in-house Salesforce capability. Early work centers on improving Sales Cloud (lead conversion, duplicate management, data quality), helping establish source control and CI/CD practices, improving test coverage and monitoring, and supporting the move of codebase ownership to the internal team. Perry Homes does not build software for sale; what you build serves our sales teams and homebuyers directly.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain Sales Cloud solutions for lead capture, lead-to-opportunity conversion, assignment, duplicate management, and the opportunity lifecycle
  • Use existing Salesforce capability and configuration (Flows, Duplicate and Matching Rules, validation rules) before custom code, and help decide when Apex or LWC is the right choice
  • Develop Apex (triggers, batch, queueable, and scheduled jobs) with test classes that have meaningful assertions, and refactor existing code to improve test coverage and reliability
  • Build Lightning Web Components and Screen Flows with clear validation and error messages
  • Support Service Cloud development as needed, including warranty case workflows, and occasional Marketing Cloud integration work with the Marketing team's administrator
  • Maintain and improve the security model (permission sets, least-privilege access), with architect review
  • Collaborate with integration teams on the Salesforce side of connections to SalesHub and Azure/.NET middleware
  • Build logging, error handling, monitoring, and alerting for critical Salesforce automations and integrations; help reconcile records when a sync fails; and provide production support for escalated issues


Requirements


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, IT, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Solid Apex skills, including asynchronous processing and test classes with meaningful assertions rather than coverage-only tests
  • Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components and Flows, including Screen Flows
  • Strong hands-on Sales Cloud experience: lead management and conversion, duplicate and matching rules, assignment rules, and opportunity management
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce security and sharing model, Salesforce APIs (REST/Bulk), OAuth/Connected Apps, and platform events


Benefits


Why You Will Love Working Here

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package:
  • Medical, dental, vision coverage
  • Financial Planning
  • Time Off & Life Balance
  • Family & Lifestyle
  • Opportunities for growth and development
  • Culture that is collaborative, inclusive, fast-paced, people-first
  • Stable company with strong reputation in the market

At Perry Homes, we're committed to integrity, excellence, and service—values that guide every customer interaction. Join a team where your work directly contributes to an exceptional homebuying experience and a trusted brand. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people can do their best work.

descriptionHtml:
Louisiana-Pacific Corporation (LP Building Solutions) is a leading provider of high-performance building solutions that meet the demands of builders, remodelers, and homeowners worldwide. We manufacture engineered wood building products that include an extensive offering of innovative and dependable building materials and accessories. LP’s values-driven culture creates an environment where talented and hardworking people thrive in an ethical, inclusive, challenging, and rewarding place to work. Since our founding in 1972, we’ve developed careers and provided advancement opportunities in the building products industry. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, LP operates more than 20 facilities across North and South America. For more information, visit LPCorp.com.

Job Purpose

LP is expanding its internal Salesforce engineering capability and is looking for a senior developer who can build, modernize, and support business-critical solutions across an integrated enterprise environment. You will work in a Salesforce ecosystem connected to SAP and other enterprise platforms, solving problems that span custom development, automation, data, integration, security, and platform architecture.

The Senior Salesforce Developer will help shape Salesforce engineering standards, development patterns, and repeatable DevOps and release practices as technical ownership grows within IT. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take a solution from technical design through production support, modernize existing solutions, reduce technical debt, and make sound decisions about when to use configuration and when custom development is warranted.

In This Position You Will Have The Opportunity To

  • Build and Modernize Salesforce Solutions
    • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, asynchronous Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flow, and Salesforce APIs.
    • Translate business and technical requirements into clear technical designs, implementation tasks, estimates, and production-ready solutions.
    • Build reusable, bulk-safe, secure, and maintainable code that operates effectively within Salesforce governor limits and established architecture patterns.
    • Create meaningful automated tests, perform code reviews, and resolve defects before changes reach production.

descriptionHtml:
Artisan Partners Limited Partnership is seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer to support and enhance our Salesforce Sales platform, a business-critical system supporting the Sales Enablement organization. This role will be responsible for technical development, ongoing enhancements, and support of the Salesforce ecosystem, with a particular emphasis on delivering intuitive, efficient, and modern user experiences and interface design within Salesforce.

The ideal candidate will have a strong Salesforce development background across Lightning Experience (LEX), Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, integrations, data, and platform security. While this is a hands-on development position, the role requires someone who can understand business workflows and translate them into scalable, user-friendly Salesforce solutions.

The primary focus of the position will be UI/UX development, improving how Sales users interact with Salesforce and simplifying complex business processes through thoughtful application design and automation. The role will also have an AI-forward focus, I with opportunities to incorporate artificial intelligence into the Salesforce ecosystem. Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, Snowflake Cortex, or similar enterprise AI technologies is highly desirable.

Salesforce operates within a broader technology and data ecosystem that includes Snowflake, making experience with Snowflake, data integration/ETL, APIs, and AI-enabled data solutions an additional advantage.

Responsibilities

The candidate is expected to:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support solutions across the Salesforce Sales platform with a strong emphasis on UI/UX
  • Develop modern and intuitive Salesforce user experiences using Lightning Experience (LEX), Lightning Web Components (LWC), Lightning App Builder, and related Salesforce technologies
  • Develop and maintain custom Salesforce functionality using Apex, SOQL/SOSL, triggers, asynchronous processing, APIs, and platform automation
  • Develop and support integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, event-driven integrations, and other integration patterns
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Salesforce security, including profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, role hierarchy, field-level security, connected applications, OAuth, and integration security
  • Participate in code reviews, automated testing, release management, deployment activities, troubleshooting, and production support
  • Partner closely with Sales Enablement stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions
  • Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, data, infrastructure, and other technology teams when designing solutions that extend beyond Salesforce
  • Support integration and data movement between Salesforce and Snowflake, including ETL/ELT processes and APIs, while exploring opportunities to incorporate AI and intelligent automation into Salesforce workflows and Sales Enablement processes, including technologies such as Salesforce Agentforce and Snowflake Cortex
  • Remain current on Salesforce releases, platform capabilities, security changes, development practices, and emerging AI technologies

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional Salesforce development experience, including hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), integrations, and platform configuration
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake
  • Experience working in financial services, investment management, asset management, or other highly regulated environments
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder, or relevant Salesforce AI certifications
  • Experience with Salesforce Agentforce and/or Einstein AI capabilities
  • Experience building or integrating AI agents and AI-enabled business workflows
  • Experience with Snowflake, including data integration, ETL/ELT, Cortex AI or other enterprise generative AI platforms
  • Understanding of semantic data models, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to make effective architectural decisions, including determining when capabilities should be built natively in Salesforce versus leveraging enterprise data, integration, analytics, or AI platforms

Privacy Notice for California Applicants

Artisan Partners Limited Partnership is an equal opportunity employer. Artisan Partners does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. All employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

Job Title: Salesforce - Developer  
 
You are a Salesforce Developer with experience solving complex problems on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce developer you have knowledge of the technical domains of Salesforce including the various cloud platforms, programmatic development, declarative solutioning and integrations. You are passionate about building hands-on technical implementations. You are a self-driven individual with a "get it done" attitude and a passion to solve complex business and technology problems.

  • Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that bestleveragethe Salesforce platform and products 
  • Participate in technical design sessions; develop technical solution documentation aligned with the business objectives 
  • Develop, test, and document custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation 
  • Utilize AI-driven accelerated engineering framework todeliverhigh productivity during project implementations
  • Develop custom solutions and interfaces on top of the Salesforce platform 
  • Execute test plans to ensure quality delivery 
  • Follow coding standards andparticipatein code reviews during projects to ensureappropriate designpatterns are followed 
  • Provide estimates and work breakdown structures for assigned tasks 
  • Absorb new product and technical capabilities from Salesforce during new product releases and acquisitions 

Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years Salesforce platform experience 
  • Proven ability to develop andoptimizeintegrated business processes across disparate systems 
  • Understanding of the Salesforce platform including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud,ExperienceCloudand common AppExchange solutions 
  • Development experience using Apex, Triggers, Batch Apex, integrations, and other programmatic solutions on the Salesforce platform (Add LWC, JavaScript and Salesforce Flows soften experience) 
  • Configuration experience using the Salesforce point-and-click application interface
  • Ability to perform automated testing and write unit tests 
  • Understanding of E2E lifecycle of Salesforce development collaborating with multiple engineers 
  • Knowledge of and experience using AI-enabled engineering approaches for enhancing Salesforce platform implementation
  • Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Metadata, etc.) 
  • Front-end development experience with Lightning Web Components 
  • Knowledge of integrations, 3rd party integration tools, ETL with Salesforce 
  • Knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, databasedesignand software development lifecycle 
  • Experience in Agile Methodology 
  • Experience and exposure in Einstein and Salesforce AI product capabilities 
  • Experience in CI/CD Salesforce services and processes 
  • Problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally either on a team or as an individual contributor 
  • Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire 
  • Excellent client-facing written, presentation and verbal communications skills

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 

 

Compensation and Benefits

Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.

 

Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: 

East Bay, San Francisco, Silicon Valley:

Consultant: $126,000-$154,000

Senior Consultant: $154,000–$189,000

San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Seattle, Boston, Houston, New Jersey, New York City, Washington DC, Westchester:

Consultant: $115,000-$141,000

Senior Consultant: $141,000–$173,000

All other locations:

Consultant: $106,000-$129,000

Senior Consultant: $130,000–$159,000


 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. We will accept applicants until 10/31, or until the position is filled.


We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.

  • Possess 2-5 years of Salesforce development experience to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Implement process automations, build scalable custom solutions, and collaborate with team members to interpret and translate business requirements into technical capabilities.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Salesforce security and object model setup.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact.   • 2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components

Sponsorship: This position does not offer any type of sponsorship. Candidates must already be authorized to work in the U.S. (e.g., Citizen, Permanent Resident, or EAD).

  • Collaborate with multiple internal teams to plan and support integrations with core Rails applications.
  • Write and review technical documentation and perform code reviews.
  • Write and maintain robust automated test suites to ensure code quality.
  • Develop tools and processes to automate development, testing, and production workflows, including release management, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Strong experience developing features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce Flows.
  • Experience building scalable architecture, including batch flows, asynchronous calls, managing governor limits, and performance monitoring.

  • Experience building fault-tolerant integrations between external systems.

Experience:

  • 3-6 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Experience working in agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional product teams.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
  • Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Possess 4-8 years of Salesforce development experience to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Implement process automations, build scalable custom solutions, and collaborate with team members to interpret and translate business requirements into technical capabilities.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Salesforce security and object model setup.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 4-8+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $135,000-$165,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
