descriptionHtml:
Salesforce Developer (Agentforce Specialist) - Salesforce Federal Delivery

Location: Remote (US-based). While this is a primarily remote role, possible in-person expectations include visits with customers and Thunder offices in Northern Virginia/DC.

Employment Type: This is a contingent role based upon a successful bid award.

Role Summary: The Salesforce Developer will deliver scalable, secure AI solutions on the Salesforce platform based on industry best practices and mission needs. Beyond traditional platform maintenance, this role pioneers the next generation of AI-driven government service by designing, developing, and deploying Agentforce agents and custom actions that transform everyday interactions between citizens and government agencies. You will collaborate with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Project Managers to implement customized, scalable, and compliant Salesforce AI solutions that directly support Federal agencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agentforce & AI Development: Design, configure, and deploy autonomous and hybrid AI agents using Agentforce, customized subagent orchestration, instructions, and guardrails to handle complex mission inquiries.
  • Custom Action Building: Develop Apex classes, flows, and API connectors to equip Agentforce agents with custom actions and API integrations required to execute complex tasks.
  • Data Grounding & System Integration: Implement secure data grounding strategies and build API integrations between legacy Federal systems, Data Cloud, and Salesforce to provide Agentforce with accurate context.
  • Custom Development: Build Lightning Web Components (LWCs) and Apex triggers to enhance user interfaces and backend processes that interact with AI agent workflows.
  • AI Safety & Compliance: Enforce Federal security and compliance standards, configuring trust layers, data privacy controls, and audit mechanisms within AI interactions.
  • Solution Design & Collaboration: Work alongside Business Analysts and Architects to translate complex mission-critical business requirements into high-impact AI agent architectures.
  • Quality & Compliance: Conduct agent testing, prompt evaluation, and UAT support to ensure precise, reliable, and compliant AI outputs in cleared environments.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Support secure CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to enable rapid, reliable deployments of AI configurations in Federal delivery environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, LWC, secure REST/SOAP APIs) with practical expertise in building and deploying Agentforce agents or generative AI solutions.
  • AgentForce Domain Experience: Deep understanding of Agentforce architecture, custom action development, prompt configuration, grounding techniques, and Data Cloud integration.
  • Core Automation: Proven track record of implementing complex business logic, enterprise workflows, and custom platform automations using apex triggers, flows, and other declarative technology
  • Federal Context: Experience integrating Salesforce with legacy Federal systems and navigating cleared, highly regulated environments.
  • Development Tools & Methodologies: Proficiency with Git, secure coding standards, and DevSecOps/CI/CD pipelines. Active participant in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
  • Clearance & Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required, with the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Certifications

  • Required: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I and Salesforce Certified AI Specialist
  • Preferred: Data Cloud Consultant, and/or Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II

Why Thunder? Because You Deserve More Than Just a Job.

  • A Culture of Builders: We’re a remote-first, global team of curious, collaborative problem-solvers. You’ll have the opportunity to refine processes, solve challenges, and help shape the future of Salesforce and Amazon consulting. If you’re excited to build, innovate, and grow, you’ll fit right in.
  • Forge Your Own Path: At Thunder, you’re not just filling a role—you’re shaping it. Whether it’s jumping into presales, refining our methodology, or building something entirely new, the opportunity to innovate is yours to take.

Perks In Store For You

  • Comprehensive Benefits with Sequoia: Medical, Dental, Vision, and Employer-Paid Life/Disability Insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered.
  • Ownership & Impact: Stock options in a fast-moving, high-growth company. Every employee plays a part in what we’re building. Come make your mark!
  • Level Up Your Career: Real opportunities to grow your Salesforce and Amazon expertise through mentorship, certifications, and hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology.
  • People-First Flexibility: We’re always listening, evolving, and adapting. Your feedback helps shape our policies, ensuring you can thrive—professionally and personally.

At Thunder, we are committed to pay equity and transparency. The annual salary range for this position is $110,000 to $170,000 and represents the national base pay targets for this role across all U.S. locations. This disclosed range does not include additional compensation components such as discretionary bonuses, equity, or our standard employee benefits package. Actual individual pay decisions are based on a rigorous assessment of job-related factors, including the candidate’s geographic location, relevant certifications, and specific level of professional experience. Please note that it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, as compensation is tailored to the unique facts and circumstances of each specific case.

Research shows that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We recognize that it is highly unlikely that someone meets 100% of the qualifications for a role. If most of this job description describes you, then we encourage you to please apply for this role. Thunder is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, and is deeply committed to building and supporting our diverse team through inclusive, equitable hiring practices.

Thunder does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. All resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any employee via email, the Internet (including LinkedIn), or directly without a fully-executed search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Thunder, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired.

Salesforce Developer – Mid


Cinteot is seeking a Salesforce Developer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position is located in Herndon, VA. The qualified applicant will become part of Cinteot's Department of State (DOS) Consular Systems Modernization (CSM) Program, for the Bureau of Diplomatic Technology (DT). · Perform app development, prototyping, testing and demonstrating capabilities to users.

· Perform code merges, resolve conflicts, deploy repositories to sandboxes and test environments, as well as assist deployments to higher environments and production.

· Build custom applications using declarative customization capabilities, e.g. flows and using App Builder.

· Design and provide solution recommendations and roadmaps for service modernizations using Salesforce Platform, both out-of-box capabilities and customized solutions.

· Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with customers to architect Salesforce solutions to meet business requirements.

· Use your technical proficiency with the Salesforce platform to design and develop business functionalities using inbuilt CRM/CX technologies and functionalities.

· Map Salesforce capabilities, features and best practices against business and technical requirements by performing fit-gap analysis against Salesforce cloud, service, community, available tools available within AppExchange and Salesforce Platform.

· Document, maintain, and govern Salesforce solutions, both out-of-box capabilities and customized, to meet business requirements for service modernizations across their respective lifecycles. Work with systems architects and support team members to address security and compliance (e.g. section 508, FISMA) requirements related to the setup of Salesforce platform sandbox and development environments.

· Work on design and development of interfaces APIs and integrations from Salesforce to external systems.

· Ensure that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance and security requirements are closely monitored by working with development teams.


Basic Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s Degree and 5 years’ of experience or Master’s Degree and 3 years’ of experience.

· At least 3 years’ direct experience in Agile software development lifecycle.

· At least 2 years of experience in development of enterprise-level Salesforce projects throughout implementation of lifecycles with demonstrable success.

· Fluent in performing code merges of Salesforce git repositories, including conflict resolution.

· Experienced in deploying repositories to sandboxes and test environments.

· Experience in writing Visualforce, Apex classes/controllers, triggers, SOQL and SOSL.

· Proficiency in related tools (Data Loader, Workbench, Salesforce Platform IDE, and integrations of third-party tools with Salesforce).

· Experience designing, building, and implementing custom applications using the declarative customization capabilities of the Salesforce Platform

· Active Secret (or higher) clearance. Interim clearance acceptable.


Preferred Qualifications:

· Certified Force.com/Salesforce Platform Advanced Developer (DEV 501).

· Certified Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent experience.

· Experience developing/deploying applications written in open languages on Heroku and integration with Salesforce platform.

Benefits:

  • Complete Insurance Coverage
  • Blue Cross Medical, Delta Dental, Vision, Life
  • 401k with Company Contribution
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Generous Paid Time Off (including your birthday!)


Cinteot is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Pay Range

$115,900.00 - $190,450.00

Role Summary

The Senior Salesforce Developer role combines technical leadership with hands-on development and strategic architectural design. You'll be the driving force behind our Salesforce platform, responsible for designing, developing, and implementing complex solutions while guiding our team of developers and admins.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architectural Design: Lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance Salesforce solutions, including complex integrations with other enterprise systems
  • Technical Leadership: Act as the go-to technical expert for the Salesforce ecosystem. You'll provide technical leadership across Salesforce products like Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, ensuring our solutions are cohesive and effective. You'll also lead architectural and code reviews, as well as technical design sessions with both internal and external teams
  • Hands-on Development: Write clean, efficient code using Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning components. You'll also use Salesforce's declarative tools to build robust solutions
  • Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with stakeholders and product owners to define the technical roadmap and vision for the Salesforce platform, ensuring our technology aligns with business goals
  • DevOps & Release Management: Manage the end-to-end development lifecycle, from continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) to seamless, timely releases
  • Problem-Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities
  • Quality & Best Practices: You'll mentor developers, enforce best practices, and conduct code reviews to ensure quality and maintainability

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with a significant portion of that time in a senior developer and/or architect role
  • Deep expertise in Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns, including REST/SOAP APIs and middleware platforms
  • Proficiency with Salesforce data model, security model, and declarative tools (Flow, Process Builder, etc.)
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Copado, Gearset)

Why Join Bio-Techne

  • We offer competitive insurance benefits starting on day one: medical, dental, vision, life, short-term disability, long-term disability, pet, and legal and ID shield.
  • We invest in our employees’ financial futures through 401k plans, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), Health Saving Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Dependent Care FSA.
  • We empower our employees develop their careers through mentorship, promotional opportunities, training and development, tuition reimbursement, internship programs, and more.
  • We offer employee resource groups, volunteer paid time off, employee events, and charity drives to build a culture of caring and belonging.
  • We offer an accrued leave policy with paid holidays, paid time off, and paid parental leave.
  • We foster a culture of empowerment and innovation, where employees feel valued and encouraged to bring their new ideas to the table.

Bio-Techne is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

To protect the interests of all, Bio-Techne will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than a candidate application. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Bio-Techne will be considered Bio-Techne property.

This position requires work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States (e.g., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant work status). If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, participate in an interview, or take part in any other stage of the recruitment process, please contact hr@bio-techne.com for assistance.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), enterprise integrations, data migration, and Salesforce DevOps, along with experience leveraging Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering efficiency and code quality.
This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, building enterprise-grade applications, and taking ownership of solutions from development through production deployment.


Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, and advanced Flows.
- Build scalable applications across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Sales Cloud.
- Develop and support enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and middleware technologies such as MuleSoft.
- Support complex data migrations, including ETL/ELT processes, data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
- Implement Salesforce development best practices, including governor limits, bulkification, asynchronous processing, and performance optimization.
- Support Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management.
- Leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and technical documentation while maintaining code quality.
- Collaborate with technical leads, architects, product owners, and QA teams to deliver reliable enterprise solutions.
- Participate in code reviews, unit testing, troubleshooting, and technical design discussions.
- Ensure compliance with Salesforce security, data governance, and platform development standards.


Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience delivering complex, production-grade solutions.
- Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and SOQL/SOSL.
- Solid understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, bulkification, and asynchronous processing.
- Experience developing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, CDC, or middleware platforms.
- Hands-on experience with data migration, ETL/ELT, data transformation, and validation processes.
- Experience with Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment best practices.
- Development experience with Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
- Active use of Generative AI or AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, Devin, or similar technologies.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
- Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required.


Preferred Qualifications

- Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
- Experience with Salesforce Einstein AI, Agentforce, or Data Cloud.
- Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, MuleSoft, or other enterprise applications.
- Background in regulated industries, utilities, energy, or enterprise data governance.
- Experience with Agentic AI development tools and AI-enabled engineering workflows.
- Experience with multi-org Salesforce environments and enterprise release management.
- Integration Architecture Designer or Data Architecture Designer certification.


Interested in Applying?
If you're a hands-on Salesforce Developer passionate about enterprise integrations, modern development practices, and AI-enabled engineering, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today to learn more about this opportunity!

descriptionHtml:
Your Job

Georgia-Pacific is seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to design, build, integrate, and sustain scalable Salesforce solutions that create long-term value for our businesses and customers. This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership and partners with product owners, architects, administrators, analysts, and delivery teams to translate business outcomes into secure, supportable platform capabilities.

Our Team

This position is part of the Georgia-Pacific Building Products IT team. The team delivers and supports connected customer, sales, service, commerce, marketing, and experience capabilities across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including SAP and Middleware technologies. The Senior Salesforce Developer will help establish engineering practices, improve platform reliability, and guide delivery across onshore and offshore resources.

What You Will Do

  • Own the technical design and hands-on development of Salesforce capabilities using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, platform events, APIs, and other appropriate declarative and programmatic tools.
  • Translate user stories and business requirements into scalable technical designs, balancing configuration and custom code while considering security, performance, maintainability, platform limits, and user experience.
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST and SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, SAP CPI, event-driven patterns, and secure authentication approaches.
  • Lead technical delivery through estimation, solution design, code reviews, unit and system testing, defect resolution, release planning, and production deployment across the Salesforce development lifecycle.
  • Create and maintain automated test classes, reusable components, coding standards, technical specifications, data models, data dictionaries, runbooks, and support documentation.
  • Apply secure development practices, including sharing enforcement, object- and field-level access controls, permission-based design, Lightning Web Security, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities.
  • Design solutions for large data volumes, bulk processing, asynchronous workloads, error handling, observability, and operational support.
  • Partner with Salesforce administrators, architects, product owners, business analysts, quality engineering, cybersecurity, and developers for connected systems to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Support and improve DevOps and release-management practices, including source control, automated validation, environment management, deployment readiness, and post-release monitoring.
  • Provide technical guidance to development teams, help resolve complex production issues, and identify opportunities to modernize existing code and reduce technical debt.


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Experience developing and implementing Salesforce solutions with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flow, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Experience designing, building, and supporting integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, middleware, or event-driven integration patterns.
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests, debugging complex issues, performing code reviews, and applying Salesforce coding and security practices.
  • Experience translating technical or functional requirements into solution designs and technical specifications for delivery teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience using source control and deployment or DevOps practices to promote Salesforce configuration and code through multiple environments.


What Will Put You Ahead

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification; Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder, with Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, B2B Commerce, or Marketing Cloud in a multi-cloud enterprise environment.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP ERP or S/4HANA through MuleSoft, SAP CPI, or comparable integration platforms.
  • Experience with large data volumes, data migration, bulkification, asynchronous Apex, platform events, and enterprise monitoring or observability.
  • Experience coordinating technical delivery across onshore and offshore development teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.


At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company and a leading manufacturer of bath tissue, paper towels, paper-based packaging, cellulose, specialty fibers, building products and much more, Georgia-Pacific works to meet evolving needs of customers worldwide with quality products. In addition to the products we make, we operate one of the largest recycling businesses. Our more than 30,000 employees in over 150 locations are empowered to innovate every day and make everyday products even better.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. descriptionHtml:
About Slalom’s Enterprise Capability

At the heart of Slalom’s Enterprise Capability is a bold ambition: to design and deliver intelligent, human-centered business applications that empower organizations to serve their customers with acceleration, agility, precision, and purpose.

 

We partner with leading platforms—Salesforce, ServiceNow, Adobe, Anaplan, Workday, Contentful, Boomi, Workato and more—to build scalable, end-to-end solutions that unify data, streamline operations, and unlock actionable insights. Our work powers everything from smarter CRM experiences and next-gen commerce sites to resilient case management systems and optimized workforce planning.

But we're not just technologists—we’re strategic enablers. Whether helping a client modernize their infrastructure, integrate mission-critical functions, or activate AI-powered innovation, we connect strategy to execution in ways that drive measurable impact.

 

Here, you’ll collaborate with curious, courageous people who believe in growth through experimentation, delivering value through partnerships, and building a future where technology works quietly in service of extraordinary outcomes.

 
Job Title: Salesforce - Developer  
 
You are a Salesforce Developer with experience solving complex problems on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce developer you have knowledge of the technical domains of Salesforce including the various cloud platforms, programmatic development, declarative solutioning and integrations. You are passionate about building hands-on technical implementations. You are a self-driven individual with a "get it done" attitude and a passion to solve complex business and technology problems.  
 
Responsibilities: 

  • Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that bestleveragethe Salesforce platform and products 
  • Participate in technical design sessions; develop technical solution documentation aligned with the business objectives 
  • Develop, test, and document custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation 
  • Utilize AI-driven accelerated engineering framework todeliverhigh productivity during project implementations
  • Develop custom solutions and interfaces on top of the Salesforce platform 
  • Execute test plans to ensure quality delivery 
  • Follow coding standards andparticipatein code reviews during projects to ensureappropriate designpatterns are followed 
  • Provide estimates and work breakdown structures for assigned tasks 
  • Absorb new product and technical capabilities from Salesforce during new product releases and acquisitions 

Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years Salesforce platform experience 
  • Proven ability to develop andoptimizeintegrated business processes across disparate systems 
  • Understanding of the Salesforce platform including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud,ExperienceCloudand common AppExchange solutions 
  • Development experience using Apex, Triggers, Batch Apex, integrations, and other programmatic solutions on the Salesforce platform (Add LWC, JavaScript and Salesforce Flows soften experience) 
  • Configuration experience using the Salesforce point-and-click application interface
  • Ability to perform automated testing and write unit tests 
  • Understanding of E2E lifecycle of Salesforce development collaborating with multiple engineers 
  • Knowledge of and experience using AI-enabled engineering approaches for enhancing Salesforce platform implementation
  • Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Metadata, etc.) 
  • Front-end development experience with Lightning Web Components 
  • Knowledge of integrations, 3rd party integration tools, ETL with Salesforce 
  • Knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, databasedesignand software development lifecycle 
  • Experience in Agile Methodology 
  • Experience and exposure in Einstein and Salesforce AI product capabilities 
  • Experience in CI/CD Salesforce services and processes 
  • Problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally either on a team or as an individual contributor 
  • Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire 
  • Excellent client-facing written, presentation and verbal communications skills

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 

 

Compensation and Benefits

Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.

 

Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: 

East Bay, San Francisco, Silicon Valley:

Consultant: $126,000-$154,000

Senior Consultant: $154,000–$189,000

San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Seattle, Boston, Houston, New Jersey, New York City, Washington DC, Westchester:

Consultant: $115,000-$141,000

Senior Consultant: $141,000–$173,000

All other locations:

Consultant: $106,000-$129,000

Senior Consultant: $130,000–$159,000


 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. We will accept applicants until 10/31, or until the position is filled.


We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.

 

EEO and Accommodations

Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer specializing in Quote-to-Cash to build and evolve the systems behind how we sell, contract, and provision customers. You’ll write production code, develop integrations, and improve the reliability of our existing workflows while delivering changes that support new products, commercial models, and business growth.

As part of GTM Engineering, you’ll partner with Sales Finance, Sales, and Product & Engineering to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Your work will span recurring CPQ defects, customer provisioning, acquisition-related contracting changes, and the evolution of our Quote-to-Cash architecture.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain Quote-to-Cash solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce Flow, choosing code or configuration based on the problem.
  • Build and extend CPQ capabilities for product launches, pricing, bundling, discount approvals, subscriptions, amendments, and renewals.
  • Diagnose complex quoting, contracting, order, and entitlement defects; trace failures through code, data, and integrations; and implement root-cause fixes with regression tests.
  • Partner directly with Sales Finance and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess tradeoffs, estimate effort, and own delivery from technical design through production validation.
  • Develop contract and subscription data models that support acquisition requirements, multiple contracts per customer, and flexible contract start dates.
  • Partner with EPD Growth to resolve provisioning discrepancies and build reliable provisioning and deprovisioning workflows so customer access matches purchased entitlements.
  • Write bulk-safe, maintainable code with meaningful automated tests; participate in code reviews and deliver changes through version control and the team’s release process.
  • Reduce recurring operational work through automation, improved validation, and targeted fixes that prevent repeat deal escalations and manual data corrections.
  • Build and maintain APIs and integrations connecting Salesforce with contracting, billing, and product-provisioning systems, including error handling, retries, and reconciliation.
  • Document technical designs, data flows, and operational behavior; partner with business users on acceptance testing and validate downstream outcomes after release.
  • Contribute to Quote-to-Cash transformation, including CPQ migration, new currencies and commercial models, and integration of acquired products.
  • Evaluate changes to CPQ and related Salesforce capabilities and recommend improvements that simplify the architecture and reduce ongoing maintenance.

Your First Six Months of Impact

  • Independently deliver Quote-to-Cash enhancements and resolve complex defects, with tested changes and clear ownership of downstream outcomes.
  • Identify recurring quoting and contracting problems, establish a baseline for repeat escalations, and ship fixes that reduce manual intervention.
  • Partner with EPD Growth to address priority provisioning failure modes and improve visibility into entitlement mismatches and failed handoffs.
  • Deliver an agreed milestone on the Quote-to-Cash roadmap, such as acquisition-related contracting, provisioning automation, or CPQ migration readiness.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including production ownership of Salesforce CPQ and Quote-to-Cash solutions.
  • Deep understanding of CPQ product configuration, pricing rules, quote calculations, subscriptions, amendments, renewals, and the quote-to-contract-to-order lifecycle.
  • Strong Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce Flow skills, with experience building bulk-safe solutions, asynchronous processing, and meaningful automated tests.
  • Experience designing and debugging API integrations, including authentication, error handling, retries, and data consistency across connected systems.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into technical designs and explain tradeoffs to Sales, Finance, and engineering partners.
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and regression testing, with evidence of independently shipping and supporting reliable production changes.
  • A track record of tracing complex defects to root cause and improving existing systems; a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II or CPQ credentials, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Experience with SaaS billing, revenue processes, entitlements, customer provisioning, or acquisition-related systems integration.
  • Experience migrating CPQ platforms or implementing multi-contract architectures, multicurrency selling, or flexible subscription terms.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve engineering productivity and reduce recurring Quote-to-Cash support work.

Why This Role

Your work will directly shape how Amplitude brings products to market and delivers purchased capabilities to customers. You’ll combine hands-on development with ownership of complex Quote-to-Cash problems, reducing the maintenance burden on the team and helping deliver the next generation of our commercial systems.

Equal Employment Opportunity and Diversity Statement

We are committed to equal employment opportunity in both principle and as a matter of policy. We will recruit, hire, train, promote, compensate and provide benefits to all applicants and employees without regard to ancestry, sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, religion, religious creed, mental and/or physical disability, medical condition, military and/or veteran’s status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all recruiting, hiring, promotions, upgrades, layoffs, compensation, benefits, terminations and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. The firm complies fully with all federal, state and local equal employment opportunity laws.

Our Values

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.
  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.
  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.
  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some Of Our Benefit Programs Include

  • Excellent M edical, D ental and V ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, Dental, Vision on select plans
  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually
  • Flexible time off, p aid holidays, and more
  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more
  • Excellent Parental benefits including : 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support
  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

Other Fun Facts About Amplitude

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.
  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.
  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.
  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.
  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.
  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.
  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Agentforce Developer to join our team supporting a large-scale enterprise Salesforce environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on Salesforce development experience along with exposure to Salesforce Agentforce and AI capabilities, including Einstein Bots, Prediction Builder, and Next Best Action.

This role will focus on designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting Salesforce solutions while collaborating closely with both onshore and offshore teams in an Agile delivery environment

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Hartford - CT. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and implement scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform.
  • Develop custom Salesforce functionality using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, and Aura Components.
  • Build and enhance AI-enabled Salesforce solutions leveraging Agentforce, Einstein Bots, Prediction Builder, and Next Best Action.
  • Troubleshoot complex Salesforce issues using platform logs, debugging, and monitoring tools.
  • Perform application performance analysis and tuning to ensure scalable and reliable solutions.
  • Follow Salesforce architecture, development standards, security guidelines, and platform best practices.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, code reviews, testing, and production releases.
  • Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and offshore development/support teams.
  • Support Salesforce deployment and release management activities using CI/CD and automation tools.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including LWC, Apex, and Aura.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture and best practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce AI tools, including Agentforce, Einstein Bots, Prediction Builder, and Next Best Action.
  • Proficiency in debugging and performance tuning using Salesforce logs and monitoring tools.
  • Experience working in Agile environments; SAFe methodology experience is preferred.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in an onshore/offshore support model and collaborating with offshore teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Force.com IDE, Apex Data Loader, ANT, Copado, and AutoRABIT.
  • Experience with GitHub, RTC, and automation tools.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $95,00– $115,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Develop and configure Salesforce platform features supporting the enlisted mission and special mission set workflows within a SAFe agile delivery structure
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies and PI planning
  • Deliver production-ready code in an IL4 Salesforce environment
  • Contribute to a shared codebase across 8 feature teams serving 28,000 end users.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with a Secret Clearance or Public Trust - Tier 2 or the ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $125,000 to $155,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

The Business Systems team is responsible for building and improving the many systems that enables Anduril to accomplish its mission. Anduril’s supply chain, accounting, sales & growth, engineering, modeling & simulation, field maintenance, manufacturing, and many more teams rely on the technology built and maintained by our team. We work across the company to ensure we have the tools and capabilities necessary for mission success.

We are looking for a Salesforce Software Developer to join our team as we build out a robust suite of products and functionality to help our rapidly growing Growth, Business Development, Legal, Investor Relations, Deployment Operations, and other teams who all use Salesforce as their “home base”. If you are passionate about build in Salesforce and want to join the most mission-oriented and passionate group of coworkers you’ll ever meet, this job is for you!

What You'll Do

  • Partner with the Salesforce Product Manager to ensure that the Salesforce platform is fully aligned with business objectives by maximizing the platforms capabilities and architecting scalable solutions.
  • Design and customize Salesforce solutions on Salesforce Government Cloud Plus, ensuring they align with industry best practices and meet the organization's objectives.
  • Support CRMA and configure new analytics dashboards, manage and create data recipes as needed.
  • Collaborate with developers to implement custom solutions when necessary, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, configurations, and customizations.
  • Automate business processes using Salesforce automation tools such as Process Builder, Formulas, Flow, Assignment Rules, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Email and Slack alerts.
  • Build integrations between Salesforce and external applications using REST, SOAP APIs, oAuth, SSO.
  • Partner with internal integration teams as needed when Salesforce needs to consume or push data to other internal platforms (i.e.; ERP)
  • Migrate changes from development/testing environments to production and conduct required smoke testing as needed.
  • Provide support to end-users, fostering a culture of self-sufficiency and user adoption.
  • Adhere to defined coding standards, maintain code documentation and develop well-structured, maintainable/scalable and easy to understand code.
  • Determine when Apex code is needed to meet a capability end goal, always striving to seek out low code/no code options when realistic.
  • Perform data updates / migration using Data Loader as needed.
  • Interface with the Salesforce data backup and recovery tool as needed.
  • Stay current with new Salesforce technologies, platform enhancements, releases, industry trends, implement best practices and engaging in regular Salesforce release readiness activities.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of total IT experience with at least 6+ years of Salesforce platform development experience
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience.
  • Strong Salesforce customization and configuration experience, preferably in Sales Cloud. Experience in Government Cloud a preferred.
  • Experience with CRMA tools and methodologies (CRM Analytics - formerly known as Tableau CRM, Einstein Analytics).
  • Hands on development experience using Salesforce configuration and customizations including Apex, Triggers, Scheduled and Batch classes, Process Builder, Formulas, Flow, Approval Processes, Validation and Assignment Rules etc.
  • Development experience in UI technologies like Bootstrap, Lightening Design System (LDS), Lightening Components Development, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML/CSS
  • Proven integration experience using integration techniques - REST, SOAP APIs, oAuth and SSO
  • Experienced in Standard/Custom Object creation and relationships
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle and DevOps tools (i.e.; JIRA, etc.)
  • A thorough understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery/Deployment and tools such as GitHub actions.
  • Proven ability to assess the impact of new requirements on SFDC and all upstream and downstream applications, flows and processes.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Exceptional organizational and communication skills (both written and oral).
  • Strong preference for Salesforce developer certifications - Certified Platform Developer I, and Certified Platform Developer II a plus.
  • Aerospace and Defense industry experience a major plus.
  • Bonus points for NetSuite integrations experience and solution architect experience.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Business Systems team is responsible for building and improving the many systems that enables Anduril to accomplish its mission. Anduril’s supply chain, accounting, sales & growth, engineering, modeling & simulation, field maintenance, manufacturing, and many more teams rely on the technology built and maintained by our team. We work across the company to ensure we have the tools and capabilities necessary for mission success.

We are looking for a Salesforce Software Developer to join our team as we build out a robust suite of products and functionality to help our rapidly growing Growth, Business Development, Legal, Investor Relations, Deployment Operations, and other teams who all use Salesforce as their “home base”. If you are passionate about build in Salesforce and want to join the most mission-oriented and passionate group of coworkers you’ll ever meet, this job is for you!

What You'll Do



- Partner with the Salesforce Product Manager to ensure that the Salesforce platform is fully aligned with business objectives by maximizing the platforms capabilities and architecting scalable solutions.
- Design and customize Salesforce solutions on Salesforce Government Cloud Plus, ensuring they align with industry best practices and meet the organization's objectives.
- Support CRMA and configure new analytics dashboards, manage and create data recipes as needed.
- Collaborate with developers to implement custom solutions when necessary, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, configurations, and customizations.
- Automate business processes using Salesforce automation tools such as Process Builder, Formulas, Flow, Assignment Rules, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Email and Slack alerts.
- Build integrations between Salesforce and external applications using REST, SOAP APIs, oAuth, SSO.
- Partner with internal integration teams as needed when Salesforce needs to consume or push data to other internal platforms (i.e.; ERP)
- Migrate changes from development/testing environments to production and conduct required smoke testing as needed.
- Provide support to end-users, fostering a culture of self-sufficiency and user adoption.
- Adhere to defined coding standards, maintain code documentation and develop well-structured, maintainable/scalable and easy to understand code.
- Determine when Apex code is needed to meet a capability end goal, always striving to seek out low code/no code options when realistic.
- Perform data updates / migration using Data Loader as needed.
- Interface with the Salesforce data backup and recovery tool as needed.
- Stay current with new Salesforce technologies, platform enhancements, releases, industry trends, implement best practices and engaging in regular Salesforce release readiness activities.

Required Qualifications



- 8+ years of total IT experience with at least 6+ years of Salesforce platform development experience
- Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience.
- Strong Salesforce customization and configuration experience, preferably in Sales Cloud. Experience in Government Cloud a preferred.
- Experience with CRMA tools and methodologies (CRM Analytics - formerly known as Tableau CRM, Einstein Analytics).
- Hands on development experience using Salesforce configuration and customizations including Apex, Triggers, Scheduled and Batch classes, Process Builder, Formulas, Flow, Approval Processes, Validation and Assignment Rules etc.
- Development experience in UI technologies like Bootstrap, Lightening Design System (LDS), Lightening Components Development, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML/CSS
- Proven integration experience using integration techniques - REST, SOAP APIs, oAuth and SSO
- Experienced in Standard/Custom Object creation and relationships
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
- Knowledge of software development lifecycle and DevOps tools (i.e.; JIRA, etc.)
- A thorough understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery/Deployment and tools such as GitHub actions.
- Proven ability to assess the impact of new requirements on SFDC and all upstream and downstream applications, flows and processes.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
- Exceptional organizational and communication skills (both written and oral).
- Strong preference for Salesforce developer certifications - Certified Platform Developer I, and Certified Platform Developer II a plus.
- Aerospace and Defense industry experience a major plus.
- Bonus points for NetSuite integrations experience and solution architect experience.
- Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

$220,000—$292,000 USD

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Wintrust provides community and commercial banking, specialty finance and wealth management services through its 16 bank charters and nine non-bank businesses. We serve clients in all 50 states with more than 200 branch banking locations in Illinois, southwestern Florida, northwestern Indiana, west Michigan and southern Wisconsin and commercial banking offices in Chicago, Denver, Milwaukee, Grand Rapids, Mich., and in key branch banking locations throughout Illinois. Our people are the heart of our business and we are proud to rank consistently as a top place to work. Wintrust is a $66 billion financial institution based in Rosemont, Illinois, and listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “WTFC.”

Why join us?

  • An award-winning culture! We are rated a Top Workplace by the Chicago Tribune (past 12 years) and Employee Recommended award by the Globe & Mail (past 6 years)
  • Competitive pay and discretionary or incentive bonus eligible
  • Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, a 401k plan with a generous company match and tuition reimbursement to name a few
  • Promote from within culture

Why join this team?

  • This position has the opportunity to interface with and have a positive impact on multiple areas of Wintrust's business
  • We hold ourselves accountable to high standards, share wins, operate ethically, and have fun

Position Overview

The Senior Salesforce Engineer is a key technical resource responsible for the design, architecture, development, and maintenance of applications, including requirements analysis, customizations, database changes, screen changes, security definition, and workflow. This role converts system requirements into logical program designs, code modules, and stable application systems.

This is a senior-level position that works with a team of technical resources, managers, and engineers to produce innovative solutions. The Senior Salesforce developer collaborates with business analysts and delivery teams in a highly collaborative environment to define product features, estimates and delivers solutions. This person must be able to create and communicate innovative solutions to business issues and processes leveraging their knowledge of the software platform, responsible for assigning resources to specific application design and development tasks.

This is a fully remote position. Please note that candidates who advance to the final stage of our interview process will be required to attend an in-person interview.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce developer, building and supporting solutions across Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, and nCino through custom development, configuration, integrations, and ongoing platform enhancements.
  • Lead technical development, implementation, administration, and support of the Salesforce CRM platform. Participate in the development and deployment of new features to support business initiatives, playing a leading role in the design of new/improved interfaces and functions within the platform
  • Collaborate with other Software Engineers to write and review technical specifications as required, meeting the objectives of functional specifications. Specify, identify specific interfaces, methods, parameters, procedures or functions as required
  • Provide advanced code review along with pair programming sessions
  • Provide production support for Salesforce/portals including after-hours support when necessary
  • Participate in the full SDLC with focus on delivery

Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience working with Salesforce CRM
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting solutions within the nCino Bank Operating System (nCino platform) in a banking or financial services environment.
  • Ability to thrive in an environment where change is constant, adjusting to constantly evolving requirements and assigned tasks
  • Proficiency in a variety of programming related technologies and tools including:
  • APEX, AutoRabbit, Git, Mulesoft, Object Orientated design, SOQL/SOSL, Visual Studio Code
  • Effective communicator

Our people are the heart of our business and we are proud to rank consistently as a top place to work. Wintrust is a $66 billion financial institution based in Rosemont, Illinois, and listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “WTFC.”

- An award-winning culture! We are rated a Top Workplace by the Chicago Tribune (past 12 years) and Employee Recommended award by the Globe & Mail (past 6 years)
- Competitive pay and discretionary or incentive bonus eligible
- Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, a 401k plan with a generous company match and tuition reimbursement to name a few
- Promote from within culture

Why join this team? 



- This position has the opportunity to interface with and have a positive impact on multiple areas of Wintrust's business
- We hold ourselves accountable to high standards, share wins, operate ethically, and have fun

Position Overview

The Senior Salesforce Engineer is a key technical resource responsible for the design, architecture, development, and maintenance of applications, including requirements analysis, customizations, database changes, screen changes, security definition, and workflow. This role converts system requirements into logical program designs, code modules, and stable application systems.

This is a senior-level position that works with a team of technical resources, managers, and engineers to produce innovative solutions. The Senior Salesforce developer collaborates with business analysts and delivery teams in a highly collaborative environment to define product features, estimates and delivers solutions. This person must be able to create and communicate innovative solutions to business issues and processes leveraging their knowledge of the software platform, responsible for assigning resources to specific application design and development tasks.

This is a fully remote position. Please note that candidates who advance to the final stage of our interview process will be required to attend an in-person interview.

What You’ll Do



- Serve as a hands-on Salesforce developer, building and supporting solutions across Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, and nCino through custom development, configuration, integrations, and ongoing platform enhancements. 
- Lead technical development, implementation, administration, and support of the Salesforce CRM platform. Participate in the development and deployment of new features to support business initiatives, playing a leading role in the design of new/improved interfaces and functions within the platform
- Collaborate with other Software Engineers to write and review technical specifications as required, meeting the objectives of functional specifications. Specify, identify specific interfaces, methods, parameters, procedures or functions as required
- Provide advanced code review along with pair programming sessions
- Provide production support for Salesforce/portals including after-hours support when necessary
- Participate in the full SDLC with focus on delivery

Qualifications



- 7+ years experience working with Salesforce CRM
- Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification
- Experience designing, developing, and supporting solutions within the nCino Bank Operating System (nCino platform) in a banking or financial services environment.
- Ability to thrive in an environment where change is constant, adjusting to constantly evolving requirements and assigned tasks
- Proficiency in a variety of programming related technologies and tools including:
- APEX, AutoRabbit, Git, Mulesoft, Object Orientated design, SOQL/SOSL, Visual Studio Code
- Effective communicator

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Possess 2-5 years of Salesforce development experience to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Implement process automations, build scalable custom solutions, and collaborate with team members to interpret and translate business requirements into technical capabilities.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Salesforce security and object model setup.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with a Clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000 to $120,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
