descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview

The Salesforce Developer owns Fullbay’s Salesforce platform end to end, from day-to-day administration and configuration through custom Apex and Lightning Web Component development. This role determines when a requirement calls for declarative configuration and when it calls for code, then builds the solution directly. Working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations stakeholders across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and the Nue CPQ platform and its integrations with QuickBooks and Stripe, the Salesforce Developer is accountable for both the daily health of the platform and its long-term technical architecture.

Right Wrench For The Job

The right wrench for this job enjoys the full spectrum of Salesforce work, from resolving a user’s support request in the morning to delivering a custom Apex integration in the afternoon. This individual takes ownership of both the daily health of the platform and its long-term architecture, builds solutions that scale, and partners with Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand the business need before building.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Platform Ownership & Administration
    • Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and health of the Salesforce platform across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and Nue CPQ
    • Debug and resolve production issues in a timely manner across both configuration and code
    • Manage sandbox environments and CI/CD / change-set deployment processes
  • Development & Engineering
    • Design and develop custom Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, and scheduled jobs
    • Build and maintain Lightning Web Components (LWC) for custom UI experiences
    • Develop and maintain REST/SOAP API integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems (QuickBooks, Stripe, Nue CPQ)
    • Write clean, well-documented, testable code with a minimum of 85% code coverage
    • Determine whether a given requirement is best solved with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) or custom code, and build accordingly
  • Project Delivery & Architecture
    • Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions
    • Build and deploy Flows, validation rules, custom objects, fields, and page layouts
    • Ensure solutions are scalable, governor-limit compliant, and built for long-term maintainability
    • Document configurations, technical designs, data models, and integration specifications for ongoing maintainability
    • Participate in sprint planning and project intake prioritization with RevOps leadership
  • Consulting & Strategy
    • Proactively identify and recommend improvements to existing processes and data models
    • Partner with Revenue Operations to align Salesforce capabilities to business goals
    • Stay current on Salesforce releases, Einstein AI features, developer tools, and platform updates; evaluate and implement relevant new functionality
  • General
    • Adheres to all confidentiality, compliance, and company standards
    • Performs other duties as assigned
Minimum Education & Work Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration / development experience, including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce data model design
  • 1 year of AI experience and switching processes over to using AI
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce Flow (Screen Flows, Record-Triggered Flows, and Scheduled Flows)
  • Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC) and an understanding of the Lightning component framework
  • Experience with Sales Cloud, including opportunity management, lead routing, and forecasting
  • Experience building and maintaining REST or SOAP API integrations
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce governor limits, bulkification, and asynchronous processing patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects end to end, from requirements through deployment
  • At least 2 active Salesforce certifications spanning both the administrator and developer tracks, with preference for:
    • Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
    • Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
    • Salesforce Certified Integration Architecture Designer
    • Agentforce Specialist
  • Preferred qualifications
    • Experience with CPQ tools (Nue, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) and order-to-cash / quote-to-cash workflows
    • Familiarity with QuickBooks and/or Stripe integrations and APIs
    • Experience with Einstein AI features, including Einstein Copilot, Lead Scoring, or Opportunity Insights
    • Knowledge of Agentforce or generative AI tooling within the Salesforce ecosystem
    • Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX), scratch orgs, and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset)
    • Exposure to platform events, Change Data Capture (CDC), or the Salesforce streaming API
    • Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business model
Key Skills And Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • Sound judgment in choosing between declarative configuration and custom code, and the ability to build either
  • Strong requirements-gathering and project management skills, from intake through deployment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing production issues across configuration and code
  • Commitment to clean, documented, testable, and maintainable work
  • Consultative mindset, with the initiative to recommend improvements to existing processes and data models

Physical Demands And Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Develop and configure Salesforce platform features supporting the enlisted mission and special mission set workflows within a SAFe agile delivery structure
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies and PI planning
  • Deliver production-ready code in an IL4 Salesforce environment
  • Contribute to a shared codebase across 8 feature teams serving 28,000 end users.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with an Active Secret Clearance
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000 to $120,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Salesforce Developer Lead to provide technical leadership, solution design oversight, and hands-on development expertise for a large-scale federal healthcare modernization initiative. This role will lead Salesforce development teams responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and mission-critical solutions that support complex business operations and enterprise transformation efforts.

The Senior Salesforce Developer Lead will serve as the primary technical authority for Salesforce development activities, partnering closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Business Analysts, DevSecOps teams, and program leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, enhancement, and deployment of enterprise Salesforce solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Salesforce developers and technical teams.
  • Architect and develop scalable solutions using Salesforce Lightning, Apex, and modern development frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex requirements into technical solutions.
  • Establish and enforce development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with security, performance, and maintainability standards.
  • Design and develop complex integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts and resolve highly complex production issues.
  • Support platform modernization, performance optimization, and technical debt reduction initiatives.
  • Partner with Solution Architects to implement enterprise architecture strategies and roadmaps.
  • Guide Agile development teams through sprint planning, design sessions, and release activities.
  • Collaborate with QA teams to ensure comprehensive testing and delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Support DevOps and CI/CD automation initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with federal security, privacy, accessibility, and governance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of software development experience.
  • At least 7 years of Salesforce development experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years leading Salesforce development teams within large enterprise environments.
  • Extensive experience developing custom Salesforce applications and integrations.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing scalable enterprise solutions.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture principles and secure coding practices.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevSecOps environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required federal background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal healthcare, health IT, or government modernization initiatives.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification.
  • Salesforce Application Architect Certification preferred.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce Government Cloud implementations.
  • Experience leading distributed development teams.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Security Requirements

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain any required federal background investigation or VA clearance.
  • S. Citizenship required.
  • Disclaimer: This position is contingent upon ELYON’s receipt of contract award, Government acceptance of the proposed candidate, completion of required onboarding, and continued contract funding.**

Benefits

Paid sick leave, Medical/Dental (optional), 401 (k) Retirement Plan (optional), Employer Paid Life Insurance, Employer Paid Short Term Disability, Optional Life Insurance.

ELYON International, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

descriptionHtml:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Senior Manager, GTM Systems

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $160,000 to $190,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer to join our Revenue Operations team and help us build, scale, and integrate the systems that power Huntress’s commercial engine. Our Salesforce platform underpins quoting, renewals, partner engagement, and integrations across our internal subscription and billing platform and a growing ecosystem of business applications.

In this role, you will partner closely with our Senior Salesforce Technical Architect to design and deliver high-impact features with a heavy emphasis on CPQ, integration development, and an upcoming migration of point-to-point integrations to a centralized iPaaS platform (Workato or Celigo). You will also contribute to an AI-augmented development culture, actively using LLM tools to accelerate your own workflows and building AI-integrated features within Salesforce. This is hands-on, high-velocity work on systems that

matter.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions with a primary focus on CPQ workflows like quoting, custom pricing logic, renewals, and subscription lifecycle management.
  • Execute the hands-on migration of existing Salesforce integrations to a centralized iPaaS platform like Workato or Celigo, building reusable components and error-handling patterns.
  • Build and maintain a reliable integration layer connecting Salesforce to our internal subscription platform, CRM applications, and third-party systems.
  • Partner with the Technical Architect to evaluate platform trade-offs, maintain environment stability, and help define integration best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales teams to support strategic initiatives like multi-product quoting and partner channel workflows.
  • Use AI and LLM tools as part of your daily engineering workflow for troubleshooting, code generation, and rapid problem-solving.
  • Participate in code reviews, raise technical standards, and deliver consistently within sprint cycles with clear communication on scope and blockers.

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 7+ years of Salesforce development experience with a strong and demonstrable focus on Salesforce CPQ.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ custom pricing logic, including Quote Calculator Plugin development in JavaScript.
  • Practical experience building and deploying components on one or more enterprise iPaaS platforms like Workato, Celigo, MuleSoft, or Boomi.
  • Mastery of Apex, JavaScript, CSS, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce Flows.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce APIs and modern event-driven integration patterns.
  • Advanced fluency with AI or LLM tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot as active accelerators in your daily engineering workflow.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical business partners and deliver features end-to-end in an Agile environment.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
  • 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
  • Life and Disability insurance plans
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
  • Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance
  • $75 USD/month digital reimbursement
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

descriptionHtml:
Salesforce Developer | Full-time | New York City


About the client

My client is one of the largest philanthropies in the world, headquartered in Manhattan. Their programs reach cities and countries worldwide, with work in public health, the environment, education and government innovation. The technology team is small and senior, and engineers work directly with leadership.


The role

They’re hiring a full-time Salesforce Engineer to own their Salesforce platform. You’ll be the go-to person when the business needs something built or connected. Most of your time goes to hands-on development and integrations. The rest goes to working with program and grants teams and turning their requests into solutions that hold up.

What you’ll work on

  • Building and maintaining custom functionality in Apex, Lightning Web Components and Flows
  • Integrating Salesforce with internal systems and data platforms through REST and SOAP APIs
  • Designing data models, objects and security (permission sets, sharing rules) that scale as the org grows
  • Running releases: sandboxes, version control, CI/CD and deployments
  • Cleaning up technical debt and older automation
  • Gathering requirements from business stakeholders and setting priorities with them


What you bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development
  • Strong Apex and LWC, including writing real test coverage and working within governor limits
  • Integration experience with APIs and middleware such as MuleSoft
  • Salesforce DX, Git and a working CI/CD pipeline
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals. This team hires engineers first, so expect questions on code quality and design.
  • Clear communication with non-technical people


Nice to have

  • Nonprofit Cloud, NPSP or grants management experience
  • Platform Developer I or II, or Application Architect certification
  • Experience Cloud or Data Cloud
  • Some Python or data warehouse exposure

Position: Salesforce Development Engineer & Systems Engineer

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and support scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business, security, integration, and operational requirements.
  • Lead development efforts across Salesforce platforms, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Experience Cloud, Agentforce, and DealCloud.
  • Develop Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical prototypes to evaluate new Salesforce capabilities, Agentforce use cases, AI-driven solutions, and integration patterns.
  • Provide technical leadership, perform code reviews, and mentor junior developers.
  • Drive solution architecture, system integrations, data modeling, and application performance optimization.
  • Promote Salesforce best practices, leveraging declarative capabilities before custom development where appropriate.
  • Support Agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment automation.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to deliver high-quality, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Support onboarding and ongoing oversight of vendor-provided applications, helping ensure alignment with onboarding, security, and operational requirements and coordinating required evidence or artifacts.

  • Coordinate operational workflows, including incident triage, routine maintenance, releases, and enhancement intake, track risks, dependencies, and remediation through closure.
  • Communicate status, impact, and next steps to stakeholders in a clear, timely manner, adapting technical details to the audience

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience, with 5-7 years of Salesforce development experience with strong expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Triggers, APIs, and Salesforce security architecture.

  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Proven ability to lead development teams and deliver complex enterprise Salesforce solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer, Application Architect, System Architect, FSC, or AI/Agentforce certifications
  • Experience developing POCs, evaluating emerging Salesforce features, and providing architecture recommendations based on business and technical feasibility.

Preferred Experience

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Develop and configure Salesforce platform features supporting the enlisted mission and special mission set workflows within a SAFe agile delivery structure
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies and PI planning
  • Deliver production-ready code in an IL4 Salesforce environment
  • Contribute to a shared codebase across 8 feature teams serving 28,000 end users.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce, Salesforce.com APEX Development, Salesforce.com Flow, Salesforce.com, Lightning Components
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with an Active Secret Clearance
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000 to $120,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Your Opportunity as the Lead Salesforce Developer

The Smucker Information Services (IS) department enables technology solutions that help our business perform, transform, and grow. The Lead Developer, IS AFH – Salesforce CRM & Integrations, supports this mission by designing, developing, and supporting Salesforce CRM solutions and enterprise integrations that power key AFH business capabilities across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Growth Management, and Marketing. Lead technical support and development for the Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform by:

  • Lead technical efforts and manage the delivery of medium to large Salesforce projects, which may include directing other developers, contractors, and technical resources.

  • Develop solutions involving complex workflows, automation, security, and emerging Salesforce capabilities including AI.
  • Lead integration testing, performance testing, data validation, and release readiness activities while identifying opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.

  • Supporting and maintaining existing solutions:
  • Facilitate troubleshooting and resolution of complex Salesforce and integration issues, including performance, scalability, authentication, and data quality concerns.
  • Own technical support for Salesforce integrations and data synchronization processes between Salesforce and AWS-based platforms.
  • Manage Salesforce platform health, including environments, security, releases, and platform optimization.
  • Partner with Information Services teams to implement and support security protocols including SSO, MFA, SAML, OAuth, certificates, and token management.
  • Facilitate development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), technical documentation, and support knowledge repositories.

  • Implement standards and continuous improvements for source control, release management, code promotion, and DevOps practices.

  • Implement improvements to development standards, coding practices, testing approaches, change management, and deployment processes.
  • Promote reusable components, services, and integration patterns to improve efficiency and standardization.
  • Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing, and AFH business teams to identify opportunities for platform optimization, automation, and simplification.

Provide Technical Leadership For The AFH Salesforce Ecosystem By

  • Leading integrations between Salesforce, the AFH AWS Data Lake, and other business-critical platforms.
  • Supporting Salesforce capabilities related to Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Growth Management, Marketing, and external partner solutions.

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integrations across multiple technologies.
  • Experience with the entire Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience delivering assignments independently within Agile, Traditional/Waterfall, and DevOps frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, integration patterns, authentication methods (OAuth, SAML, SSO), and security best practices.
  • Ability to evaluate, articulate, estimate, and recommend technical solution approaches for complex business requirements.
  • Ability to conduct integrated testing, troubleshoot production issues, and identify balanced technical solutions.
  • Ability to coach and mentor other technical resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage work across multiple resources including contractors and external partners.
  • Ability to implement modern IT concepts including Cloud Computing, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (Partner Community)
  • Experience with Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot)
  • Salesforce certifications a plus
  • Experience with data integration and ETL tools, particularly Informatica Intelligent Cloud Service (IICS) or SnapLogic iPaaS.

  • Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Experience with Salesforce development to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with a Public Trust - Tier 2 or the ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000 to $120,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Description

Why GMF Technology?

Innovation isn’t just a talking point at GM Financial, it’s how we operate. From generative AI and cloud-native technologies to peer-led learning and hackathons, our tech teams are building real solutions that make a difference. We’re committed to AI-powered transformation, using advanced machine learning and automation to help us reimagine customer interactions and modernize operations, positioning GM Financial as a leader in digital innovation within a dynamic industry.

Join us and discover a workplace where your ideas matter, your development is prioritized, and you can truly make a global impact.

This position will be posted until filled.

Responsibilities

About The Role:

The Salesforce Developer III will be part of the Technology team providing business application solutions to enhance Servicing agents’ experiences while working to support our loan and lease customers. Day to day activities will involve building solutions on Salesforce and integrating Salesforce into a rich ecosystem of custom built applications on Azure and AWS, as well as third party solutions. This role will be helping to stand up a new instance of Salesforce, working with Salesforce resources to define how a captive lender will use their Automotive Cloud Solution and related Data Architecture. Salesforce technical skills will require knowledge and experience in custom LWC, Apex, Flows and Scheduled jobs.

The Salesforce Developer III will collaborate with key business subject matter experts and technical architects to implement and deliver amazing solutions to help our agents work in compliant and efficient ways. The Salesforce Developer II will also need to understand and promote best-in class DevOps and delivery practices including testing and monitoring. This role will also be responsible for helping to define and implement best practices in microservices and API first design integrating Salesforce into our enterprise tech landscape.

Qualifications

What makes you an ideal candidate?

Knowledge And Skills

  • Deep understanding of integrating Salesforce with a broad range of enterprise technologies across Azure and AWS
  • Be able to collaborate to define, design, develop and deliver the best Data Architecture to support our business needs balancing storage, API traffic and synchronization with other systems of record
  • Utilize technical aspects of Salesforce such as Apex triggers, classes, Flows and Scheduled jobs; as well as knowledge of Cases and Service cloud work processes
  • Be able to deliver encryption configurations, user security profiles and permissions, monitoring and disaster recovery using Own to fulfil our Cyber requirements
  • Be able to design data synchronization between Salesforce and other systems
  • Deliver outbound and inbound API integrations
  • Keep up with and evangelize best practices for implementing Salesforce solutions and integrations with enterprise systems
  • Strong communication, documentation, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with business subject matter experts, architects, developers, and product teams.

Work Experience & Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related Engineering field; and/or commensurate experience preferred
  • 4-6 years of Salesforce Experience required
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce and related Salesforce technologies such as Own

What We Offer: Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay and bonus eligibility.

Work Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work environment, 3 days a week (Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday)

Location: Arlington (AOC1), TX office.

This position is not open to agency submissions

Description

Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements that support Amazon's long-term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon's scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

The Worldwide Sustainability Salesforce Team is looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer to design, build, and integrate the Salesforce instances that support Sustainability teams across Amazon. You will work across Salesforce and AWS, and you will help set the technical direction for both.

We're building out our Salesforce instances to support Sustainability goals that reach every part of Amazon's business. In this role you will help define the long-term technical architecture for how Worldwide Sustainability uses Salesforce, AWS, and AI to improve productivity and operate more efficiently. You will use your engineering judgment and architecture experience to design and build secure, scalable products for internal customers across Amazon in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the technical architecture of the Sustainability Salesforce instances, including the data model, security and sharing model, automation strategy, and integration patterns across multiple orgs.
  • Evaluate when to build custom, configure native platform features, or adopt an AppExchange product, and recommend the right tool for each requirement.
  • Design, build, and maintain custom solutions with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and Salesforce platform APIs that hold up under large data volumes and platform governor limits.
  • Design and build integrations between Salesforce, AWS, and other internal Amazon systems, using API-based and event-driven patterns, secure authentication, and serverless services.
  • Build and operate the AWS components the platform depends on, defined as infrastructure as code, with logging, monitoring, alarms, and least-privilege access.
  • Build generative AI features into the platform on Salesforce and AWS, and use AI-assisted development tools to deliver faster without lowering quality.
  • Own the engineering lifecycle, including source control, code review, automated testing, static code analysis, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management from sandbox through production.
  • Protect platform security and data quality by enforcing object and field-level security, managing credentials and secrets, and resolving security findings.
  • Lead technical design reviews and code reviews, set development standards, and mentor developers and administrators on the team.
  • Partner with product owners, program managers, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into technical designs, estimates, and delivery plans.
  • Resolve escalated production issues across Salesforce and connected systems, find the root cause, and build mechanisms that prevent the same failure from happening again.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to use Salesforce, AWS, and AI in new ways to improve business processes, increase productivity, and support an organization scaling at a rapid pace.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
  • 2+ years of AWS experience EC2, S3, ECS, Lambdas, EventBridge, SNS, SQS, SES, CodeCommit etc. and proficiency in integration technologies (JSON, REST, SOAP, GraphQL)
  • Experience writing technical documents, project plans and progress reports to leadership and to stakeholders
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Experience Cloud

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with distributed systems at scale
  • 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect or equivalent experience

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Possess 2-5 years of Salesforce development experience to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Implementing process automations, building scalable custom solutions, and collaborating with team members to interpret and translate business requirements into technical capabilities.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Salesforce security and object model setup.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Experience with Salesforce development to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be a US Citizen U.S. with a Public Trust - Tier 2 or the ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000 to $120,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Drive the strategic evolution of Everpure’s enterprise quote-to-cash ecosystem as a Senior Salesforce Developer. In this role, you will architect, build, and optimize complex Salesforce and Zuora Billing/CPQ solutions that accelerate our revenue operations and eliminate business bottlenecks. You will solve variable technical challenges, design robust APIs, and partner directly with cross-functional leaders in Finance, Sales Operations, and IT to deliver seamless subscription and billing processes.

What You'll Do

  • Architect Scalable Quote-to-Cash Workflows: Design, code, and deploy custom Apex, Lightning Web Components, and automated flows on the Everpure Platform to optimize quote creation, product rate plans, subscriptions, and billing renewals.
  • Drive Strategic Enterprise Integrations: Build and maintain high-performance REST/SOAP API integrations and AppExchange connections between Salesforce, Zuora, and enterprise systems to ensure fault-tolerant data synchronization and security.
  • Optimize Operational Efficiency & System Health: Identify process bottlenecks, perform root-cause debugging, monitor performance metrics, and participate in production support to ensure high availability and seamless data integrity across ecosystem solutions.
  • Lead Modern Engineering Practices: Establish best practices for change management, GitHub version control, deployment pipelines, and the utilization of AI-assisted coding tools to elevate engineering quality across the team.

What You Bring

  • Advanced Technical Mastery: Extensive expertise in Salesforce architecture and programmatic development (Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Web Services/oAuth) paired with deep hands-on experience configuring Zuora Billing, Zuora Quotes/CPQ, and enterprise quote-to-cash business logic.
  • Complex Problem-Solving & Innovation: Ability to evaluate complex architectural requirements, select effective declarative or programmatic methods, and translate strategic business goals into secure, scalable technical designs.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration: Strong analytical, communication, and consultative skills with a track record of partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, driving consensus, and guiding technical execution.
  • Modern Development Tooling Proficiency: Direct experience utilizing version control systems (such as GitHub), CI/CD release management practices, and modern AI-assisted coding tools to deliver quality software efficiently.
  • Location Expectation: This role is based on-site at our Santa Clara office in accordance with Everpure’s in-office policy, with no remote or relocation options available. As such, we are currently considering applications exclusively from local candidates residing within commuting distance of the Bay Area.

This range is our good faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire, as of the date of this posting. Actual base pay within this range will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The Annual Base Salary Hiring Range Is

$171,900—$210,100 USD

What You Can Expect From Us

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce development
  • 4+ years of experience

EXPERIENCE

6–9 years in Salesforce


TYPE

Full-time employee


LEVEL

Senior individual contributor


What you’ll do

A Forward Deployed Engineer works where the business problem actually lives. You’ll embed with a business team, learn their process in enough detail to argue about edge cases, and then build the thing — in their org, against their data, with them watching. The feedback loop is days, not quarters.


The work is a mix of three things. First, Agentforce: designing agents, topics, and actions on the platform, grounding them in Data Cloud, and tuning them until they behave in production. Second, custom MCP servers you design and write in Python, which connect agents (Agentforce and others) to systems and capabilities the platform doesn’t cover out of the box. Third, the core Salesforce engineering that makes both dependable: Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, and a data model that holds up under real volume.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Run discovery directly with business stakeholders — process walkthroughs, org audits, data profiling — and turn what you learn into a design, not a backlog of tickets.
  • Design, build, and deploy Agentforce agents: topics, instructions, guardrails, and actions backed by Apex, Flow, prompt templates, and APIs.
  • Ground agents in the right data using Data Cloud, retrieval, and the Einstein Trust Layer, with an eye on accuracy, latency, and cost.
  • Decide, case by case, whether a capability belongs in a native Agentforce action or a custom MCP server, and build the connection between them when it’s the latter.
  • Design and build custom MCP servers in Python that expose Salesforce objects, SOQL queries, Apex endpoints, and business actions as well-scoped agent tools, with clear input schemas, useful error messages, and permissions that respect the org’s sharing model.
  • Build on-platform: Apex (triggers, Queueable, Batch, async patterns), Lightning Web Components, Flow, Platform Events, and a data model you’d defend in review.
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems — REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2.0 flows, Named Credentials, External Services, middleware — handling retries, idempotency, and rate limits properly.
  • Evaluate agent behavior end to end: write test cases, measure topic routing and action accuracy, and find failure modes before a user does.
  • Own deployment and quality — SFDX, scratch orgs, CI/CD, Apex test coverage that means something, and governor-limit awareness as a design habit rather than a bug fix.
  • Leave documentation and runbooks behind, so the team you embedded with can operate what you built after you move on.


REQUIREMENTS


Salesforce depth

  • 6–9 years building on the Salesforce platform.
  • Production Apex at scale: bulkification, asynchronous patterns, governor limits, trigger frameworks.
  • Lightning Web Components and solid front-end fundamentals (JavaScript, HTML, CSS).
  • Declarative fluency — Flow, validation rules, sharing and visibility — and judgment about when not to write code.
  • Data modeling, large-data-volume considerations, and integration architecture.
  • Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud in production.


Agentforce, MCP, and Python

  • Hands-on Agentforce experience: building agents with topics and actions, Prompt Builder, Agent Builder, and Data Cloud grounding.
  • Strong Python — you’ve shipped and maintained services, not just scripts.
  • Hands-on experience building custom MCP servers or comparable LLM tool-use integrations (function calling, agent frameworks, retrieval pipelines).
  • A working mental model of how LLMs fail, and the habit of designing tools that fail safely.
  • API design, authentication, and secrets handling in an environment with real compliance constraints.
  • Comfort with Git, CI/CD, containers, and cloud deployment.


How you work


  • You’re effective in front of non-technical stakeholders — you can run the meeting, not just attend it.
  • You move under ambiguity and know which corners are safe to cut in a prototype and which ones aren’t.
  • You write clearly. Design docs, decision records, and handoff notes are part of the job.


BONUS

  • Salesforce certifications — Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud 360 Conslutant, Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Integration Architect.
  • Production Agentforce deployments with measurable business outcomes.
  • Data Cloud implementation experience beyond basic grounding.
  • Open-source contributions to MCP servers, agent tooling, or the Salesforce developer ecosystem.
  • Prior consulting, solutions engineering, or forward-deployed work at a product company.
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM applications.

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. This is role is based out of Plano ,TX.

Who We’re Looking For

Toyota Financial Services is looking for a passionate and highly motivated Sr. Software Engineers (Salesforce Platform). The primary responsibility of this role is to lead the transformation of our core business systems into agile, cloud-native, and service-oriented platforms. By leveraging modern frameworks and strong technical judgment, you will help shape the long-term evolution of our technology and enable a best-in-class experience for our customers and partners while supporting Toyota Financial Services’ vision of mobility for all.

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you will help drive major technology transformation by owning key components across multiple cloud environments and delivering scalable, high-impact solutions. Success means building robust Salesforce architecture, collaborating across teams, and mentoring others to ensure our systems remain secure, performant, and aligned with long-term business goals.

  • Design and implement sophisticated Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud solutions that improve agent productivity and customer-facing support experiences.
  • Develop custom business logic and modern UI components using Apex and Lightning Web Components to solve complex challenges where standard tools fall short.
  • Implement advanced Salesforce solutions using OmniScripts and Integration Procedures to streamline business processes and data flow.
  • Partner closely with product, UX, QA, and architecture teams to translate business needs into scalable, maintainable, high-quality technical solutions.
  • Take ownership of system reliability by performing root-cause analysis, troubleshooting production issues, and driving Salesforce development standards.
  • Provide technical leadership through code reviews, documentation, and mentorship to help elevate the capabilities of the engineering team.

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent foundation that supports success in software engineering and Salesforce development.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience across Salesforce Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Experience Cloud, delivering complex enterprise solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Apex development, including triggers, classes, asynchronous processing, and scalable business logic.
  • Proficiency in Lightning Web Components, with the ability to build modern, reusable, and performant UI components.
  • Deep configuration and automation skills, including Flows, validation rules, page layouts, and reporting dashboards.
  • Expertise in designing and maintaining OmniScripts, building Integration Procedures, and connecting them with backend systems and APIs to streamline guided processes and enable end-to-end automation.
  • Proven problem-solving abilities, including experience with REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and data modeling to support seamless integration and data integrity.
  • Experience working with Copado to manage and automate Salesforce deployments across development, testing, and production environments. Hands-on knowledge of release management, version control, and CI/CD practices within Salesforce using Copado.
  • Salesforce Certified Professional : Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform Developer I or II, Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant

Added bonus if you have

  • Experience leveraging Einstein features to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Agentforce tools to drive support innovation.
  • Knowledge of Dynatrace monitoring tools to help ensure system health and reliability.

  • A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect
  • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career, as well as tuition reimbursement
  • Team Member Vehicle Purchase Discount
  • Toyota Team Member Lease Vehicle Program (if applicable)

Job Description

Salesforce Developer with python

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Technical Profile Summary

The Senior Salesforce Developer will design, develop, and optimize scalable enterprise architectures across core Salesforce clouds and decoupled middleware/data ecosystems. This role bridges programmatic Salesforce engineering (Apex, LWC) with modern programmatic backend capabilities (Python), leading API-first integrations, data pipeline engineering, automation frameworks, and maintainable enterprise software design patterns.

________________________________________

  • Core Salesforce Platform & Programmatic Development (Mandatory)
  • Apex Engineering & Architecture:
  • Advanced object-oriented programming (OOP) using enterprise design patterns (Trigger Handler frameworks, Service Layer pattern, Domain/Selector layer, Unit of Work pattern).
  • Asynchronous processing mastery: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex with chaining, Schedulable jobs, and Continuation patterns for long-running callouts.
  • Rigorous transaction management and governor limit mitigation strategies (SOQL/SOSL query optimization, heap size tuning, and bulkified CPU execution profiling).
  • Comprehensive automated testing using Apex Mocks, stub APIs, and enterprise-grade test isolation fixtures achieving resilient code coverage.
  • Modern Frontend (Lightning Web Components & UX):
  • Modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Lightning Web Components (LWC) reactive programming, lifecycle hooks, wire adapters, and @api/@track state architecture.
  • Component orchestration via Lightning Message Service (LMS), custom events, and publish-subscribe paradigms across decoupled UI boundaries.
  • Experience handling complex data tables, real-time client validation, custom modal interactions, and Lightning Design System (SLDS) styling standards.
  • Legacy maintenance and refactoring capabilities: aura component modernization and Visualforce deprecation roadmaps.

________________________________________

  • Enterprise Integration & Middleware Architecture (Mandatory)
  • API Development & Protocols:
  • Designing and consuming custom RESTful and SOAP web services (Apex REST APIs, external REST endpoints, JSON/XML parsing).
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce native integration APIs: Composite API, Bulk API 2.0, Streaming API, and GraphQL API.
  • Event-Driven Architectures (EDA) using Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and Pub/Sub APIs for real-time decoupled event streaming.
  • Security & Authentication:
  • OAuth 2.0 flows (JWT Bearer Token flow, Web Server flow, Authorization Code, Client Credentials) and mutual TLS (mTLS).
  • Named Credentials, External Credentials, Connected Apps configuration, and certificate-based mutual authentication.
  • Hybrid Middleware & Microservices:
  • Integrating Salesforce with enterprise middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, AWS EventBridge, Azure Service Bus).
  • Idempotency handling, exponential backoff, error retry queues, and dead-letter queue (DLQ) architectures.

________________________________________

  • Python Development & Data Ecosystem (Mandatory)
  • Python Capabilities & Tooling:
  • Advanced proficiency in Python 3.x (functional programming, object-oriented design, type hinting, concurrency with asyncio, multithreading, or multiprocessing).
  • Direct experience with Salesforce programmatic interaction libraries such as simple-salesforce, beatbox, and official REST/Bulk API wrappers.
  • Microservice / API development using frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or AWS Lambda serverless functions.
  • Data Engineering & Automation Pipelines:
  • Designing Python-driven ETL/ELT pipelines for high-volume data synchronization between Salesforce and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or Databricks).
  • Data manipulation and cleansing using libraries such as pandas, polars, and numpy for data sanitation, mass deduplication, and complex transformations.
  • Automated operational scripts for bulk data extract, compliance validation, and platform telemetry aggregation.
  • AI & Agentic Systems (Preferred / Emerging):
  • Interfacing Python-based AI agents, LLMs, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with Salesforce data models (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Bedrock APIs, Salesforce Agentforce integration).

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement and maintain Salesforce customizations, applications, extensions and integrations.
  • Develop complex workflows using flows and omni studio will be preferred
  • Develop LWC components
  • Participate in the planning/analysis of business requirements for system changes and enhancements.
  • Collaborate inter-departmentally to identify business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Create testing and implementation plans, including user training and documentation.
  • Remain current with Salesforce technologies and best practices.
  • Experience with Apex, Visualforce and the Lightning Component Framework.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce permissions, roles, reports, dashboards, etc.
  • Experience with APIs and integrations.
  • Experience working on an Agile development team
  • Experience with software development outside of the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Salary Range- $100,000-$120,000 a year

Department Information

Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.

Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

Description Of Job

IMPORTANT NOTE: Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.

Are you eager to use your skills to enhance our beautiful state? At the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT), we're dedicated to providing secure digital services with a focus on Coloradans.

As a Salesforce Senior Developer , you'll play a pivotal role in supporting our mission. Your responsibilities will span across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), focusing primarily on development activities. You'll collaborate with our business analysts and customers to understand requirements, work with team members to apply secure programming techniques, and effectively comment on your code for peers and testers.

You'll also perform unit testing, manage configuration, control source code, oversee deployment and release management, and provide support services when needed. As applications approach the sunset stage, you'll also help plan for replacement and modernization. Your primary role will be to support software for enterprise data tools, including those supporting business intelligence (BI) and data governance services, while you'll also contribute to the support of API development and integration, including monitoring performance, ensuring effective functioning, documenting best practices, and troubleshooting.

As a Salesforce Senior Developer at OIT, you'll do more than just code - you'll be a crucial part of making Colorado a better place for all its residents, putting your creativity and innovation into the state that you love.

Essential Functions

  • Software development using Agile or Waterfall methodologies. Collaboration to create estimates and timelines.
  • Coding and managing configurations for COTS applications.
  • Helping to minimize defects with a disciplined testing approach.
  • Implementation of break/fix solutions and updating documentation accordingly.
  • Resolve issues in the development process employing unique problem-solving and strategically anticipating future enhancement needs.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions Of Employment & Appeal Rights

A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience as a Salesforce Developer.
  • Experience applying digital accessibility regulations and standards (e.g., WCAG 2.1) to business processes, content, tools, and/or documents, with the ability to provide specific examples of accessibility improvements made.

Substitutions

  • Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.
  • Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.
  • If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator Certification.
  • 6+ years of professional experience designing and developing within the Salesforce.com platform.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder.
  • Release/configuration management or completion of formal training
  • Cloud development experience.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel) and Microsoft Visio or the Google equivalent of this tool suite.

Conditions Of Employment

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

Supplemental Information

If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado.

While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.

Visit our How to Apply webpage to learn more about our application process and what to expect after you apply.

The State of Colorado strives to create a Colorado for All by building and maintaining workplaces that value and respect all Coloradans through a commitment to equal opportunity and hiring based on merit and fitness. The State is resolute in non-discriminatory practices in everything we do, including hiring, employment, and advancement opportunities.

The Governor's Office of Information Technology is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our ADA Coordinator at OIT_HR@state.co.us or call (303) 764-7900.

This posting may be used to fill multiple vacancies based upon business need.
