Description

Salesforce Application Developer

We are hiring for multiple positions.

This home-based (remote) position is open to Washington residents and those living in Oregon and Idaho only.

The Opportunity

As a Salesforce Application Developer working on Community Health and Licensing team, you will design, develop, maintain, and improve enterprise applications and databases used by the Washington State Department of Health (DOH). Working within the Executive Office of Innovation and Technology, you will develop and manage technology solutions that support professional licensing, regulatory oversight, complaint investigations, facility inspections, and other essential agency operations.

You will work across the application development lifecycle, translating business needs into functional solutions, developing application features and integrations, managing databases, and resolving complex technical issues. This includes working with technologies such as Salesforce, Microsoft SQL Server, .NET, JavaScript, and Microsoft Azure. You will also collaborate with developers, business teams, vendors, and other technology professionals to ensure applications remain secure, reliable, and responsive to changing business needs.

The applications and databases you develop and maintain are used by DOH programs, healthcare providers, local health jurisdictions, and state and federal partners. Your work helps ensure the technology behind essential agency services remains dependable, secure, and accessible.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain web applications and software solutions that meet agency and program needs.
  • Develop application features, Salesforce solutions, and integrations that connect systems and enable information sharing across platforms.
  • Design, manage, and maintain relational databases, data integrations, and automated processes to ensure information is accurate, accessible, and reliable.
  • Develop and maintain data queries, reporting tools, dashboards, and data extracts that help program teams access and use information.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve complex application, database, and system issues, including identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
  • Plan and coordinate technical implementation activities, manage project tasks and timelines, and communicate progress, risks, and technical considerations.
  • Conduct code reviews, system testing, and quality assurance to ensure applications meet functional, security, coding, and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to development standards, practices, and continuous improvements across supported applications.

Why You'll Love This Role

You'll work on technology that plays an important role in the Department of Health's ability to deliver essential services across Washington. The applications and databases you develop help agency programs, healthcare professionals, and public health partners carry out critical work. You'll also have opportunities to solve complex technical challenges, work with evolving technologies, and collaborate with professionals across IT and public health.

The Ideal Candidate

You enjoy solving complex technical problems and turning business needs into practical, reliable technology solutions. You approach development with curiosity and attention to detail, value secure and well-designed applications, and take ownership of the quality of your work. You communicate technical information clearly, collaborate effectively with people from different professional backgrounds, and remain adaptable as technologies and business needs evolve. You also recognize the importance of the systems you build and maintain and take pride in contributing to technology that serves the public.

Required Qualifications

There are multiple pathways to qualify for this position. You must meet one of the options provided and any additional criteria listed. Additional years of experience can substitute for education on a one-for-one basis. Please ensure any relevant experience defined below is outlined in your cover letter, resume, and/or applicant profile.

  • Option 1: Eight (8) years of professional experience in one or more of the following IT disciplines: consulting, analyzing, designing, programming, installing and/or maintaining computer software applications.
  • Option 2: An Associate’s degree or higher in Information Technology program or a closely related field; AND six (6) years of professional experience in one or more of the following IT disciplines: consulting, analyzing, designing, programming, installing and/or maintaining computer software applications.
  • Option 3: A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology program or a closely related field; AND four (4) years of professional experience in one or more of the following IT disciplines: consulting, analyzing, designing, programming, installing and/or maintaining computer software applications.

Additional Required Knowledge, Skills, And Experience

  • Professional experience in software development including designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining applications throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Proficiency and recent experience (within the past three years) coding and developing applications using current, vendor-supported programming languages, frameworks, and development tools, such as C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, or comparable technologies.
  • Proficiency and recent experience (within the past three years) developing and maintaining applications on the Salesforce Platform as a Service (PaaS), including front-end development using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and back-end development using Apex and SOQL.
  • Proficiency in relational database development, including writing SQL queries, developing stored procedures, functions, and views, and managing data structures using technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server or comparable database platforms.
  • Experience developing and maintaining application integrations, including APIs, web services, and data exchanges between applications, databases, and external systems.
  • Experience with cloud-based application platforms or hosting environments, such as Microsoft Azure, Salesforce, or comparable cloud technologies.
  • Experience with software testing and quality assurance, including unit testing, system testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving application defects.
  • Knowledge of application security and secure development practices, including identifying vulnerabilities and implementing solutions that protect sensitive data and maintain system integrity.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Lean practices, and continuous improvement principles as applied to software development and the SDLC.
  • Proficiency communicating concepts and ideas to a variety of audiences both verbally and in writing.
  • Experience simultaneously managing multiple application development projects, enhancements, or production support activities.
  • Proficiency working collaboratively as part of a cross-functional teams such as business partners, business analysts, quality assurance testers and application support teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A Bachelors’ degree or higher in Computer Science, Management Information System, or closely allied field (Engineering/Mathematics).
  • Proficiency developing for Salesforce Platform with OmniStudio components and managed packages such as MuleSoft, Box and Nintex.
  • Experience with DevOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery practices and tools such as Azure DevOps and GitHub.
  • Experience with cloud computing via Azure Services such as Azure Portal, Azure App Services, Application Insights, Azure Storage, Azure SQL and Azure Functions.
  • Experience developing custom components, templates and web-based applications with the Dynamics 365 PaaS

Employee Benefits

We want you to have the support and benefits you need to do your best work while building a career that fits your life. As a DOH employee, you’ll have access to a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, with resources to support you now and help you plan for the future. Learn more about DOH benefits and what it’s like to work with us by visiting Work@Health .

The Office of Innovation and Technology

Technology and data powering public health.

The Office of Innovation and Technology (OIT) provides the technology, data, and digital services that support DOH programs and public health partners across Washington. Our specialized teams work together to build, secure, modernize, and support the systems that power public health operations, data exchange, laboratory services, emergency response, and informed decision-making. We foster curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement to create reliable, connected technology solutions that help DOH better serve communities across Washington.

About The Washington State Department Of Health

We're nearly 2,700 professionals across Washington working together to protect and improve community health. Guided by our values of Equity, Innovation, and Engagement, we address health disparities, respond to emerging challenges, and strengthen systems that support resilience.

At DOH, we help reduce barriers, collaborate with diverse communities, and champion equitable health outcomes. We're passionate people who are driven to make a difference in public health . Our work depends on people who take action to learn and grow and who take action to meet the needs of others every day, in service of a healthier Washington. Explore more about the Department of Health, our programs, and our impact by visiting our website .

What To Expect (Working Conditions)

The following describes the working conditions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Work Setting: This position is fully remote, with no regular in-person attendance required. If onsite work is requested by the supervisor, it will be planned and communicated in advance. The work environment is comparable to a typical home or office setting, with limited exposure to hazards. Work is primarily sedentary and involves extended periods of working at a computer.

Schedule: This is a full-time position working 40 hours per week, generally Monday through Friday during standard DOH business hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Longer hours may occasionally be required to complete projects or assignments, meet business demands and deadlines, or support work during the annual legislative session. Alternative or flexible work schedules may be considered at the employee's request, subject to supervisory approval. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be necessary to respond to urgent business emergency needs including remotely supporting inclement weather or emergency operations support functions. System maintenance windows are scheduled in advance and vary by team. The position may also participate in on-call or standby coverage to support agency systems as needed.

Travel Requirements: Infrequent travel may be required to meet with customers, attend professional development opportunities such as Salesforce conferences, communities of practice, and trainings, provide in-person training, or participate in community outreach. When driving for state business, the employee must be legally able to operate a state or privately owned vehicle or provide alternate transportation.

Tools & Equipment: This position uses standard office furniture and equipment, including a desk, office chair, computer, monitors, keyboard, mouse, and cell phone. When working onsite, additional equipment such as printers, fax machines, and copiers may be used. Reliable internet access sufficient to perform all job duties remotely is required.

Customer Interactions: This position regularly interacts with a diverse range of internal and external customers to coordinate work, address business needs, and provide technical information and services. These interactions include agency staff, managers and supervisors, legislators, Governor's Office staff, local health jurisdictions, federal government representatives, the State Board of Health, external partners, and statewide professional associations.

Other: This position is covered by a bargaining unit for which the Washington Federation of State Employees (WFSE) is the exclusive representative. The DOH campus is a smoke-free, drug-free, alcohol-free, scent-neutral environment. This position may be required to conduct and/or participate in public health emergency preparedness and response activities.

We Encourage You to Apply

If you meet the required qualifications for this position; we want to hear from you. Preferred qualifications describe additional experience, knowledge or skills that may be helpful in the role, but they are not required to be considered for the position. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives.

Application Directions

Required

To be considered, you must complete the online application in full and submit all required materials. Incomplete applications or applications missing required materials will not be considered. When completing your application, please include the following required materials:

  • Cover letter: describing your qualifications for this specific position
  • Resume: that details your applicable experience and education.
  • Three (3) professional references: References must be entered directly into the designated references section of your application or attached as a separate document. At least one reference must be a current or recent supervisor.

DO NOT INCLUDE private details like your SSN or birth year, personal photos, transcripts, certifications, diplomas, projects, portfolios, or letters of recommendation.

Veterans Preference: We value the experience and skill veterans bring to the workforce and encourage veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses to apply. Eligible veterans may qualify for veterans’ preference in accordance with Washington State Law. If you are claiming veterans’ preference, you must attach your applicable DD-214, NGB Form 22, or other equivalent discharge or separation documentation. Please redact your social security number, date of birth, and any other sensitive information before uploading and attaching the document.

Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion: We regard diversity as the foundation of our strength, recognizing that differing insights and abilities enable us to reflect the unique needs of the communities we serve. DOH is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship or immigration status, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, age, the presence or perception of a disability, honorably discharged veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

Questions and Accommodations: If you have questions, need assistance with the application process, require an accommodation, or would like to request this posting in an alternative format, please contact Shawnelle Goalder at employment@doh.wa.gov and reference DOH9036.

Technical Support: Reach out to NEOGOV directly at 1-855-524-5627 for technical support and login issues.

SUBSCRIBE to DOH Job Alerts

Supplemental Information

This recruitment may be used to fill positions of the same job classification across the agency. Once all the position(s) from the recruitment are filled, the candidate pool may be used to fill additional open positions for the next sixty (60) days.

To be considered, please follow the application instructions and complete all required application materials. Information provided in your supplemental question responses, including education and experience, must be supported by your applicant profile.

About The Role

As we continue to grow and add top talent to the Baird IT family, we are looking to add an experienced Salesforce Platform Engineer to our team. The team you work with manages an implementation for our Global Investment Banking group with 600+ users.

Our Baird Salesforce professionals are dedicated to working together to support our expanding Salesforce implementation in a highly collaborative environment. Join us to design, build, continuously improve and maintain Salesforce solutions that solve real business problems. You’ll combine declarative configuration with programmatic development and apply Salesforce best practices to build, configure, automate, integrate and optimize Salesforce solutions to ensure users can maximize the platform’s value. Join an inclusive Salesforce team—engineers, developers, architects, analysts, and change leaders—who learn from each other, share ownership, and raise the bar together.

We're hiring two Salesforce Platform Engineers to support our growing Salesforce platform in our Capital Markets portfolio. These roles support our Capital Markets team in a hybrid work environment.

  • Platform Engineer, Financial Services Cloud: This engineer will help develop and implement a new Salesforce org using Financial Services Cloud. Prior FSC experience is preferred, but not required.
  • Platform Engineer, Sales Cloud: This engineer will build and enhance solutions in shared-org environment using Sales Cloud.

Baird is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.

The Impact You'll Make

  • Turn business requirements into functional Salesforce solutions using the appropriate declarative or programmatic tools based on a strong understanding of trade-offs between declarative and programmatic solutions and a declarative-first approach
  • Design, develop, test, document, and deploy Salesforce features with quality and reliability in adherence to the Salesforce Well-Architected framework Mapping Salesforce features to the problem we are solving and the associated business processes
  • Clarify MVP and scope, consider platform‑first options (including AppExchange), and compare alternatives before committing to code
  • Work closely with product owners, business analysts, and peers to help translate business needs into working solutions by engaging in discovery and gathering requirements
  • Assist in effort estimation and applying Salesforce capabilities to business requirements Clearly communicate trade-offs, risks, decision criteria to assist others in understanding the impact of changes to the Salesforce system
  • Collaborate closely with teammates and stakeholders, using agile feedback loops to refine decisions
  • Define and communicate a clear course of action, prioritize effectively, and summarize complex issues in simple terms for different audiences
  • Stay focused on the most important, prioritized work; communicate competing priorities; and give useful status updates with remaining‑work estimates
  • Manage user access and security, maintain data quality and integrity, automate business processes, create custom reports and dashboards
  • Manage installed managed packages and AppExchange solutions, including opening, managing and resolving application issues with external application vendors
  • Write/Maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, when necessary
  • Build Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura components, when necessary
  • Work with VisualForce and JavaScript, when necessary
  • Develop and manage Salesforce integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, External Services)
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (Salesforce DX) and coordinate the rollout of enhancements to the production environment, including coordination with other IT areas and business stakeholders
  • We design with empathy and evidence, delivering intuitive, accessible solutions that fit real workflows and drive measurable adoption and outcomes that reflect a positive user experience
  • Experiment as a team, prototype and learn fast, and scale what works—celebrating collaboration and continuous improvement over perfection
  • Maintain org configuration, sandbox refreshes, and manage metadata
  • Partner with architects and data teams to enforce platform best practices and coding standards
  • Integrate third-party applications
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including network diagrams, installation and configuration procedures, troubleshooting guidelines, and operational procedures
  • Support new releases and bug fixes as they relate to the management of the platform,
  • Investigate and resolve failing processes, apps, and integrations by performing root‑cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes
  • Take ownership for the health of the platform by looking beyond the current work to spot platform opportunities with long‑term benefits
  • Provide technical support assistance to diagnose and resolve issues and troubleshoot complex ‘how to’ questions
  • Supply level one support technicians with documentation and procedures for resolving common or recurring issues
  • Keep up to date on Salesforce releases (patches, upgrades, etc), news and industry information
  • Participate in the Salesforce Success Community, local user group and other community events to help further your skills
  • Share ideas and collaborate with other Baird Salesforce professionals in the Baird Trailblazer group

What You'll Bring To Baird

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience and Salesforce certifications will also be considered
  • 7-10 years experience in development, declarative configuration and administration experience working with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud required)
  • Suggested certifications: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer
  • Comfortable working with developers to read and understand Apex, Visualforce, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and is required
  • Ability to develop and maintain Apex classes, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components, and JavaScript within the Salesforce platform is a plus
  • Knowledge of Microsoft development tools is a plus but not required (Object-Oriented design, C#, MVC, ASP.NET, Web API)
  • Experience with Git, version control, and CI/CD tools (e.g., Salesforce DX)
  • Working knowledge of integrations (middleware, REST APIs, or ETL tools)
  • Collaborating with IT / Developers for other systems to integrate across the business
  • Diverse Salesforce product knowledge and proven technical expertise. Experience with Sales Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Marketing Cloud, MuleSoft are preferred
  • Strong understanding of trade-offs between declarative and programmatic solutions
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model and object relationships. Data management, data administration, and data modeling experience is a plus
  • Strong communication skills with a great team player mentality
  • Agile Methodology experience highly preferred (Kanban, User Stories, Sizing, Retro, etc)
  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects
  • Understanding of change management methodologies is a plus
  • Focused and driven with excellent problem-solving skills and ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Compensation And Benefits

  • $87,000-$120,800 annual salary range
  • Bonus potential up to 20% of base pay
  • Compensation and bonus are commensurate with experience, performance and/or firm profitability
  • You’ll have the opportunity to advance your career while enjoying our comprehensive benefits designed for your life, career and future.

Simplus, An Infosys Company are seeking a highly experienced Salesforce Developer who can provide technical leadership, guide engineering standards, and drive the evolution of our enterprise Salesforce ecosystem.


Location: Atlanta, GA


Deliver on the following responsibilities:



Technical Execution and Architecture

  • Lead the design and development of complex Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and platform APIs.
  • Architect reusable components and scalable integrations that support growing business needs.
  • Oversee and enhance CI/CD pipelines, branching strategies, and release management processes using tools such as GitLab and Salesforce DX.
  • Validate technical designs and code quality through in-depth reviews, ensuring solutions adhere to performance, security, and scalability requirements.


Organizational Impact

  • Lead technical planning and estimation for large, multi-team initiatives.
  • Support the growth of the Salesforce practice by contributing to reusable patterns, engineering playbooks, and technical onboarding materials.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and promote automation that improves delivery speed and operational efficiency.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on Salesforce capabilities, helping business and technology partners understand constraints, risks, and solution tradeoffs.


Minimum Required Experiences:

  • 3-4 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Deep expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and SOSL, Flow development, custom metadata, and platform automation.
  • Excellent knowledge of Salesforce data modeling, security models, and advanced integration patterns that include REST, SOAP, Platform Events, and asynchronous processing.
  • Proven experience leading development teams in Agile and Scrum environments with consistent participation in sprint planning, grooming, and technical ceremonies.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive high-quality releases in fast-paced settings with strong ownership of deadlines and technical deliverables.
  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud is required.
  • Experience with Github Copilot to accelerate Salesforce development


Desired Experiences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I and II, Application Architect, or System Architect are highly preferred.



If you are interested, please share your CV to sharonsantosh.ninan@infosys.com OR you can apply here and attach your profile.

Our Company: ISN was established in 2001 and is a global leader in contractor and supplier management. We work closely with a variety of household-name clients in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, and the Middle East to connect them with safe and reliable contractors and suppliers and incorporate a level of due diligence in the contractor management process.

The Position: ISN is seeking a highly skilled Salesforce Solutions Engineer to join our Enterprise CRM team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions while partnering closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, recommend enhancements, and deliver impactful solutions across the Salesforce platform.

This position combines hands-on Salesforce development with business collaboration, solution design, integration development, and platform administration. The ideal candidate is comfortable working beyond documented requirements, proactively identifying gaps, edge cases, and cross-cloud impacts to ensure successful outcomes.

Who should apply?

  • 6+ years of Salesforce development experience
  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce product suite including - Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Revenue Cloud (CPQ & Billing), and Experience Cloud
  • Experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL/SOSL and MuleSoft
  • Experience managing large Salesforce environments (900+ users)
  • Strong integration experience using REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML
  • Experience with code review, strong attention to detail and QA knowledge
  • Interest in frequent business end-user interaction and collaboration
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field from an accredited university
  • Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer

Responsibilities

  • Develop and design Salesforce solutions using both programmatic and declarative tools
  • Build and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and platform events
  • Interact regularly with business end-users to discuss and recommend enhancements. This requires a strong understanding of how end-users work within our Salesforce instance in order to translate functional requirements into Salesforce technical requirement and recommend solutions.
  • Complete Salesforce Admin functions, including user management, data management, and reports/dashboards
  • Identify gaps, edge cases, or downstream cross-cloud impacts not explicitly stated in requirements
  • Shadow business end-users to gain a deep understanding of the business use of Salesforce, business needs, and the impact on users' day-to-day roles
  • Effectively leverage approved AI-powered tools and automation to enhance productivity across daily work activities and applicable elements of the Software Development Life Cycle — requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and/or operations

Note: ISN does not provide work visa sponsorship for this position (such as H-1B visa sponsorship in the United States). Applicants for employment must possess work authorization/right to work without the need for sponsorship by the employer now or in the future.

Onsite Requirements: 3232 McKinney Ave #1500, Dallas, TX 75204

  • Employees must be within a commutable distance to the Dallas, TX office. Relocation is required for candidates not already local to the DFW area.
  • In-person attendance is required at minimum 2 days onsite per week and required for certain meetings and tasks (generally Wednesday and Thursday for collaboration with stakeholders and customers, trainings, team collaboration day, ISN events, team events, performance reviews, etc.)
    • The first month will involve extensive onboarding, job training, and shadowing with the business team. Employees should anticipate spending additional time onsite during this period to support training and knowledge transfer activities.
ISN Benefits*

  • 100% company-paid monthly insurance premiums for employees and dependents - Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 4% retirement matching
  • Paid time off
    • 0-1 year – 15 day (pro-rated first year)
    • 1-5 years – 20 days
    • 5-10 years – 25 days
    • 10+ years – 30 days
  • Holidays – 13 paid holidays
  • Monthly cell phone reimbursement
  • Complimentary parking space or monthly reimbursement for DART public transportation
  • Team-building activities and events, including quarterly kick-off meetings and community volunteer day
  • Matching charitable gift program
  • Professional development & training opportunities
  • Wellness Program: Focuses on community, financial, mental, nutrition, physical and social health
  • Business casual, jeans allowed
  • All benefits are subject to change with notice to the employee
All job offers will be contingent on successful completion of a drug screen and background check.

ISN is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

descriptionHtml:
The Salesforce Administrator/Developer owns the day-to-day configuration, automation, and support of the Salesforce platform. This role blends hands-on administration (security model, declarative automation, data quality, user support) with intermediate development (Apex, Lightning Web Components, integration troubleshooting) to keep Salesforce reliable and aligned to business process. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a Flow with sales leadership and writing an Apex trigger to enforce it at scale.


Responsibilities

  • Owns Salesforce administration: user setup, security model (Profiles, Permission Sets/Groups, sharing rules, field-level security), page layouts, record types, and Lightning App Builder configuration.
  • Develops Apex (classes, triggers, test classes) and Lightning Web Components to extend Salesforce beyond what declarative tools can support, following best practices.
  • Builds and maintains Flow-based automation (Screen Flows, record-triggered Flows).
  • Supports and troubleshoots existing integrations between Salesforce and other business systems (ERP, CPQ, middleware), escalating architecture-level changes as needed.
  • Collaborates with IT / Developers for other systems to integrate across the business.
  • Maintains, monitors and improves data quality (deduplication, validation rules, required fields).
  • Adheres to Salesforce best practices and, maintain documentation for all custom development.
  • Remains current with Salesforce technologies and best practices.
  • Creates and executes user acceptance test plans, including use cases and test data.
  • Takes ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and codes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

descriptionHtml:
About Lovesac

We are a young-at-heart, fast-growing furniture company, dedicated to helping people fill their homes with Total Comfort™. We do this by designing and innovating furniture solutions that are adaptable, washable, expandable, and delivered right-to-your-door-able, allowing our customers to live the life they want to live.

Our Designed for Life mission started with Sacs, a seat so much better than your classic beanbag made with repurposed Durafoam and designed to reduce environmental impact while providing unimaginable, cloud-like comfort. From there, we expanded the possibility for sustainable furniture with Sactionals, a customizable modular sectional that can be endlessly rearranged to evolve with you. Our product line has grown a lot since our Sacs days, but our goal will always remain the same – to create truly adaptable, comfortable furniture that can be with you for life.

About Our Culture

At Lovesac, we strive to be an employer of choice by embodying a culture that encourages team members to think and dream big. We call this Top Ambition. We aim to not only excel within our industry but also make a meaningful impact on the world. Above all else, we’re driven by love (because it matters) and are dedicated to promoting love and happiness in all aspects of our work. It’s about success, of course, but it’s also about making a positive impact on everyone our business touches.

About The Role

As the Sr. Engineer of Salesforce, you will design, build, and support Salesforce solutions that enable connected, customer-centric experiences across Lovesac’s business. This role is responsible for configuring, developing, and maintaining Salesforce capabilities that support sales, service, marketing, and store operations through reliable, scalable, and secure solutions.

This position is remote and will report into Lovesac Corporate HUB based in Stamford, CT. Candidates must fully reside in the United States at all times during employment and should have the ability to travel as needed.

What You’ll Do

Salesforce Configuration & Development

  • Design, configure, and develop Salesforce solutions using declarative tools and programmatic capabilities (Flows, Apex, Lightning Web Components).
  • Build and maintain functionality across Salesforce clouds (e.g., Sales, Service, Marketing integrations) to support omnichannel customer engagement.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable Salesforce solutions.
  • Support feature delivery through build, test, deployment, and post-release support.

Platform Support & Optimization

  • Maintain and enhance existing Salesforce functionality to improve performance, usability, and adoption.
  • Identify and resolve defects, bugs, and performance issues.
  • Support platform upgrades, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical standards, and best practices.

Data, Integration & Customer 360 Enablement

  • Support Salesforce integrations with downstream and upstream systems (ERP, commerce platforms, marketing tools, data platforms).
  • Help ensure accurate, consistent customer data across the CRM ecosystem.
  • Implement and maintain data validation, automation, and security rules to support data quality and governance.
  • Assist with Unified Customer Profile and identity alignment efforts.

Security, Privacy & Governance

  • Implement role-based access controls, sharing rules, and permission sets.
  • Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and accessibility standards.
  • Follow established Salesforce development and release management processes.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and business stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, grooming, testing, and release activities.
  • Support change management and operational readiness for new capabilities.

Qualifications

Who you Are:

Core Values: Top Ambition, We All Win Together, Conscious Operations, Do Less and Do Best, Love Matters

Table-Stake Values: Willing to Sweep Floors, Grit, Positive, Self-Aware, Self-Starting, Insatiable Learners, Transparency, Customer-Centric

Core Competencies: Builds Customer Centricity, Drives Remark-able Results, Collaborates Effectively, Makes Good Decisions, Demonstrates Self-Awareness

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required.
  • Experience implementing Salesforce products (Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud).
  • 5-8 years of hands-on experience working with Salesforce as an Administrator, Developer, or Engineer.
  • Experience with Salesforce configuration, Flow automation, and Apex (LWC experience a plus).
  • Understanding of CRM concepts, customer lifecycle management, and omnichannel journeys.
  • Experience supporting integrations via APIs, middleware, or native Salesforce tools.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data flows, cloud environments, and system security principles.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors and system integrators to deliver scalable and high-quality solutions.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments leading backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and cross-team delivery.
  • Exemplify each of our Lovesac values, at all times, be results driven and utilize knowledge to meet or exceed key performance indicators (KPIs), goals and deadlines.
  • Must be able to travel using various forms of transportation, as required by the Company in its sole discretion, for mandatory meetings and conferences held either at our offices or offsite (i.e. quarterly team connection weeks, companywide meetings and events, vendor visits).
  • Must comply with all policies and procedures outlined in the Lovesac Employee Handbook and work collaboratively with fellow employees, treating all clients, both internal and external with dignity and respect at all times.

Full Time Benefits*

  • Financial Benefits: Annual Bonus Program, Annual Grant Equity Awards, 401K Matching Contribution, Financial Wellness Tools.
  • Health and Wellness Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Paid Parental Leave, Life/AD&D, Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Critical Illness and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Program.
  • Paid Time Off: Up to 160 hours of paid time off within our fiscal calendar year, prorated from date of hire, 8 paid company recognized holidays.
  • Pet Insurance and generous Associate Discounts.
  • Eligibility and terms for all benefits listed are as outlined in Lovesac’s policy and plan documents. Associate pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level and competencies.

Lovesac is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender (including gender-related identity, gender nonconformity, or status as a transgender or transsexual individual), pregnancy, age, national origin, marital status, physical or mental disability, military status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Non-New York City Applicants Only: To the extent permitted by law, conditional offers of employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check, including but not limited to education verification, employment history verification, reference checks, criminal history and motor vehicle history (if vehicle required). All qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal law.

Lovesac participates in E-Verify as required by law. Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role.

Lovesac is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with disabilities, protected medical conditions, and religious beliefs. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at: accommodations@lovesac.com.

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.


About the Role

This role is based out of Johns Creeks GA or Northridge CA.


MIniMed is looking for a Principal SalesForce Developer who will set the technical direction for Salesforce development while staying hands‑on with complex engineering work. You define and enforce development standards, guide architectural decisions, and ensure all Salesforce solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. You review technical designs, oversee integrations, mentor developers, and drive consistent engineering quality across the team. You collaborate with cross‑functional partners to translate business needs into technical solutions, troubleshoot complex system issues, and maintain clear documentation to support long-term system health and maintainability.


Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of complex Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, automation tools, and integrations.
  • Proven experience with Integration Patterns, specifically connecting Salesforce with SAP and legacy systems.
  • Deep understanding of SSO and Identity Management protocols (e.g., SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).
  • Working experience with global, multi-region large enterprise data sets and complex environment management.
  • Experience implementing or working with AI technologies (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or LLM integrations).
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, development frameworks, best practices, and technical governance across the Salesforce team.
  • Conduct code reviews, manage pull requests, reduce technical debt, and ensure high code quality across all deliverables.
  • Provide hands-on development and refactoring support for complex or high-impact features.
  • Oversee Salesforce integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and data integration tools.
  • Partner with business analysts, architects, and project managers to translate requirements into well-defined technical specifications.
  • Mentor and guide developers at all levels, promoting strong engineering practices and professional growth.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex Salesforce issues related to performance, integrations, configuration, and custom code.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation for technical designs, integrations, configurations, and development processes.
  • Support delivery within Agile frameworks and collaborate with DevOps teams on Copado deployment best practices.


Must Have: Minimum Requirements

To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident in your applicant profile.

  • Requires a Bachelors degree and minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with 5 years of experience.


#BetterDaysStartNow


Nice to Have:

  • 10+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and core platform capabilities.
  • 3+ years in a technical lead, senior developer, or architect role within Salesforce ecosystems.
  • Proven ability to design scalable, secure Salesforce architectures following platform and enterprise best practices.
  • Strong command of programming and web technologies (Apex, JavaScript, HTML/CSS) and version control tools (Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub).
  • Deep knowledge with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Digital Engagement; Commerce Cloud and Marketing Cloud experiences are a plus.
  • Strong background in building and managing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware platforms.
  • Experience with Copado, including managing development pipelines, promoting changes across environments, and supporting automated deployment processes.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs with clarity and precision.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with experience troubleshooting complex code and system issues.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, and guide developers at varying skill levels, fostering technical excellence and collaboration.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.
  • Experience working within Agile development methodologies.
  • Required Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II
  • Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect certifications.
  • Experience with multi-org or enterprise-scale Salesforce environments.
  • Familiarity with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js).


Physical Job Requirements

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.

descriptionHtml:
At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Salesforce FDE, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. This requires a highly motivated practitioner who moves with speed and precision, building working software, engaging confidently with senior stakeholders and engineers to bring measurable business impact from day one. At the core, this role is about three things: selling the art of the possible, delivering fast, and leaning into mission-critical deployments to maximize impact. Additional responsibilities include:

Client Engagement

  • Embed with clients to identify business needs and translate high-value use cases into Salesforce and Agentforce-enabled solutions.
  • Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.
  • Lead working sessions to shape solutions and drive client outcomes.
  • Prototype and deliver working agentic and deterministic solutions using Salesforce capabilities on client infrastructure.
  • Contribute independently within an FDE pod while mentoring newer team members.
  • Coach client teams and end users on platform capabilities and agentic use case enablement, while building trusted relationships, managing customer expectations, and supporting long-term engagement success.
  • Drive end-to-end sales and delivery support by developing demos/POCs, contributing to proposals and orals, articulating business value, and identifying follow-on opportunities, then documenting solutions for smooth client handoff and knowledge transfer.
  • Strengthen team and organizational impact by mentoring other FDEs through design/code reviews and feedback, while contributing reusable components to intellectual capital.

Solution Engineering

  • Build AI-enabled solutions, agentic platforms, and workflows across the Salesforce ecosystem, including Agentforce, Data Cloud, and the broader Customer 360 and Data 360 offerings (Missionforce/Public Sector Solutions, Agentforce, Slack, Informatica, MuleSoft, and Tableau), in support of mission-critical deployments where reliability and impact are non-negotiable.
  • Be fluent in Government platform cybersecurity considerations and requirements, from integration procedures (e.g., interface agreements) to FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, and more.
  • Develop scalable AI engineering patterns, tool-use approaches, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Apply architecture decisions that balance quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.
  • Deliver production-quality code built on strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation.
  • Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.
  • Contribute reusable assets including code, prompt libraries, runbooks, and reference implementations.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
  • 5+ years of experience
  • 3+ years of experience with Salesforce including hands-on experience with one or more of the following Salesforce ecosystem technologies across our Customer 360 and Data 360 offerings: Salesforce Platform (Apex, LWC), Agentforce, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack, and/or Informatica.
  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data integration or engineering, data science, or analytics
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments
  • 1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • 1+ years of experience with, and demonstrated fluency in, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or other leading agentic development tools.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Preference for candidates local to the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area
  • Experience delivering as both an independent contributor and as a leader of a product-focused development team
  • Strong candidates will possess deep experience in the core Salesforce platform and Agentforce, and complementary experience in another core Salesforce product offering like Slack, MuleSoft, Informatica, or Tableau
  • Experience with a complementary enterprise data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Palantir Foundry is strongly desired
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments
  • Experience and fluency in AI/ML solution practices such as evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and prompt management, and continuous improvement
  • Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems via APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures
  • Experience operating within hybrid onshore/offshore teams
  • Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Virginia, Deloitte is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Virginia and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $184,100 to $306,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

#BetterDaysStartNow

Description

The Ads Services Salesforce Team is looking for a smart, motivated, and hands-on Salesforce Developer & Administrator to own and operate our shared production Salesforce instance. This is a hybrid role that combines technical Salesforce development (Apex, integrations, Lightning) with platform administration (configuration, user management, data quality). You will be responsible for day-to-day operations, new feature delivery, integrations with internal tools and AWS services, and ensuring a smooth experience for business teams across Support, Operations, and Customer Advisory.

You will use your business judgement and technical experience to design and build compelling solutions for hundreds of internal customers in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage configuration of Salesforce features including user management, security, custom objects, page layouts, validation rules, workflows, Flows, and Process Builders.
  • Manage Salesforce support requests and escalated administrative needs — provide prompt and complete resolution to technical challenges.
  • Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders on major project roll-outs, including training and troubleshooting for end-users.
  • Monitor system health and proactively identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce in innovative ways to improve business processes and increase productivity.

Development

  • Design and develop Apex classes, triggers, and batch jobs to support complex business logic.
  • Build and maintain Lightning Components and Visualforce pages for custom user interfaces.
  • Develop and manage integrations with internal tools and AWS services using REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Design and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations to connect Salesforce with AWS, Retail, and Ads platforms — enabling AI-powered workflows across multi-cloud ecosystems.
  • Design, build, and maintain data models and data pipelines for Salesforce — including ETL/ELT processes, data lake integrations, and real-time sync with external systems.

Cross-Cutting

  • Partner with system product owners to deliver tailored solutions that support business requirements and drive tangible business value.
  • Consult with stakeholders on application performance, scalability, and usability.

A day in the life

Most days start off with a team standup. Participate with a 2-pizza cross functional team of PM and SDEs as they discuss the activities for products and services. In this role you will work with business stakeholders to ideate products and features. You will collaborate with engineers of various levels to break down complex problems with real business impact.

About The Team

Advertising Services is inclusive of service and support functions to ensure -- post-sale -- advertising customers are able to hit their marketing objectives. We cover the full spectrum of services and support from Ads Console and Sponsored Ads to Amazon DSP. We will achieve best-in-class service by obsessing over what customers actually need, and when they need it, to confidently and effectively grow their business. Internally, our service teams include Advertiser Support, Programmatic Solutions Consultants (PSC), Advertiser Success (AST), Creative Services, Campaign and Creative Managers (CCM), Ad Operations (AdOps), and AdTech Solutions (ATS).

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
  • Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
  • 1+ years of systems development experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
  • Knowledge of distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases

Job Title: Associate Salesforce Developer

Team: Systems

Location: Hybrid in Atlanta (GA), Chicago (IL), Newark (NJ), or New York City (NYC)

Employment Type: Full-time

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Start Date: ASAP

About Braven

Braven is a national nonprofit that prepares promising college students to secure a strong first opportunity after college graduation through a career-accelerating program. We work with higher education and employer partners to offer a life-changing experience that begins with a semester-long course for college students, followed by support that lasts through graduation. Together, our ambition is to help rebuild the middle class and revitalize the American Dream. To learn more, take a look at Braven's Jobs.

About The Role

In order to achieve its ambition of serving 80,000-100,000 Fellows over the next decade, Braven is hiring an Associate Salesforce Developer who will play a crucial role in supporting the design and implementation of customized and scalable Salesforce solutions that drive organizational impact. In this role, you will translate user stories and requirements into technical solutions. Key responsibilities include developing and implementing customized Salesforce solutions, ensuring seamless integration with other systems, troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance Braven's Salesforce infrastructure in support of organizational growth and impact.

This role is on the Systems team and reports directly to the Salesforce Architect.

What You'll Do


Solution Development & Implementation (75%)

  • Collaborate with Salesforce Solution Engineers, Developers, Architects, and cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and ensure alignment with overall project goals and objectives
  • Manage internal System team projects, including DevOps improvements, automation audits, and data deduplication
  • In collaboration with Salesforce developers, create customized Salesforce solutions, including Apex classes, Lightning Web Components, and Visualforce pages, that address complex business needs and technical challenges
  • Deploy scalable, dynamic, and maintainable Salesforce applications, leveraging custom objects, flow, triggers, and integrations to meet the evolving needs of Braven's operations
  • Write, optimize, and maintain clean, efficient, and high-performance code, ensuring scalability and adherence to Salesforce best practices and governance standards
  • Test and debug solutions, identifying and resolving complex technical issues throughout the development lifecycle to maintain a robust Salesforce platform
  • Develop and maintain Agentforce agents, prompt templates, and custom MCPs.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the Salesforce platform by identifying opportunities for new features, enhancements, and automations to optimize functionality and enhance the user experience


Knowledge-Sharing (25%)

  • Translate complex Salesforce processes and solutions into user-friendly documentation, resources, and training materials for technical and non-technical teams
  • Promote a culture of knowledge-sharing by encouraging team members to stay up-to-date with Salesforce innovations, tools, and methodologies

Other duties as assigned

Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in the Salesforce platform.
  • Salesforce Certifications: Platform Developer I or Platform Administrator II. This can be substituted with 4 years of professional experience in the Salesforce platform plus proofs of Salesforce development knowledge including Trailhead superbadges, Github repos, and Apex/web development course completion
  • Broad experience in Salesforce development environments, including Apex triggers/classes, Lightning Web Components, Flows, Visualforce pages/controllers, and advanced Salesforce configuration such as Sharing and Profile & Permission Set security.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer II, and/or Javascript Developer I.
  • Experience in a nonprofit/higher ed setting using Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP) or Education Cloud. Experience Cloud knowledge is a plus
  • Experience using Salesforce CLI, Github, Gearset (or other DevOps tools), managing sandbox environments, implementing continuous testing, and deploying changes into production
  • Experience with one or more relevant tools that integrate with Salesforce such as Campaign Monitor, Classy, Conga, Duplicate Check, Excel/Google Sheets, FormAssembly, Mogli, and Tableau
  • Familiar with public cloud providers such as Google Cloud, and AWS
  • Experience with REST-based web services
  • Experience in Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Jira, etc.) preferred
  • You have a strong design sense when crafting data models, holding yourself and others to a high bar when creating schemas that balance ease of use, efficiency, and data integrity.
  • Strong collaborative skills with a clear understanding of how data and operations contribute to organizational goals
  • Demonstrated commitment to building strong and welcoming cultures that help to develop others
  • Exemplification of Braven's core values
  • Experience that has informed your belief in Braven's mission and has prepared you to work with, or for, Braven's student Fellow population
  • Demonstrated commitment to building strong and welcoming cultures that help to develop others
  • Exemplification of Braven's core values
  • Experience that has informed your belief in Braven's mission and has prepared you to work with, or for, Braven's student Fellow population

Please know that no one ever meets 100% of the preferred qualifications. If much of this describes you, we encourage you to apply.

Work Demands

  • Ability to work in person in Atlanta (GA), Chicago (IL), New York City (NYC), or Newark (NJ) 3 days per week
  • Travel 1-2 times per year
  • Access to internet


Additional Requirements

  • Authorized to work in the U.S
  • Braven doesn't offer employment visa sponsorship


Application & Interview Process

While the interview process may vary slightly, the general process will be:

  • Phone screen with Talent Team member
  • Performance Task
  • Interview with Hiring Manager
  • Panel Interview with Key Partners
  • Reference Checks


Benefits

Total Rewards

Braven provides competitive, comprehensive benefits, recognition, and career development. While Braven reserves the right to change benefits at any time, current benefits include:

  • Discretionary time off in addition to org-wide holidays and 2 week-long shutdowns in July and December (this is a minimum of 19 days per year)
  • Braven supports your path to parenthood and beyond with $25,000 in lifetime Carrot benefits for fertility, family-building, and hormonal health
  • Match of your 401K contribution up to 5% of your base annual salary, starting your first full month
  • Coverage of 85% of health insurance premium for employee and dependents
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • A one-month paid sabbatical after 4 years on staff
  • Monthly $75 reimbursement for cell phone or internet
  • Access to funding for continued career development


Compensation

Braven offers opportunities for salary growth over time. We believe in compensating staff members fairly relative to one another, their qualifications, and their impact on the organization, and we take internal and external equity seriously. Given our commitment to equity, Braven does not negotiate salary offers; instead, each offer is carefully determined using external and internal benchmarks.

The hiring range is determined by role scope, qualifications, and internal equity, with annual growth based on performance. Braven does not base compensation on individual candidate salary expectations and is committed to maintaining internal equity. The hiring ranges for this role by geographic market are set forth as $87,200-$93,700 in Atlanta, $92,000-$98,800 in Chicago, and $101,200-$108,700 in Newark and New York City. This is based on a 50-hour work week. This is a full-time, regular, exempt, and benefits-eligible position where you will be working at 100% capacity.

Please note that Braven is firm in its compensation philosophy; therefore, only candidates who believe our total rewards package aligns with what they are looking for in their next opportunity are encouraged to apply.

Location

We gather in the office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday) and work remotely 2 days a week (Monday and Friday). Therefore, this role requires teammates to live within commuting distance of one of our hubs: Atlanta, Chicago, New York City, or Newark. We believe in the magic, connection, and collaboration that happens when people work together face-to-face, and we believe in giving people flexibility to focus, balance personal priorities, and save themselves two commutes per week.

Braven is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor. We encourage talented individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

Req199266

Position Purpose

The Salesforce Engineering team is responsible for scaling Home Depot's Pro CRM and enterprise Salesforce ecosystem, and for expanding our use of AI-driven development to accelerate delivery and modernize how we build, test, and migrate Salesforce solutions. The Staff Software Engineer is the technical anchor for the team, setting architecture direction for Salesforce development, integration, and release patterns, and partnering closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and Principal Engineer. This person owns hard technical decisions on complex Salesforce initiatives, drives disciplined adherence to PDLC/SDLC methodology, and balances delivery speed with long-term platform scalability, security, and maintainability.

In This Role You Will

  • Lead end-to-end Salesforce solution design and development – Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and declarative configuration – across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and custom Salesforce applications.
  • Architect and build integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Bulk API, and middleware.
  • Own the technical governance of code and configuration migration and release management across sandboxes and production orgs, ensuring adherence to PDLC/SDLC methodology, version control, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with Salesforce admins on user maintenance, licensing, and the security model – profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules – as well as ongoing platform administration.
  • Bring AI into the daily engineering workflow, from AI-assisted development and code review to building AI-powered features directly into Salesforce experiences.
  • Set the technical bar: lead architecture reviews, mentor engineers at every level, and raise the standard for code quality across the team.
  • Partner directly with Product, IT leadership, and cross-functional engineering teams to turn ambiguous business requirements into scalable, shippable Salesforce solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • 50% Delivery and Execution – Develops, tests, deploys, and maintains Salesforce solutions with a clear understanding of the business value they provide; takes a broad, enterprise view when approaching integration and platform challenges; builds automated test suites to enable rapid, reliable deployment to production; takes on complex technical challenges with urgency and ownership, consistently delivering results even under tight timelines.
  • 10% Learns and Grows – Actively pursues growth in Salesforce, AI, and cloud technologies through formal and informal channels; learns through both successful and failed experiments when tackling new integration or migration challenges.
  • 20% Plans and Aligns – Creates new and better ways for the organization to scale its Salesforce platform; communicates clearly across technical and non-technical audiences; partners with the Product team to ensure user stories are developer-ready, well-scoped, and testable; collaborates within agile/PDLC processes; adapts approach to shifting business priorities.
  • 20% Supports and Enables – Fields questions from Product, IT, and business teams on Salesforce capabilities; mentors engineers on Salesforce development standards and AI-assisted engineering practices; identifies platform gaps and proposes improvements to development and release processes.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports

  • This position typically repots to Software Engineer Manager or Sr. Manager
  • This position has 0 Direct Reports

Travel Requirements

  • No travel required.

Physical Requirements

  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.
  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Salesforce development and integration.
  • Salesforce expert-level development – Hands-on, expert-level experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL,Platform Event triggers and the Salesforce security/sharing model, not just declarative configuration.
  • Integration architecture – Proven experience designing and building integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Bulk API, and middleware.
  • Staff-level technical leadership – Track record leading technical direction on complex, cross-team Salesforce initiatives: architecture design, modernization, and refactors at scale.
  • PDLC/SDLC methodology – Deep familiarity applying structured Product/Software Development Life Cycle methodology to plan, govern, and deliver Salesforce releases.
  • Code migration – Hands-on experience managing code and configuration migration across sandboxes and production orgs, including release/version management and rollback planning.
  • Salesforce user maintenance – Experience with user provisioning, licensing, profiles, permission sets, and ongoing org administration.
  • AI development – Experience building AI-powered features or using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code and similar) as part of the daily engineering workflow to accelerate delivery.
  • Communication – Able to explain complex technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders with equal clarity.

Nice To Have (optional)

  • Avaya – Familiarity with Avaya telephony/CTI integration into Salesforce.
  • Databases – Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Cloud & CI/CD – Experience with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Google Cloud Platform – Hands-on experience with GCP services.
  • AI/ML on GCP – Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, and/or AutoML.

Minimum Education

  • The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.

Preferred Education

  • No additional education

  • 2

  • No additional years of experience

  • None

Preferred Leadership Experience

  • None

Certifications

  • None

Competencies

  • Global Perspective
  • Manages Ambiguity
  • Nimble Learning
  • Self-Development
  • Collaborates
  • Cultivates Innovation
  • Situational Adaptability
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Drives Results
  • Interpersonal Savvy
