Department Information

Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.

Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

Description of Job

IMPORTANT NOTE: Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.

As a Principal Developer at the Office of Information Technology (OIT), you will play a pivotal role in bridging agency vision with technical delivery, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture and long-term business goals. Operating across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), this role combines robust technical leadership with hands-on execution—mentoring engineering teams, establishing scalable development standards, and leading active modernization efforts to reduce technical debt. You will design secure, maintainable applications, ensure seamless deployment and operational stability, and uphold state-wide architectural and security mandates while driving quality, compliance, and velocity across matrixed development teams.

A successful candidate in this role is a seasoned technical leader and strategic problem solver who excels at bridging high-level enterprise vision with hands-on software execution. They thrive in matrixed environments, balancing multiple high-priority initiatives while driving engineering excellence, enforcing strict security and accessibility (WCAG 2.1) standards, and elevating team capabilities.

Key Attributes For Success Include

  • Strategic & Compliant Architecture: Ability to partner effectively with Solution Architects to design scalable, cloud-first, and accessible application platforms aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Skilled at inspiring developers, fostering professional growth, and guiding matrixed teams through complex development challenges.
  • Execution & Modernization Focus: Strong track record of technical debt reduction, predictable release delivery, continuous workflow optimization, and high system availability.
  • Pragmatic Evaluation & Problem Solving: Talent for translating complex business needs into future-proof software designs while objectively evaluating third-party products and infrastructure requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Architectural Alignment & Enterprise Compliance: Partner with Solution Architects to ensure all delivered applications strictly align with OIT enterprise standards (Cloud-First, Secure Colorado, Mobile-First), resulting in fully compliant, scalable, and secure systems.
  • Predictable Delivery & Multi-Task Execution: Provide precise technical estimations and roadmaps in collaboration with Business Analysts and Project Managers, while balancing multiple concurrent high-priority initiatives across OIT divisions to ensure key milestones are delivered on time and within scope.
  • High-Quality Execution & Technical Debt Reduction: Deliver robust, maintainable software components using modern Agile/Waterfall practices; enforce secure coding, rigorous unit testing, and mandatory peer reviews to reduce vulnerabilities, post-release defects, and technical debt.
  • Release Excellence & Production Transition: Build, validate, and package complete release builds to achieve defect-free execution during User Acceptance Testing (UAT), seamless production transitions, and high overall system availability.
  • Governance & Standard Adherence: Execute all development activities in strict accordance with service portfolio policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure organizational consistency.
  • Future-Proof Application Architecture: Select optimal technical approaches to meet current customer requirements while ensuring application scalability for future enhancements.
  • Continuous Process Optimization: Modernize software engineering workflows, policies, and templates, leading to improved team productivity, delivery standards, and operational transparency through advanced development and testing tooling.
  • Matrix Collaboration & Resource Management: Collaborate effectively across matrixed OIT teams, managing staff work assignments within a matrix supervisory structure to maximize resource alignment and productivity.
  • Innovative Problem Solving & Translation: Transform complex business requirements into high-performing software solutions while implementing efficient technical approaches for complex development challenges.
  • Strategic Vision & Domain Thought Leadership: Articulate a clear technical vision and provide thought leadership across OIT agency portfolios, inspiring engineering teams and aligning domain expertise with long-term architecture goals.
  • Mentorship & Engineering Culture: Mentor junior and senior developers to foster professional growth, deepen technical knowledge, and elevate team performance standards.Infrastructure Readiness: Proactively specify and secure necessary infrastructure resources (servers, storage, networking) to ensure environment readiness for development and testing phases.
  • Commercial Product Evaluation & Selection: Assess third-party commercial products objectively to streamline business process flows and deliver data-driven recommendations to OIT leadership for optimal product purchasing and integration decisions.
  • Operational Accountability: Maintain accurate time tracking and progress reporting in enterprise tools to provide clear project visibility to supervisors and management.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions Of Employment & Appeal Rights

A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of professional experience in software engineering, application development, or a closely related IT occupational field.
  • Proven technical leadership experience guiding software development teams, architecting enterprise solutions, and designing scalable system components across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Experience applying digital accessibility regulations and standards (e.g., WCAG 2.1) to business processes, content, tools, and/or documents, with the ability to provide specific examples of accessibility improvements made.

Substitutions

  • Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.
  • Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Salesforce Certified Application Architect.
  • 8+ years of professional experience designing, architecting, and developing enterprise solutions on the Salesforce.com platform.
  • Proven track record of technical leadership in large-scale Salesforce enterprise integrations, system architecture, and governance.
  • Advanced expertise in Salesforce deployment strategies, CI/CD pipeline implementation, and DevOps best practices.
  • Multi-cloud architecture experience across Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and enterprise integrations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel) and Microsoft Visio or the Google equivalent of this tool suite.

Conditions Of Employment

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

Supplemental Information

If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado.

While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.

Senior Salesforce Developer, Wharton Computing

Job Profile Title

Salesforce Developer Senior

  • Lead the strategic planning and implementation of transformative technology projects, focusing on application-based tools within Salesforce and related technologies, such as AccountingSeed, Airtable, Docusign, and more.

Establish seamless integration with other information management systems to foster a unified technical landscape.
  • Lead meticulous security model design and user management practice, including overseeing the activation of new users, managing user profile, role, and permission set structure, and implementing sophisticated security measures like Salesforce Shield. Lead comprehensive system maintenance, upgrade, and documentation projects. Proactively identify strategic improvement opportunities through system measurements and analysis, ensuring the continuous improvement of technical capabilities.
  • Champion end-to-end strategic initiatives, driving user adoption, maximizing value realization, and ensuring a high return on investment through top-tier support for Salesforce tools. Collaborate seamlessly with Wharton Computing, Finance & Administration, and business stakeholders to align technology initiatives with broader organizational objectives.

  • Comfortable writing Apex.

  • Experience using Jira to manage your workload.

Wharton School

Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.

You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.

Job Description

 Senior Salesforce Developer

Woodside, NY (Hybrid / Onsite preferred)

Chief Operating Officer

Full-Time, Exempt

About New York Edge

New York Edge is the largest provider of after-school and summer camp programs in New York City public schools. Each year, academic programs—including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access—help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

Position Overview

New York Edge is seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to own and advance our Salesforce platform from end to end. This hands-on senior role brings together four responsibilities: designing and building custom applications, administering the org, leading cross-departmental technology projects from discovery through go-live, and serving as our primary point of contact with Salesforce, implementation partners, and third-party technology vendors.

Salesforce supports critical operations across New York Edge, including program management, procurement, finance, and reporting. The right candidate will turn business needs into scalable solutions, run structured rollouts with real users across departments and sites, and make sure every release is tested, approved, documented, and supported.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Program Management

  • Lead Salesforce projects end to end: discovery, requirements, solution design, build, testing, deployment, training, and post-launch support
  • Plan and run phased rollouts by department, portfolio, or site group, including readiness checks, user access, training, and weekly milestones
  • Design and facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT): write test scenarios and acceptance criteria, coordinate testers, track defects, and manage remediation and retesting
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Finance, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, Budget, Program Managers, and site staff, to confirm owners, schedules, and sign-offs
  • Define testing guardrails and escalation paths, and make go/no-go recommendations based on documented approvals and acceptance criteria
  • Track estimated versus actual effort, risks, and blocking issues, and report project status clearly to leadership

Application Development

  • Design, build, and maintain custom Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and Platform Events
  • Automate end-to-end business processes such as purchase requests, multi-level approval routing based on dollar thresholds, record locking, self-approval restrictions, and order and invoice tracking
  • Build and support integrations with external platforms (e-procurement and vendor marketplaces, finance/ERP, and other business systems) using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, OAuth 2.0, and middleware
  • Engineer integrations to be reliable and auditable, with duplicate prevention, retry logic, error handling, and clear logging
  • Write bulkified, well-tested code that respects governor limits; lead code reviews and enforce development standards
  • Manage source control and deployments using Salesforce DX/CLI, Git, and a structured sandbox-to-production release process

Salesforce Administration

  • Own the health, security, and configuration of the org: users, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and field-level security
  • Manage sandboxes, release planning, change management, and Salesforce’s seasonal release updates
  • Maintain data quality through validation rules, duplicate management, data imports, and regular audits
  • Build reports and dashboards that give Finance, Purchasing, Program, and Executive teams accurate, timely visibility
  • Monitor system limits, licenses, integration errors, and automation failures; provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Serve as the primary liaison to Salesforce, implementation partners, AppExchange/ISV vendors, and third-party platforms that integrate with Salesforce
  • Scope work and review vendor statements of work (SOWs), estimates, and technical designs before approval
  • Hold vendors accountable to timelines, deliverables, and acceptance criteria; coordinate joint testing, cutover, and issue resolution

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

This role is based out of Johns Creeks GA or Northridge CA.

MIniMed is looking for a Principal SalesForce Developer who will set the technical direction for Salesforce development while staying hands‑on with complex engineering work. You define and enforce development standards, guide architectural decisions, and ensure all Salesforce solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. You review technical designs, oversee integrations, mentor developers, and drive consistent engineering quality across the team. You collaborate with cross‑functional partners to translate business needs into technical solutions, troubleshoot complex system issues, and maintain clear documentation to support long-term system health and maintainability.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of complex Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, automation tools, and integrations.
  • Proven experience with Integration Patterns, specifically connecting Salesforce with SAP and legacy systems.
  • Deep understanding of SSO and Identity Management protocols (e.g., SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).
  • Working experience with global, multi-region large enterprise data sets and complex environment management.
  • Experience implementing or working with AI technologies (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or LLM integrations).
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, development frameworks, best practices, and technical governance across the Salesforce team.
  • Conduct code reviews, manage pull requests, reduce technical debt, and ensure high code quality across all deliverables.
  • Provide hands-on development and refactoring support for complex or high-impact features.
  • Oversee Salesforce integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and data integration tools.
  • Partner with business analysts, architects, and project managers to translate requirements into well-defined technical specifications.
  • Mentor and guide developers at all levels, promoting strong engineering practices and professional growth.

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. At MiniMed, we are committed to supporting the well-being and financial security of our employees. Regular employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for a robust benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, as well as access to a Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, life insurance, long-term disability leave, and a dependent daycare spending account. In addition, all regular employees enjoy incentive plans, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term disability coverage, paid time off and holidays, participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and access to our Employee Assistance Program. Eligible employees may also benefit from our Non-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement and Capital Accumulation Plan, subject to IRS minimum earnings requirements. Please note that “regular employees” refers to those who are not temporary staff, such as interns, and some benefits may not apply to employees in Puerto Rico.

MiniMed is a full-stack insulin delivery company dedicated to supporting people living with diabetes through every step of their journey — when and how they need it. Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Job Description

Qualys, Inc is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based IT, security, and compliance solutions with over 10,000 active customers in more than 130 countries, including a majority of each of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. Qualys helps organizations streamline and consolidate their security and compliance solutions in a single platform and build security into digital transformation initiatives for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.

As a Salesforce Senior Principal Application Developer, you should have around 12–16 years of experience and a good understanding of the Salesforce platform end to end.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical design and architecture of complex Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ/Revenue Cloud and Experience Cloud.
  • Lead hands-on development in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and Flows, and act as the escalation point for the hardest technical problems.
  • Design scalable integrations with ERP, billing, marketing and data platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi).
  • Set and enforce coding standards, design patterns (trigger frameworks, separation of concerns), code review practices and security best practices.
  • Work with architects, product owners and business stakeholders to turn requirements into technical designs and estimates.
  • Mentor and grow a team of senior and mid-level developers through reviews, pairing and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Assess new Salesforce releases and features and recommend how to adopt them.
  • Reduce technical debt, and lead org health reviews, refactoring and platform optimization.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements, providing actionable feedback on specifications, design, and integration flows.
  • Actively engage in Agile ceremonies and support cross-functional collaboration to drive efficient project delivery.


Desired Skills & Experience:

  • Expert knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL and asynchronous Apex.
  • Experience with Flow automation at scale, including knowing when to use Flow and when to use Apex.
  • Deep experience with the Salesforce data model, the sharing and security model.
  • Proven integration experience: REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, OAuth, Platform Events, Streaming API and Bulk API.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Track record of delivering enterprise-scale Salesforce programs in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.


Soft Skills & Collaboration:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage cross-functional stakeholders and end users.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • A mentoring mindset, with a commitment to growing developers and building a strong engineering culture.
  • Ownership and accountability for delivery quality, production stability and stakeholder commitments.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s, degree in computer science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 12–16 years of software development experience, with at least 8+ years building on the Salesforce platform.
  • Experience with Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, and/or CPQ Clouds.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay current with Salesforce platform updates and innovations.
  • Active involvement in the Salesforce community is a plus.


Work Location:

The position is based at our U.S. headquarters, with in-office presence required in accordance with company policy.

The salary range for this position is $175,000 - $200,000 per year. Final compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, relevant experience, and work location. Please note this range reflects base salary and does not include incentive compensation or potential equity grants. We also offer a comprehensive and highly competitive benefits package.

Qualys is an Equal Opportunity Employer, please see our EEO policy.

Primary Objective of Position: The Salesforce Engineer owns the design, delivery, integration, administration, and optimization of the Winnebago Motorhome Salesforce platform. This techno-functional role translates business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions, supports enterprise integrations, and presents solution strategy, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders to enable informed decision-making.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Project Delivery & Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and platform capabilities.
  • Lead technical delivery of Salesforce projects from requirements through deployment.
  • Support integrations using MuleSoft, APIs, Platform Events, and other enterprise integration technologies.
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing recommendations for scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
  • Operate independently through ambiguous or complex work, balancing business priorities, technical constraints, and delivery timelines.
  • Support Agile planning, estimation, and sprint execution.
  • Conduct code reviews and enforce development standards.
  • Manage Salesforce environments, deployments, source control, and CI/CD processes.

Application Support

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues and provide advanced user support.
  • Partner with stakeholders to prioritize defects, enhancements, and continuous improvement opportunities based on business impact.
  • Apply techno-functional expertise to understand business processes, assess platform impacts, and recommend practical Salesforce solutions.
  • Maintain Salesforce security, data integrity, and system performance.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve business processes through automation and platform enhancements.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, testing artifacts, and solution designs.
  • Train and mentor designated business users and citizen administrators on approved Salesforce configuration, data management and administrative activities.
  • Promote Salesforce best practices, governance standards, and user adoption across the organization.
  • Evaluate new Salesforce releases, features, and emerging technologies for business value and platform optimization.
  • Generate test plans, create test cases, and maintain changes in appropriate test environments.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Critical Competencies

  • Strong experience with Salesforce Platform development including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and Lightning Experience.
  • Experience implementing enterprise integrations using MuleSoft, REST APIs, Platform Events, and middleware technologies.
  • Proficiency in SOQL, SQL, and data analysis techniques.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce DX, Git, Azure DevOps, JIRA, Gearset, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, sharing, permissions, and governance.
  • Experience leading technical project delivery and mentoring development teams.
  • Excellent problem solving, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical topics for business stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Ability to present solution options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional teams and senior leadership audiences.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Industry Clouds (such as Automotive Cloud) preferred.
  • Ability to evaluate Salesforce platform features and emerging technologies for practical business value.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5-8+ years Salesforce application development experience.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce administration, configuration, security, and data management.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification preferred. Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer II, App Builder, and MuleSoft certifications are a plus.
  • Experience designing and implementing Salesforce solutions utilizing Flow, MuleSoft, APIs, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience leading projects and providing technical guidance to development teams.
  • Experience working within Agile software delivery environments.

This posting includes a range of the salary across a geographical market. The base pay for this position ranges from $120,000.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to $130,000.00/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Dependent on the position other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. For more information, please visit https://www.winnebagoind.com/careers/total-rewards.

Description

Join the Fun at Arrow International!

Arrow International is the world’s #1 maker of charitable gaming products, from pull tabs and bingo paper to cutting-edge electronic gaming systems. Our products power entertainment in social and gaming venues around the globe—and we’re growing fast!

We're building a winning culture that’s all about teamwork, passion, and innovation. At Arrow, you’re not just another employee, you’re part of a high-performing team that’s redefining fun and giving back to communities. We believe in rewarding your hard work with profit-sharing, 401(k) matching, great benefits, and paid time off including a bonus week every July!

If you're looking for a career that’s exciting, meaningful, and full of opportunity, Arrow is the place to be.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Salesforce developer to lead development and contribute to the architecture and growth of our Salesforce platform. This dynamic position is responsible for how Salesforce is built, how its data is structured, how it connects to our other systems, and how much value the business gets from it. You will work side by side with existing Salesforce Administrators and Developers who bring deep knowledge of Arrow's business, users, and processes, and together you will find and put to work the Salesforce capabilities we already pay for but underuse.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

The Platform

  • Partner with the Director of IT to shape the Salesforce roadmap and make technical decisions.
  • Maintain the health of the Salesforce org, including release management, sandbox strategy, technical debt, performance, and the security model.
  • Review configuration and code changes, including work done by Administrators, Developers, and other team members.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Sales/Marketing, and Communications to translate business needs into platform solutions.

The Technology

  • Design and build custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and APIs.
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other systems, including SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake, and proprietary Arrow applications.
  • Evaluate build-versus-configure-versus-buy decisions and recommend the right approach.
  • Support new and updated integrations with Salesforce.

The Data

  • Define and maintain the data model, object relationships, and field standards.
  • Set data quality, governance, deduplication, and migration practices.
  • Ensure Salesforce data flows reliably to and from reporting and enterprise systems.
  • Work with the BI and data engineering teams so Salesforce data is trustworthy for analytics.

Best Practices

  • Contribute to development, naming, documentation, testing, and deployment standards, and help the team follow them.
  • Maintain change control for Salesforce, including source control and CI/CD where appropriate.
  • Maintain a clear separation of duties for security, permissions, and production changes.
  • Document the platform, including architecture, integrations, automations, and decisions.

Underused Capabilities

  • Audit current feature usage and licensing against what Arrow already owns.
  • Identify, prioritize, and stand up capabilities the business is not yet using.
  • Build the business case for each capability, then deliver it, train users, and measure adoption.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases and recommend what is worth adopting.

The Team

  • Mentor existing Salesforce Administrators and Developers as they grow into deeper development, architecture, and platform strategy.
  • Share knowledge so platform expertise is not concentrated in one person.
  • Partner with other IT resources to build a broader bench of people who can contribute to the platform.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Requirements

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including 2 years in a developer role.
  • Strong Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components, and Flow experience.
  • Proven experience designing and building integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or ETL tools.
  • Solid grasp of Salesforce data modeling, security architecture, and data migration.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience with deployment tooling and source control (for example Salesforce DX, Git, and a CI/CD pipeline).
  • Track record of defining and enforcing development standards, code review, and governance.
  • Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and win their buy-in.

Preferred Experience And Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification; Platform Developer II or an architect certification a plus.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP (S/4HANA), Snowflake, or AS400/legacy systems.
  • Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Data Cloud.
  • Experience supporting a platform through an ERP migration.
  • Hands-on experience with Agentforce and other Salesforce AI capabilities (for example Einstein and generative AI features).
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools consuming Salesforce data.
  • Background in a regulated industry such as gaming, finance, or nonprofit fundraising.

Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At Arrow International, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that embracing our differences makes us stronger, more innovative, and better positioned to serve our communities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome, supported, and empowered to succeed.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Arrow International is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals in all job titles without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, results of genetic testing, veteran status, or physical or mental disability—except where such disability prevents performance of essential job functions and cannot be reasonably accommodated in accordance with applicable laws.

Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Statement

Arrow International is committed to complying with the spirit and requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, participate in the interview process, undergo any pre-employment testing, or otherwise take part in the employee selection process, please contact us at recruiting@arrowinternational.com.

To ensure a safe and productive work environment, all candidates who receive a conditional job offer must successfully pass a confidential pre-employment drug screening, which generally consists of a hair drug test, and receive an acceptable result as a condition of employment.

Arrow International does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies. Resumes submitted without an approved vendor agreement will become the property of Arrow International, and no fees will be paid if the candidate is hired.

We are seeking a Salesforce Developer to help develop and support technology solutions within a clinical laboratory environment. This position will work across Salesforce, laboratory information systems, middleware, diagnostic instruments, and other healthcare applications to improve connectivity, automation, data flow, and operational reliability.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of software development, systems integration, and healthcare technology and can take ownership of both new development and production support.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, enhance, test, and maintain applications and technology solutions supporting laboratory and healthcare operations.
  • Build and maintain interfaces connecting laboratory instruments, LIS/LIMS platforms, Salesforce, EHRs, and other enterprise systems.
  • Develop integrations using technologies such as HL7, ASTM, REST APIs, web services, and other interface protocols.

  • Troubleshoot application, integration, database, and workflow issues across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Participate in implementations, system upgrades, releases, testing, validation, and deployment activities.
  • Work closely with laboratory operations, IT, business users, vendors, and other technical teams to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.

descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Salesforce Developer at Anthropic, you will design, build, and maintain the Salesforce platform that powers our core customer motions and quote-to-cash business.: This includes automation throughout the Salesforce platform ranging from core sales automation to product catalog and pricing, quoting and approvals, order and contract management, and the handoff to billing and provisioning. You'll work both autonomously and collaboratively across RevOps, Order Management, Legal, Billing Engineering, Deal Desk, Finance and Accounting, and Product to translate pricing and packaging requirements into scalable Apex, Flow, and integration solutions, and to extend our capabilities with custom code where necessary. We are an AI-first systems team, and you'll be expected to use Claude and our in-house AI development tooling as a core part of how you write, review, and ship code, always against our house standards for flexibility, maintainability, and scale.

Where you might sit

We're hiring across more than one team. Placement depends on your background and where you can have the most impact.

GTM Systems: Builds and runs the Salesforce platform and connected tools that Anthropic's sellers, sales leaders, and revenue operations teams rely on every day. You'd build the automation behind how deals move through the pipeline, how leads and accounts reach the right owner, and how information flows between our sales tools and the rest of the business. You'll work directly with the analysts and operators who define the process, and see the impact on the people who use what you ship.

QTC Experiences: A vertically integrated team that spans quoting through to provisioning agreements, as well as customer billing experiences over the term of their agreement. You'd build the foundational systems for CPQ, order management, provisioning and billing experiences, envisioning how we make our sellers and ops teams orders of magnitude more efficient with Claude. You'll work cross-functionally with GTM, finance, accounting and other stakeholders. Your work will directly impact seller velocity and our GTM deal making capacity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Apex (triggers, services, selectors, batch/queueable), Lightning Web Components, and Flow automation following our house Apex standards and trigger framework
  • Design and build quote-to-cash infrastructure in Salesforce, including the product catalog and pricing data model, quote and order lifecycle, discount and approval automation, and amendment, renewal, and co-termination flows
  • Extend CPQ and expand into agentic selling with custom pricing and quote-calculation logic, quote and order user experiences, and code built against the package's APIs and data model
  • Build and own integrations between Salesforce and our billing, provisioning, and finance systems, such as Stripe, Metronome, and NetSuite, directly or via middleware
  • Support new product and pricing launches by modeling catalog, SKU, and pricing changes so they can be released quickly and reflected consistently in every downstream system
  • Use Claude and our internal AI development tooling as a first-class part of your build and code-review workflow
  • Partner with Business Systems analysts and Finance to ensure data-model decisions support downstream bookings, forecasting, and revenue reporting
  • Partner with DevOps on release management for your work: sandbox strategy, source control, peer review, and deployment via SFDX/metadata tooling
  • Ensure appropriate controls, test coverage, and documentation are in place for an effective control environment, particularly around pricing, discounting, and contract changes
  • Operate with ambiguity in a rapidly changing business, resolve problems independently, and propose solutions that scale

Minimum Qualifications

  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, SOQL, LWC, Flow) in a production org
  • Experience building or extending CPQ and quote-to-cash functionality in Salesforce (Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, Nue, or similar): product and pricing data models, quote and order lifecycle, approval automation, and amendments and renewals, including custom code written against the CPQ package rather than configuration alone
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with billing, ERP, or provisioning systems via REST/Bulk APIs, middleware (Workato, Mulesoft, or similar), or direct callouts
  • Fluency with SFDX, source-controlled metadata, and a sandbox-to-prod release process with peer review
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you write and review code, and the ability to speak to how you steer and verify their output
  • Basic SQL skills and comfort working alongside a data warehouse
  • Effective communication with sales, deal desk, finance and accounting, product, and engineering stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications
  • Advanced Administrator or Application/System Architect certification
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform constraints: governor limits, bulkification, sharing and visibility, recursion control, and how they surface in CPQ-specific situations such as large quotes, calculation performance, and bulk amendments
  • Experience implementing a CPQ solution end to end or re-platforming from one CPQ to another, not just maintaining an existing one
  • Experience with billing and finance platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, or Oracle, and with usage-based or consumption pricing models
  • Working understanding of how CPQ design decisions flow through to bookings, invoicing, and revenue recognition
  • Proven experience scaling Salesforce in a high-growth GTM environment

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$270,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We're hiring across more than one team. Placement depends on your background and where you can have the most impact.

GTM Systems: Builds and runs the Salesforce platform and connected tools that Anthropic's sellers, sales leaders, and revenue operations teams rely on every day. You'd build the automation behind how deals move through the pipeline, how leads and accounts reach the right owner, and how information flows between our sales tools and the rest of the business. You'll work directly with the analysts and operators who define the process, and see the impact on the people who use what you ship.

QTC Experiences: A vertically integrated team that spans quoting through to provisioning agreements, as well as customer billing experiences over the term of their agreement. You'd build the foundational systems for CPQ, order management, provisioning and billing experiences, envisioning how we make our sellers and ops teams orders of magnitude more efficient with Claude. You'll work cross-functionally with GTM, finance, accounting and other stakeholders. Your work will directly impact seller velocity and our GTM deal making capacity.

Key Responsibilities



- Develop and maintain Apex (triggers, services, selectors, batch/queueable), Lightning Web Components, and Flow automation following our house Apex standards and trigger framework
- Design and build quote-to-cash infrastructure in Salesforce, including the product catalog and pricing data model, quote and order lifecycle, discount and approval automation, and amendment, renewal, and co-termination flows
- Extend CPQ and expand into agentic selling with custom pricing and quote-calculation logic, quote and order user experiences, and code built against the package's APIs and data model
- Build and own integrations between Salesforce and our billing, provisioning, and finance systems, such as Stripe, Metronome, and NetSuite, directly or via middleware
- Support new product and pricing launches by modeling catalog, SKU, and pricing changes so they can be released quickly and reflected consistently in every downstream system
- Use Claude and our internal AI development tooling as a first-class part of your build and code-review workflow
- Partner with Business Systems analysts and Finance to ensure data-model decisions support downstream bookings, forecasting, and revenue reporting
- Partner with DevOps on release management for your work: sandbox strategy, source control, peer review, and deployment via SFDX/metadata tooling
- Ensure appropriate controls, test coverage, and documentation are in place for an effective control environment, particularly around pricing, discounting, and contract changes
- Operate with ambiguity in a rapidly changing business, resolve problems independently, and propose solutions that scale

Minimum Qualifications



- Hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, SOQL, LWC, Flow) in a production org
- Experience building or extending CPQ and quote-to-cash functionality in Salesforce (Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, Nue, or similar): product and pricing data models, quote and order lifecycle, approval automation, and amendments and renewals, including custom code written against the CPQ package rather than configuration alone
- Experience integrating Salesforce with billing, ERP, or provisioning systems via REST/Bulk APIs, middleware (Workato, Mulesoft, or similar), or direct callouts
- Fluency with SFDX, source-controlled metadata, and a sandbox-to-prod release process with peer review
- Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you write and review code, and the ability to speak to how you steer and verify their output
- Basic SQL skills and comfort working alongside a data warehouse
- Effective communication with sales, deal desk, finance and accounting, product, and engineering stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications



- Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications
- Advanced Administrator or Application/System Architect certification
- Deep understanding of Salesforce platform constraints: governor limits, bulkification, sharing and visibility, recursion control, and how they surface in CPQ-specific situations such as large quotes, calculation performance, and bulk amendments
- Experience implementing a CPQ solution end to end or re-platforming from one CPQ to another, not just maintaining an existing one
- Experience with billing and finance platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, or Oracle, and with usage-based or consumption pricing models
- Working understanding of how CPQ design decisions flow through to bookings, invoicing, and revenue recognition
- Proven experience scaling Salesforce in a high-growth GTM environment

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$270,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Position Type

Staff

There are four positions available for this role.

Position / Job Summary

The Salesforce Developer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports secure, scalable solutions on the College's Salesforce platform. The role translates approved business and technical requirements into high-quality configurations, custom applications, integrations, and automated processes that improve constituent experience and operational effectiveness. The Salesforce Developer collaborates with product owners, business analysts, architects, administrators, integration developers, quality assurance resources, and support teams throughout the solution lifecycle, while maintaining technical documentation and following established governance, security, accessibility, release, and change-management standards.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Salesforce solutions using declarative tools and custom development, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, validation rules, permission configurations, and platform events, as appropriate.
  • Translate approved user stories, functional requirements, process maps, and technical designs into maintainable Salesforce solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, platform standards, and release priorities.
  • Develop and support integration between Salesforce and enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, event-driven patterns, secure file exchanges, and other approved integration methods.
  • Participate in solution design reviews, backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, release readiness activities, demonstrations, and retrospectives within the College's delivery framework.
  • Create unit tests and support system, integration, regression, performance, security, accessibility, and user acceptance testing; troubleshoot defects and implement timely corrective actions.
  • Apply Salesforce security and data-access controls, including profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, field-level security, and secure coding practices, in accordance with college privacy and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Support data quality and stewardship through sound data models, validation, duplicate prevention, exception handling, migration support, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Maintain source control, deployment pipelines, environment configurations, technical specifications, runbooks, release notes, and other documentation needed for reliable operations and knowledge transfer.
  • Monitor application health and resolve production incidents, service requests, defects, and performance issues in partnership with platform administrators, support teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Evaluate Salesforce seasonal releases, managed-package updates, technical debt, and platform changes; recommend and implement approved enhancements that improve reliability, usability, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate respectfully with cross-functional teams, communicate risks and dependencies early, and provide clear status updates on assigned work, issues, and delivery commitments.
  • Follow College policies, development standards, change controls, records requirements, and responsible practices for handling confidential student, employee, and institutional data.
  • Required Dallas College Professional Development Hours per Academic Year.
    • All employees are required to complete a minimum of 19 hours.
    • People leaders are required to have an additional 16 hours of leadership development.
  • Perform other duties not listed as assigned.
Minimum And Preferred – Education, Experience, And/or Certifications

Required Qualifications for Role (necessary or mandatory)

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field plus three (3) years of application development experience, including at least two (2) years developing or configuring solutions on the Salesforce platform; or a comparable combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience developing with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flow, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Experience with software development, lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification, or the ability to obtain it within twelve (12) months of hire.
  • Ability to maintain the security or integrity of the critical infrastructure of Dallas College.

Other Preferred Qualifications For Role (not Mandatory, But Advantageous)

  • Experience supporting Salesforce Education Cloud, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or other Salesforce products used in higher education.
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling, Salesforce DX, Git-based development, automated testing, DevOps practices, and release management.
  • Experience developing integrations using REST or SOAP APIs, middleware platforms, event-driven architecture, and secure data-exchange patterns.
  • Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, or related Salesforce certifications.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Required Qualifications for Role (necessary or mandatory)

  • Knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, limits, metadata, security model, data model, development patterns, and deployment approaches.
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming, web technologies, API design, integration concepts, relational data, and cloud application development.
  • Ability to write clear, secure, maintainable, and testable code and to select declarative configuration when it offers the best long-term solution.
  • Ability to analyze requirements, identify gaps and dependencies, estimate work, troubleshoot complex issues, and communicate solution options and tradeoffs.
  • Ability to create and execute unit tests, interpret logs and error messages, perform root-cause analysis, and resolve defects across environments.
  • Ability to work effectively in agile or iterative delivery teams, manage multiple assignments, meet commitments, and adapt to shifting priorities.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to developers, administrators, analysts, functional stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.
  • Commitment to accessibility, privacy, security, data stewardship, ethical practice, documentation, continuous improvement, and constituent-centered service.

Other Preferred Qualifications For Role (not Mandatory, But Advantageous)

  • Knowledge of higher education business processes, student services, case management, constituent engagement, marketing automation, and enterprise integration patterns.

Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Vision and Direction
  • Business Acumen
  • Developing and Empowering People
  • Technology and Data Stewardship
  • Accountability and Performance Management
  • Communication and Collaboration
  • Enterprise Partnership and Influence
  • Operational Excellence
  • Change and Innovation Leadership

  • Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving
  • Application Development and Technical Quality
  • Collaboration and Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Continuous Learning and Innovation
  • Customer and Constituent Focus
  • Data, Privacy, and Security Stewardship
  • Operational Excellence
  • Planning and Prioritization

Work Condition Environment / Physical Requirements

Normal physical job functions are performed within a standard office environment. Work hours may occasionally extend beyond the regular Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. workday, including evenings, weekends, or holidays, to support planned releases, maintenance activities, or critical incidents. descriptionHtml:
As a Salesforce Engineer at vCluster Labs, you will own the Salesforce backend behind our revenue team. Most of your time goes into building and maintaining the flows, formulas, scripts, and automations that take manual work off our AEs and move us toward a self-serve sales environment. We are a Series A company, so you will also take on revenue operations and deal desk work for our US team: quote-to-cash, reporting, and helping reps get deals set up right. The core structure is already in place, so you start from a working foundation with real room to shape what we build next.

vCluster Labs is the company behind vCluster, which provisions fully isolated tenant clusters on Kubernetes, bare metal, and VMs for AI Clouds, enterprises, and platform teams.

As a Salesforce Engineer, Your Role Will Include

  • Salesforce engineering and automation: You will design, build, and maintain Salesforce flows, formulas, scripts, and automations, and fix what breaks. If it can be automated, we automate it, and you will help decide how.
  • GTM systems integrations: You will keep Salesforce connected to the rest of our GTM stack, including Ironclad, QuotaPath, and the Stripe to Salesforce ARR sync.
  • Deal desk and quote-to-cash: When a quote or order form looks wrong, you are the first responder. You will own quote line items, term-length logic, and order forms in Salesforce, and keep our Ironclad contract workflows running.
  • Rep support and enablement: You will own the Salesforce request queue during US hours and help AEs, especially new hires, set up deals correctly. The best version of this role teaches reps how our Salesforce works and builds toward a self-serve setup, so the same question does not come back twice.
  • Commissions: You will support QuotaPath and how reps get paid, partnering with our COO on deal reviews and resolving pay discrepancies.
  • Reporting and dashboards: You will keep pipeline, renewal, ARR, and territory dashboards accurate, answer “why does this number look off,” and build new views as sales leadership asks for them.
  • Data hygiene and documentation: You will own recurring data fixes and keep our RevOps process docs current, so how we quote, approve, and report is written down and repeatable.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Salesforce engineering experience: 3+ years building on Salesforce, as a Salesforce engineer, developer, or admin, or in a RevOps or sales ops role with hands-on build work. You have built and maintained flows, formulas, scripts, and automations and can walk us through what you built and why. Experience writing code is a plus. Certification is not required; real build experience is.
  • Quote-to-cash fluency: You understand how revenue flows through a CRM, from quote line items to order forms to booked ARR.
  • Reporting instincts: You build Salesforce reports and dashboards, reconcile numbers across systems, and can explain a discrepancy clearly to a sales leader.
  • B2B SaaS background: You know how SaaS deals are structured and how revenue is recognized.
  • Openness to RevOps and deal desk: Most of your time is technical, but at a Series A you also jump in on AE questions, deal setup, and enablement, and you turn requests around in hours rather than days.
  • Resourcefulness: When you have not built something before, you figure it out, including using AI tools like Claude to get there faster.

Bonus Points For

  • Ironclad: Experience with Ironclad or another contract lifecycle tool.
  • Commissions tooling: Hands-on time in QuotaPath or a similar tool.
  • Salesforce certifications or CPQ experience: Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Developer certifications, or CPQ experience, are a plus, not a requirement.
  • Tableau or early-stage experience: Tableau experience, or you have helped scale RevOps at an early-stage company.

Why You Will Love This Role

  • Build on a working foundation: Our core processes are in place, and you will have real input into the automations and self-serve tools we build next.
  • See the whole company: You will work hands-on across the full GTM tech stack and support sales, marketing, partners, finance, and leadership.
  • Grow with us: Join early at an inflection point, with room to shape your path, including building and leading a team as we scale.

About VCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For

  • Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
  • Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
  • Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
  • Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
  • Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.
