As a Salesforce Engineer at vCluster Labs, you will own the Salesforce backend behind our revenue team. Most of your time goes into building and maintaining the flows, formulas, scripts, and automations that take manual work off our AEs and move us toward a self-serve sales environment. We are a Series A company, so you will also take on revenue operations and deal desk work for our US team: quote-to-cash, reporting, and helping reps get deals set up right. The core structure is already in place, so you start from a working foundation with real room to shape what we build next.

vCluster Labs is the company behind vCluster, which provisions fully isolated tenant clusters on Kubernetes, bare metal, and VMs for AI Clouds, enterprises, and platform teams.

As a Salesforce Engineer, Your Role Will Include



- Salesforce engineering and automation: You will design, build, and maintain Salesforce flows, formulas, scripts, and automations, and fix what breaks. If it can be automated, we automate it, and you will help decide how.
- GTM systems integrations: You will keep Salesforce connected to the rest of our GTM stack, including Ironclad, QuotaPath, and the Stripe to Salesforce ARR sync.
- Deal desk and quote-to-cash: When a quote or order form looks wrong, you are the first responder. You will own quote line items, term-length logic, and order forms in Salesforce, and keep our Ironclad contract workflows running.
- Rep support and enablement: You will own the Salesforce request queue during US hours and help AEs, especially new hires, set up deals correctly. The best version of this role teaches reps how our Salesforce works and builds toward a self-serve setup, so the same question does not come back twice.
- Commissions: You will support QuotaPath and how reps get paid, partnering with our COO on deal reviews and resolving pay discrepancies.
- Reporting and dashboards: You will keep pipeline, renewal, ARR, and territory dashboards accurate, answer “why does this number look off,” and build new views as sales leadership asks for them.
- Data hygiene and documentation: You will own recurring data fixes and keep our RevOps process docs current, so how we quote, approve, and report is written down and repeatable.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:



- Salesforce engineering experience: 3+ years building on Salesforce, as a Salesforce engineer, developer, or admin, or in a RevOps or sales ops role with hands-on build work. You have built and maintained flows, formulas, scripts, and automations and can walk us through what you built and why. Experience writing code is a plus. Certification is not required; real build experience is.
- Quote-to-cash fluency: You understand how revenue flows through a CRM, from quote line items to order forms to booked ARR.
- Reporting instincts: You build Salesforce reports and dashboards, reconcile numbers across systems, and can explain a discrepancy clearly to a sales leader.
- B2B SaaS background: You know how SaaS deals are structured and how revenue is recognized.
- Openness to RevOps and deal desk: Most of your time is technical, but at a Series A you also jump in on AE questions, deal setup, and enablement, and you turn requests around in hours rather than days.
- Resourcefulness: When you have not built something before, you figure it out, including using AI tools like Claude to get there faster.

Bonus Points For



- Ironclad: Experience with Ironclad or another contract lifecycle tool.
- Commissions tooling: Hands-on time in QuotaPath or a similar tool.
- Salesforce certifications or CPQ experience: Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Developer certifications, or CPQ experience, are a plus, not a requirement.
- Tableau or early-stage experience: Tableau experience, or you have helped scale RevOps at an early-stage company.

Why You Will Love This Role



- Build on a working foundation: Our core processes are in place, and you will have real input into the automations and self-serve tools we build next.
- See the whole company: You will work hands-on across the full GTM tech stack and support sales, marketing, partners, finance, and leadership.
- Grow with us: Join early at an inflection point, with room to shape your path, including building and leading a team as we scale.

About VCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:



- Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
- Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
- Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
- Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For



- Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
- Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
- Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
- Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
- Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Description

Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites. Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Amazon Leo Government (ALG) supports government customers by developing solutions and capabilities that address their unique connectivity, procurement, and operational requirements.

As a Salesforce Engineer supporting Amazon Leo Government, you will design, develop, and implement scalable CRM and CPQ solutions that enable critical government sales, business development, and contracting processes. You will work extensively with Salesforce Sales Cloud capabilities, including Lead, Account, Contact, and Opportunity Management, CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), and custom application development using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and other Salesforce platform technologies.

You will contribute to the development and enhancement of ALG Salesforce applications, including adapting CRM and CPQ data models to a common Salesforce organizational data model, implementing secure data access controls, and enabling government-specific workflows such as RFI/RFP management, opportunity capture, and partner co-selling programs.

You will also contribute to Generative AI-powered CRM solutions using AWS Bedrock, leveraging AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Salesforce integrations to automate business processes, enhance productivity, and improve customer experiences. The role involves designing and implementing secure, scalable API integrations between Salesforce, AWS services, third-party applications, and internal enterprise systems.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, technical program managers, engineering managers, and software engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. You will drive engineering best practices across application design, development, testing, CI/CD, security, production support, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate will pioneer mechanisms and processes to improve engineering velocity, scalability, and reliability while embracing emerging technologies and AI-assisted development practices. This fast-paced team offers significant opportunities for self-motivated engineers who thrive on technical challenges, enjoy building innovative solutions, prioritize exceptional customer experiences, and take ownership of complex initiatives from design through production delivery.

Key job responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Design: Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to design and architect scalable Salesforce solutions supporting ALG Lead, Account, Contact, and Opportunity Management, CPQ, contract management, and government sales processes. Produce technical design artifacts, including system architecture diagrams, solution design documents, API specifications, and data models.

Salesforce Application Development: Design, develop, and enhance ALG Salesforce CRM and CPQ applications using Sales Cloud, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, SOQL, and other platform capabilities. Adapt existing ALG CRM and CPQ data models to a common Salesforce organizational data model while maintaining support for government-specific business processes.

Government Sales and Capture Processes: Design and implement Salesforce capabilities supporting ALG government business development, RFI/RFP management, opportunity capture processes, and partner sales and co-selling programs. Build configurable workflows and applications that support government sales lifecycle requirements.

Salesforce Data Security and Access Management: Design and implement secure Salesforce data access models for ALG, including role hierarchies, sharing rules, permission sets, and other Salesforce security controls. Ensure appropriate access and isolation of government-related CRM and CPQ data within the shared Salesforce organization.

Generative AI and Intelligent Automation: Design and implement AI-powered CRM solutions leveraging AWS Bedrock, including AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent workflow automation. Integrate GenAI capabilities with Salesforce applications to improve operational efficiency and user productivity.

Enterprise Integrations: Architect and develop secure, scalable API integrations between Salesforce, AWS services, third-party applications, and internal enterprise systems. Apply integration patterns and best practices to ensure reliable data exchange and interoperability.

DevOps, Security, and Operational Excellence: Implement and deploy solutions using CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and enterprise security best practices. Own maintenance, production support, troubleshooting, and ongoing enhancements for ALG Salesforce applications. Optimize system performance and ensure application reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead for ALG Salesforce CRM and CPQ applications, driving architecture decisions, conducting code and design reviews, establishing engineering best practices, and proactively managing technical debt.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, technical program managers, engineering managers, and software engineers to translate ALG business requirements into technical solutions and deliver complex initiatives from design through production.

Mentorship and Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, provide technical guidance, promote knowledge sharing, and drive continuous improvements in engineering quality and development velocity.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About The Team

The Amazon Leo Global Business Operations (GBO) team is responsible for driving business strategy, product management, customer adoption, system development and operations for Leo's commercial business.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
  • Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
  • Experience with Linux/Unix

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Consumer & Community Banking, JPM Wealth Management Technology team, you will be part of a team that owns end-to-end technical execution (design through production support), supports architectural evaluations with internal and external partners, and helps modernize platforms through automation, optimization, and capabilities including AI/LLM and Agentforce. You will also support and build Java microservices and React-based UI applications for use cases outside the Salesforce ecosystem as business needs arise.

Job Responsibilities

  • Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
  • Designs, develops, and troubleshoots software solutions on the Salesforce platform (including Apex, LWC, and Lightning Connect) and breaks down complex technical problems using practical, effective approaches
  • Builds secure, production-grade code; reviews, debugs, and improves code written by others
  • Designs and builds Java-based microservices (e.g., Spring Boot) and React-based UI components for applications outside the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Identifies recurring issues and implements elimination/automation strategies to improve the operational stability of applications and systems
  • Contributes to communities of practice to drive awareness and adoption of emerging technologies across software engineering, including Salesforce, full-stack, and cloud-native patterns
  • Contributes to a team culture rooted in diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts, with 3+ years of applied experience.
  • Hands-on experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability for Salesforce-based applications.
  • Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment using modern programming languages and database querying languages.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation, with the ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, secure handling of inputs and outputs, resiliency, and security requirements, with the ability to guide peers on safe and effective AI usage.
  • Strong knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, CI/CD, application resiliency, and security.
  • Strong Salesforce development experience is required, with deep expertise in Agentforce and AI/LLM capabilities, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Triggers, Flows, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), REST APIs, web callouts, and integrations.
  • Working proficiency in full-stack Java development, including building microservices using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, as well as experience with modern UI frameworks such as React, to support applications beyond the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Strong communication skills and executive presence, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts, end-to-end system functionality, and the rationale behind architectural and design decisions.
  • Proven experience working with large data volumes, performance tuning, and platform/application optimization.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Financial services industry experience.
  • Experience building or integrating cloud-native applications, including AWS.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Bitbucket, and source/version control systems.
  • Salesforce certifications and/or Java/Spring or equivalent full-stack credentials.
  • Experience with API gateways, service mesh, or event-driven architecture patterns.
  • Experience designing or integrating AI-driven features within Salesforce or full-stack applications.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, integration, and application architecture patterns

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Our Salesforce instance is of great importance to us, therefore you should keep the wider organization’s best interests in mind composing and deploying any code.

Required

Qualifications and Background

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud, Field Service Management, Service Cloud, and Marketing cloud product knowledge and at least 3 - 5 years of Salesforce development experience
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Java
  • Ability to write, interpret, and critique technical specifications
  • Able to work independently
  • Able to collaborate and communicate effectively with business stakeholders / other Salesforce team members
  • Able to gather requirements and present solutions to stakeholders
  • Certified Salesforce Platform Developer I

  • Additional Salesforce certifications e.g. Certified Salesforce Administrator, Certified Salesforce Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, Mobile application Developer
  • Competency in other languages / development (XML, Flex, .NET, SQL, C++, SOAP-based web services,
  • Demonstrates continued personal/professional development
  • Active in the Salesforce community
  • Bachelor’s/Postgraduate degree, professional qualification, or relevant experience

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Yoga Alliance is the largest nonprofit membership association of yoga professionals, practitioners, and advocates around the globe. We believe if more people practice yoga, the better the world will be. We’re here to amplify the power of yoga and to make it accessible to anyone wherever they are, under whatever circumstances by:

  • Uplifting the transformative power of yoga,
  • Surfacing and reducing barriers to the practice, and
  • Building, engaging, and supporting the yoga community.

Our member-driven community is a diverse collective of wisdom holders, yoga educators, and teachers expanding their expertise; a welcoming space for those newly exploring yoga; a place for seasoned practitioners to deepen their practice; and a supportive hub where community leaders, organizations, and businesses can leverage yoga for social good.

At the core of Yoga Alliance lies a profound commitment to our people. Here, every team member is empowered to lead, innovate, dream, create, and grow. Diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility and belonging guide our way of being in work and in working with each other. We champion a culture of collaboration, where learning from failures is as valued as achieving success. Together, we challenge the status quo and push the boundaries of what is possible.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience Yoga Alliance is seeking a Salesforce Developer to join our team.

Salesforce is the backbone of how we serve our members -- it holds their critical information and powers credentialing, membership, and communications. Yoga Alliance is adding this newly created role to its team to give the platform a dedicated in-house owner who can strengthen and grow Salesforce over time. Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience, this role will partner cross-functionally with internal teams and externally with the implementation partner to ensure the Salesforce environment is reliable and stable, as well as manage day-to-day requests from members and staff, and help deliver the improvements on the product roadmap.

What You Will Do:

Administration and Configuration

  • Own incident response during renewals, launches, and peak periods, making time-sensitive calls and coordinating fixes with the external partner when needed
  • Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles, and license assignments across the organization
  • Build and maintain declarative automation with Flow, validation rules, and approval processes
  • Configure objects, fields, page layouts, record types, and Lightning App pages
  • Build and maintain CRM and operational reports and dashboards: membership records, case volume, renewals, and internal team dashboards
  • Maintain data quality across records through deduplication, standardization, and ongoing hygiene
  • Work through the support and enhancement backlog, prioritizing the highest-impact tickets first

Development

  • Write, test, and maintain Apex (triggers, classes, batch and scheduled jobs) where configuration alone is not enough
  • Build Lightning Web Components for custom interfaces
  • Build and configure member portal experiences on Experience Cloud within the product and UX direction set by the Director of Digital Experience
  • Support and maintain the platform's integrations over REST and SOAP APIs: Absorb LMS (SSO enrollment and completion sync), Stripe and Blackthorn payments, Marketing Cloud journey triggers, and Pendo
  • Write unit tests that meet Salesforce's 75% minimum, with higher coverage on business-critical logic
  • Run deployments and sandbox refreshes following the release schedule and environment strategy set by the Director of Digital Experience and the external implementation partner

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Own user acceptance testing and post-launch stabilization across a launch-heavy roadmap, including participating in UAT cycles, triaging defects, and resolving the post-launch backlog after each release
  • Translate defined business requirements into technical designs and build specifications, advising stakeholders on feasibility, effort, and tradeoffs
  • Collaborate day-to-day with the external implementation partner on assigned development and release items, with the partner relationship and scoping staying with the Director of Digital Experience
  • Document configuration, customizations, and decisions so the org stays maintainable
  • Track Salesforce releases and adopt relevant features and best practices

What You Will Bring:

  • 5+ years of full time hands-on Salesforce work experience across administration and development
  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder certification
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification
  • Strong command of the Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and organizational-wide defaults
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud
    • Declarative automation, especially Flow
    • Source control and deployment tooling: Salesforce DX, Git, and CI/CD
    • Coordinating work with external implementation or development partners
  • Working proficiency in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components
  • Familiarity with REST and SOAP API integrations
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong project management skills with a proven track record of proactively managing expectations and ensuring consistent follow through and delivery
  • Demonstrated commitment to and experience advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging in the workplace or community settings.
  • Curious and proactively scans the horizon to stay abreast of technology, creative approaches, and novel ideas to experiment, test, and apply
  • Ability to travel as needed to Yoga Alliance’s Arlington, VA office to participate in organizational meetings, trainings and retreats

Desired Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification
  • Experience with credentialing or certification systems: renewals, application flows, and the underlying data model. Ideally at a membership organization, nonprofit, or association
  • Experience with data deduplication and data quality tooling within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum delivery
  • Experience coordinating work with external implementation or development partners

We encourage individuals to apply even if they do not have any of the desired qualifications.

What We Offer:

Yoga Alliance provides robust employee benefits including comprehensive health insurance plan offerings that are 100% employer paid for employees and 65% paid for dependents, a matching 401K plan, a generous paid-leave program including parental leave and sabbatical leave, and reimbursement for professional development opportunities. Employees enjoy a casual dress code so they can arrive to work as their most authentic selves. Our organizational culture is supportive and collaborative with conscious attention to body and mind health.

Location:

This position is remote and will require the individual to be able to travel as needed. Yoga Alliance is based in Arlington, Virginia within sight of the historic northwest region of Washington, DC.

Salary Range:

$102,000 - $112,000 (commensurate with experience). This position is a full-time, exempt position.

Application and Timeline:

Interested applicants are encouraged to apply by November 16, 2026 to ensure priority consideration of your application. We will continue to review applications on a rolling basis after this priority deadline until the position is filled.

A cover letter is required and all cover letters will be read during the application review process.

Please, no phone calls or walk-ins.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace:

At Yoga Alliance, we value a diverse team and a culture of inclusivity and belonging. We encourage applications from all individuals without regard to an individuals' race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The David Eccles School of Business is seeking a collaborative, detail-oriented Salesforce Developer/Administrator to support Graduate Programs and Executive Education within the school's central Salesforce environment. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Team Lead and Lead Developer to deliver technical solutions, maintain and enhance existing functionality, and support the continued evolution of the school's Salesforce platform.

The successful candidate will build upon established Salesforce architecture, data models, integrations, and development patterns rather than develop solutions in isolation. Working under the direction of the Team Lead and Lead Developer, this individual will collaborate with technical colleagues and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions that align with existing standards and long-term platform goals.

Documentation, data analysis, and collaboration are essential to success in this role. The position requires someone who can understand complex business processes and data relationships, evaluate existing functionality, identify opportunities for improvement, and clearly document technical designs, system behavior, data flows, and implementation decisions. The individual should be comfortable working across configuration, Apex development, integrations, and reporting to address business needs while preserving the integrity and sustainability of the existing Salesforce environment.

Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu

The department may choose to hire at any of the below job levels and associated pay rates based on their business need and budget.

Responsibilities

Salesforce Development & Platform Maintenance

  • Collaborative Solution Development: Work under the direction of the Salesforce Team Lead and Lead Developer to design, develop, test, and implement Salesforce enhancements Collaborate throughout the development lifecycle to ensure solutions align with established architecture, coding standards, and business requirements
  • Enhance Existing Functionality: Extend and improve existing Salesforce objects, automation, Apex classes, Lightning Web Components (LWC), integrations, and user experiences. Evaluate current functionality and reuse established patterns wherever appropriate to maintain consistency and reduce unnecessary complexity
  • Technical Implementation: Apply sound development and configuration practices to deliver solutions appropriate to the requirements. Use Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flow, and other platform capabilities as appropriate, with an emphasis on maintainability, performance, security, and scalability
  • Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement: Investigate defects, analyze system behavior, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Support ongoing maintenance, technical debt reduction, and platform improvements in collaboration with the Lead Developer and Team Lead
  • Integrations & Data Processes: Support the development, maintenance, and troubleshooting of integrations and data pipelines between Salesforce and other university systems, including PeopleSoft, marketing platforms, and other enterprise applications

Technical Documentation & Collaboration

  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for Apex classes, LWCs, Flows, integrations, data models, system architecture, data transformations, and business processes. Documentation should enable other team members to understand, maintain, troubleshoot, and extend implemented solutions
  • Knowledge Sharing: Actively share technical knowledge, implementation decisions, and troubleshooting findings with the Salesforce team. Ensure that changes are documented and communicated so the broader team can effectively support the platform
  • Collaborative Development: Partner closely with the Lead Developer and Team Lead to review requirements, discuss technical approaches, participate in code reviews, and resolve implementation challenges. Incorporate feedback and follow established development, testing, and release practices
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Work with Graduate Programs, Executive Education, and other business stakeholders to understand requirements, investigate issues, and validate solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Technical Recommendations: Evaluate proposed solutions and communicate their implications for data integrity, maintainability, security, performance, and future development. Recommend alternatives when appropriate and work collaboratively to determine the best path forward

Data Analysis, Reporting & Platform Optimization

  • Data Analysis: Analyze Salesforce data, relationships, and business processes to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, validate assumptions, and support informed technical decisions. Demonstrate the ability to work with complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Data Quality & Integrity: Investigate data inconsistencies, support validation and reconciliation processes, and help maintain reliable data across Salesforce and connected systems
  • Reporting & Analytics: Develop, maintain, and optimize Salesforce reports and dashboards. Support data pipelines and integrations with Tableau to provide accurate, actionable insights into application funnels, enrollment trends, program outcomes, and corporate partnerships
  • Salesforce Org Migration & Enhancement: Contribute to the migration to a new Salesforce org by supporting data transitions, application enhancements, testing, and documentation. Ensure the new environment builds upon established architecture and aligns with the school's broader Salesforce strategy
  • Process Improvement: Analyze existing workflows and system functionality to identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, data quality, reporting, and the experience of Salesforce users

Governance, Security & Quality Assurance

  • Architecture & Standards: Follow the technical direction, architectural decisions, coding standards, security requirements, and data governance practices established by the Salesforce Team Lead and Lead Developer
  • Testing & Release Management: Develop and execute appropriate testing strategies, document results, support deployment activities, and verify that changes function as intended without disrupting existing processes
  • Security & Data Protection: Follow established access controls, sharing models, secure coding practices, and university data management requirements when developing and maintaining Salesforce functionality
  • Maintainability & Sustainability: Consider the long-term implications of technical decisions and prioritize solutions that are understandable, supportable, and consistent with the existing environment

Responsibilities listed are representative and not all-inclusive. Other duties may be assigned based on evolving departmental needs and priorities.

Minimum Qualifications

EQUIVALENCY STATEMENT: 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor's degree = 4 years of directly related work experience).

Department may hire employee at one of the following job levels:

IT Software Developer, II: Requires a bachelor's (or equivalency) + 4 years or a master's (or equivalency) + 2 years of directly related work experience.

IT Software Developer, III: Requires a bachelor's (or equivalency) + 6 years or a master's (or equivalency) + 4 years of directly related work experience.

Preferences

Minimum Qualifications

Job Summary

The David Eccles School of Business is seeking a collaborative, detail-oriented Salesforce Developer/Administrator to support Graduate Programs and Executive Education within the school's central Salesforce environment. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Team Lead and Lead Developer to deliver technical solutions, maintain and enhance existing functionality, and support the continued evolution of the school's Salesforce platform.

The successful candidate will build upon established Salesforce architecture, data models, integrations, and development patterns rather than develop solutions in isolation. Working under the direction of the Team Lead and Lead Developer, this individual will collaborate with technical colleagues and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions that align with existing standards and long-term platform goals.

Documentation, data analysis, and collaboration are essential to success in this role. The position requires someone who can understand complex business processes and data relationships, evaluate existing functionality, identify opportunities for improvement, and clearly document technical designs, system behavior, data flows, and implementation decisions. The individual should be comfortable working across configuration, Apex development, integrations, and reporting to address business needs while preserving the integrity and sustainability of the existing Salesforce environment.

Now Brewing – application developer lead, Salesforce Cloud Developer! #tobeapartner

From the beginning, Starbucks set out to be a different kind of company. One that not only celebrated coffee and the rich tradition, but that also brought a feeling of connection. We are known for developing extraordinary leaders who share this passion and are guided by their service to others.

In this role, you will get to work on the latest features of Salesforce including Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud and more! Team is rapidly expanding and operates with a Startup mindset driving major transformation for Channel Development, US Licensed Stores, and our Global Licensed Stores. If you are looking for an area ripe with opportunities and where you can stretch and grow your leadership potential, this is the role for you.

As a Salesforce developer, you will identify, design, and deploy technology and process solutions, establishing key business capabilities enabling the realization of strategic initiatives and operational improvements of Starbucks’ global Salesforce orgs spanning products such as Sales Cloud, B2B Commerce, Experience Cloud, and others. This role requires proficiency in requirement analysis, solution design coupled with the ability to collaborate effectively across various technical and business partners across the company to maximize the benefits of the Salesforce platform, with a focus on elevating the user experience. In addition to delivering well architected salesforce solutions, this role requires leadership through a strong customer service orientation and continuous improvement mindset to elevate partner (employee) and customer user experience. The ability to lead, influence, negotiate, driving alignment and coach/mentor less experienced developers and partner effectively with others is critical to success in this role. Models and acts in accordance with Starbucks guiding principles.

As An Application Developer Lead, You Will

Technical Design and Implementation

  • Support project initiation efforts by assisting in the definition of project scope, identification of the targeted solution. Assist project management in planning, estimating, scheduling, prioritization, and resource allocation exercises.
  • Participate in the solution design process: requirements gathering and backlog refinement, contributes to functional design, and leads technical design and development. Mitigates risk with prototypes and proof of concepts for complex problems as appropriate. Build incrementally, with an eye toward vision of the final product. Provide transparency in approach and progress, throughout the process.
  • Develop software solutions to business problems. Leverage established design patterns and coding standards. Build solutions that are secure, durable, scalable, flexible, and accessible and proactively mitigate against production support issues.
  • Utilize agile delivery methodologies and participate in scrum teams in the execution of solution delivery projects.
  • Create and maintain documentation supporting training, system administration, deployment, and operational processes and procedures.
  • Demonstrate system proficiency and leverage subject matter expertise to perform root cause analysis and assess issue trends.
  • Coordinate issue resolution with vendors and/or cross-functional teams. Provide timely and thorough communication regarding issue status/resolution with end-users and other key stakeholders.
  • Consider overall user technology experience in thoughtfully designing engaging solutions

Platform Stewardship

  • Proactively participate in helping shape candidate solutions on the platform. This consultative part of the role explores the business capability portfolio to guide and direct solution options to ensure health of the platform.
  • Play a creative role in the Platform Stewardship portfolio. Contribute to the vision, roadmap, and platform investments needed to take our business solutions to the next level. Identify, influence, sell, and prioritize innovative platform opportunities, as well as technical debt, with regular reviews, creating programs and solutions to raise the level of the platform offering or remediate systemic operational problems.
  • Partner with cross functional teams, such as Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, QA, and key Development teams, to strengthen and elevate the platform from a technology perspective. Successfully drive designs and solutions through enterprise processes and governance to ensure compliant, secure, and supportable solutions.
  • Deepen vendor relationships to understand and influence vendor product offerings and roadmaps, improves support engagement and gains insight into technology trends.
  • Contribute to the platform development community by providing input, content and feedback on design patterns, coding standards, and shared libraries.

Leadership

  • Provide project leadership; initiate, organize, and champion small to medium development efforts for a team of developers over a shared code base.
  • Supervise delivery of other developers on the team by setting priority and guiding deliverables.
  • Represent the Development Team when engaged with cross functional teams, including functional analysts, Project Management, Development, Architecture, Infrastructure, and the business customer.
  • Negotiate, facilitate, and influence others to gain alignment and mutually agreeable outcomes in complex and ambiguous situations. Socialize technical approach and design to project team and corresponding dependent teams.
  • Coach and mentor other application developers learning new skills and technologies.
  • Exhibit leadership courage with respectful, articulate positions to influence critical technology solutions.
  • Manage the initiative and delivers in a fast-paced support environment, driving all issues to resolution with a strong focus on customer satisfaction, stakeholder management, on-time delivery, and efficient task execution.

We’d Love To Hear From People With

  • 8+ years of relevant IT experience
  • 3+ years of experience with Salesforce B2B Commerce and Experience Cloud
  • 4+ years of experience and understanding of the Salesforce Platform & architecture, data models, commerce out of the box features and capabilities
  • 3+ years of experience in an Agile and DevOps environment
  • Experience implementing large scale eCommerce solutions with focus on Salesforce Commerce solutions
  • Experience in designing or building Salesforce Experience Cloud applications
  • Development experience in Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Experience integrating salesforce with different business systems as well as working with integration tools (ETL, NiFI, Mulesoft etc.)
  • Experience in Apex, Flow, HTML and Javascript, CSS, calling REST/SOAP web services; SOQL, relational databases and SOQL
  • Knowledge of declarative tools (process builder, flow) and best practices on when to use programmatic implementations over declarative solutions.
  • Best practices understanding of salesforce security model and security implementation at the org and user levels Hands-on experience with platform tools (data loader, visual source code, workbench)
  • Solid understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices and deployment methodologies
  • Teamwork is essential; a sense of humor preferred
  • Salesforce certifications are a plus

Technical Proficiency

  • Understanding of implications from design and implementation choices toward building secure, scalable, durable, flexible, accessible solutions.
  • Aptitude to pick up new technologies and trends, as they become relevant for the business and our platforms.
  • Ability to write and value high quality, reusable software with minimal defects.
  • Ability to learn and incorporate new technologies, concepts, and development languages.
  • Thorough understanding of data transport mechanisms and integrations including synchronous, asynchronous, bulk data, tightly and loosely coupled methods.
  • Working understanding of application architecture, infrastructure and security concepts and technical implementation.
  • Ability to analyze, diagnose and propose solutions to user problems.
  • Ability to understand and escalate technical challenges with options and recommendations.
  • Knowledge of business context and trends, as well as the business customers’ opportunities. Awareness of the functional aspects of the solution.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Ability to create and articulate ideas and solutions for both technical and business functions
  • Ability to use facts and data to influence peers and leads on solutions and designs
  • Ability to work with process owners and identify information technology solutions that enable business process improvements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to negotiate priorities, approach, designs and ideas with team members and customers
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Ability to use business knowledge, sound judgment, and resourcefulness to proactively
  • Ability to make timely and effective decisions using a mixture of intuition, analysis, experience, and judgment

As a Starbucks partner, you (and your family) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, and other voluntary insurance benefits. Partners have access to short-term and long-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation from date of hire*, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 hours worked), eight paid holidays, and two personal days per year. Starbucks also offers eligible partners participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, a discounted company stock program (S.I.P.), Starbucks equity program (Bean Stock), incentivized emergency savings, and financial well-being tools. Additionally, Starbucks offers 100% upfront tuition coverage for a first-time bachelor’s degree through Arizona State University’s online program via the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, student loan management resources, and access to other educational opportunities. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. Starbucks will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, and in accordance with its plans and policies. This list is subject to change depending on collective bargaining in locations where partners have a certified bargaining representative. For additional information regarding partner perks and more detailed information about benefits, go to starbucksbenefits.com.

  • If you are working in CA, CO, IL, LA, ME, MA, NE, ND or RI, you will accrue vacation up to a maximum of 120 hours (190 in CA) for roles below director and 200 hours (316 in CA) for roles at director or above. For roles in other states, you will be granted vacation time starting at 120 hours annually for roles below director and 200 hours annually for roles director and above.

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, and internal equity. At Starbucks, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

Join us and inspire with every cup. Apply today!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Job Description

As a Salesforce Platform Engineer, you are a technical expert that will independently identify, engineer, and optimize Salesforce technology solutions that address critical business needs. Continuously seeking to improve existing methods and processes. Read and adapt literature and publicly available information to accomplish assignments. Demonstrate proficiency in a broad range of techniques and methods for information technology engineering, including software development, data warehousing, statistics, machine learning, and/or technology. Technology Engineers will be aligned to a specific area: Information, Software, Data, or Infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand, design, implement, demonstrate, and deploy Salesforce Technology solutions using Point and click OOO features, Apex, Triggers, LWC, REST/SOAP integrations by studying Business needs, futuristic use cases, system data flows, work processes, investigating the production problems.
  • Analyze and resolve technical problems using analytical problem-solving techniques/methods.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively across matrixed teams, mentor Senior Salesforce Developers, lead remediation efforts, and navigate organizational protocols to align engineering resources.

Preferred Qualifications

  • The Salesforce Platform Developer II certification or at least two Salesforce Architect certifications (e.g., Platform Integration Architect, Platform Data Architect, Platform Sharing and Visibility Architect).
  • (Preferred) Experience working in a Salesforce Public Sector Solutions (PSS)/Agentforce Public Sector org is highly desirable.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

By applying through this job posting, you will be assessed specifically for Global Public Sector (Government, Nonprofit and/or Education) teams.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You have 3+ years (6-10 years for Senior levels) of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Proven experience managing and delivering customer-facing projects within Public Sector, Higher Education, or Nonprofit environments
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end data migrations across multiple Salesforce orgs and legacy systems.
  • Design and optimize data models, field mappings, deduplication rules, and validation logic.
  • Build custom ETL scripts using Apex, API calls, external ETL tools, or MuleSoft DataWeave. Experience with Salesforce Data Loader (CLI and GUI).
  • Experience with historical data archiving strategies, Incremental and delta load processing and Data validation and reconciliation.
  • Work with stakeholders to define transformation rules, cleansing logic, and test plans.
  • Manage bulk API operations, parallel processing, and handling of governor limits.
  • Create reusable frameworks: staging tables, delta load logic, and error retries.
  • Collaborate with QA to validate migration accuracy and volume tests.
  • Tune performance for large-scale, multi-million record loads.
  • Document all migration artifacts and technical designs.
  • Design, develop, and implement robust, scalable, and secure solutions on the Salesforce platform (primarily using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and Flows).
  • Build custom applications, objects, workflows, validation rules, process builder flows, and approval processes.

As a Principal Developer at the Office of Information Technology (OIT), you will play a pivotal role in bridging agency vision with technical delivery, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture and long-term business goals. Operating across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), this role combines robust technical leadership with hands-on execution—mentoring engineering teams, establishing scalable development standards, and leading active modernization efforts to reduce technical debt. You will design secure, maintainable applications, ensure seamless deployment and operational stability, and uphold state-wide architectural and security mandates while driving quality, compliance, and velocity across matrixed development teams.

A successful candidate in this role is a seasoned technical leader and strategic problem solver who excels at bridging high-level enterprise vision with hands-on software execution. They thrive in matrixed environments, balancing multiple high-priority initiatives while driving engineering excellence, enforcing strict security and accessibility (WCAG 2.1) standards, and elevating team capabilities.

Key Attributes For Success Include

  • Strategic & Compliant Architecture: Ability to partner effectively with Solution Architects to design scalable, cloud-first, and accessible application platforms aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Skilled at inspiring developers, fostering professional growth, and guiding matrixed teams through complex development challenges.
  • Execution & Modernization Focus: Strong track record of technical debt reduction, predictable release delivery, continuous workflow optimization, and high system availability.
  • Pragmatic Evaluation & Problem Solving: Talent for translating complex business needs into future-proof software designs while objectively evaluating third-party products and infrastructure requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Architectural Alignment & Enterprise Compliance: Partner with Solution Architects to ensure all delivered applications strictly align with OIT enterprise standards (Cloud-First, Secure Colorado, Mobile-First), resulting in fully compliant, scalable, and secure systems.
  • Predictable Delivery & Multi-Task Execution: Provide precise technical estimations and roadmaps in collaboration with Business Analysts and Project Managers, while balancing multiple concurrent high-priority initiatives across OIT divisions to ensure key milestones are delivered on time and within scope.
  • High-Quality Execution & Technical Debt Reduction: Deliver robust, maintainable software components using modern Agile/Waterfall practices; enforce secure coding, rigorous unit testing, and mandatory peer reviews to reduce vulnerabilities, post-release defects, and technical debt.
  • Release Excellence & Production Transition: Build, validate, and package complete release builds to achieve defect-free execution during User Acceptance Testing (UAT), seamless production transitions, and high overall system availability.
  • Governance & Standard Adherence: Execute all development activities in strict accordance with service portfolio policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure organizational consistency.
  • Future-Proof Application Architecture: Select optimal technical approaches to meet current customer requirements while ensuring application scalability for future enhancements.
  • Continuous Process Optimization: Modernize software engineering workflows, policies, and templates, leading to improved team productivity, delivery standards, and operational transparency through advanced development and testing tooling.
  • Matrix Collaboration & Resource Management: Collaborate effectively across matrixed OIT teams, managing staff work assignments within a matrix supervisory structure to maximize resource alignment and productivity.
  • Innovative Problem Solving & Translation: Transform complex business requirements into high-performing software solutions while implementing efficient technical approaches for complex development challenges.
  • Strategic Vision & Domain Thought Leadership: Articulate a clear technical vision and provide thought leadership across OIT agency portfolios, inspiring engineering teams and aligning domain expertise with long-term architecture goals.
  • Mentorship & Engineering Culture: Mentor junior and senior developers to foster professional growth, deepen technical knowledge, and elevate team performance standards.Infrastructure Readiness: Proactively specify and secure necessary infrastructure resources (servers, storage, networking) to ensure environment readiness for development and testing phases.
  • Commercial Product Evaluation & Selection: Assess third-party commercial products objectively to streamline business process flows and deliver data-driven recommendations to OIT leadership for optimal product purchasing and integration decisions.
  • Operational Accountability: Maintain accurate time tracking and progress reporting in enterprise tools to provide clear project visibility to supervisors and management.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions Of Employment & Appeal Rights

A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of professional experience in software engineering, application development, or a closely related IT occupational field.
  • Proven technical leadership experience guiding software development teams, architecting enterprise solutions, and designing scalable system components across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Experience applying digital accessibility regulations and standards (e.g., WCAG 2.1) to business processes, content, tools, and/or documents, with the ability to provide specific examples of accessibility improvements made.

Substitutions

  • Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.
  • Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Salesforce Certified Application Architect.
  • 8+ years of professional experience designing, architecting, and developing enterprise solutions on the Salesforce.com platform.
  • Proven track record of technical leadership in large-scale Salesforce enterprise integrations, system architecture, and governance.
  • Advanced expertise in Salesforce deployment strategies, CI/CD pipeline implementation, and DevOps best practices.
  • Multi-cloud architecture experience across Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and enterprise integrations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel) and Microsoft Visio or the Google equivalent of this tool suite.

Conditions Of Employment

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

Supplemental Information

If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado.

While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.
