descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

By applying through this job posting, you will be assessed specifically for Global Public Sector (Government, Nonprofit and/or Education) teams.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You have 3+ years (6-10 years for Senior levels) of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Proven experience managing and delivering customer-facing projects within Public Sector, Higher Education, or Nonprofit environments
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $88,970 - $287,910 annually There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. In California and New York, and select cities in the metropolitan areas of Boston, Chicago, Seattle, and Washington DC, the base pay range for this role in those locations is $97,860 - $316,750 per year. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

- You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

- Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

- Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

Job Requirements

The Lead Software Engineer develops information systems by designing, developing, and installing software solutions. Drives all aspects of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including producing specifications and determining operational feasibility. Responsible for technical assignments to other team members.

Primary Responsibilites

  • Provides planning, processing and able to perform all development roles for a given team.
  • Analyzes, designs, coordinates and supervises the development of Salesforce software systems.
  • Analyzes system specifications and translates system requirements to task specifications for junior software engineers
  • Provides analysis of current programs which includes performance, diagnosis and troubleshooting of problem programs, and designing solutions to problematic programming.
  • Searches, summarizes and keeps the team abreast of strategic information from all sources.
  • Provides feedback to analysis/training staff about performance considerations / usability issues concerning software specifications and implementation.
  • Researches and recommends software tools to management.
  • Develops, documents and maintains requirements, designs, algorithms, interfaces, and software, for Salesforce software systems, including Apex classes, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and declarative configuration.
  • Develops, maintains, and integrates this software into a fully functional software system, including integrations between Salesforce and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
  • Develops software verification plans, test procedures and test environments, executing the test procedures and documenting test results to ensure software system requirements are met in an agile environment, including testing within Salesforce sandboxes.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with scrum team members, business users, project managers and other engineers to achieve elegant solutions.
  • Provides recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Adheres to organization, department, and industry guidelines, standards, policies, and procedures
  • Promotes the company culture by approaching each day with a team-oriented and can do attitude
  • Updates job knowledge by studying state-of-the-art development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.
  • Improves operations by actively participating in systems analysis and driving recommendations for SDLC and agile process changes.
  • Mentors more junior team memberson Salesforce development best practices and platform architecture
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for an overall application area (the Salesforce plateform). Represents the team in cross-team technical meetings and meetings with users.
  • Leads Salesforce release management, deployment, and CI/CD processes across sandboxes and production orgs.
  • Evaluates and integrates Salesforce AppExchange and third-party vendor solutions; builds custom data integrations between Salesforce and other business systems.
  • Serves as the technical leader guiding a team of 3–5 Salesforce developers using the Scrum framework.

Requirements And Critical Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools (Flow, Process Builder).
  • Have 2-3 years of technical lead experience
  • Demonstrates creativity, individual initiative, excellent problem-solving skills, ingenuity, integrity, self-discipline, excellent oral and written communication skills, and customer sensitivity.
  • Ability to communicate and work effectively with others and utilizing persuasion and teamwork relationships. Great communicator.
  • Ability to plan, organize, implement, identify problems and resolutions, adjust, evaluate work performed by self and other team members in a complex and dynamic work environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills are expected, along with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to lead a team and actively coach others on Agile/Scrum processes and frameworks, not just participate in them.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for an overall application area. Take a leadership role representing the team and IT department in cross-team technical meetings and meetings with users.
  • Provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Desire/Experience working in a fast-paced agile environment, working with agile tools, e.g. Jira
  • Experience with TDD/unit test/code coverage paradigm
  • Expert in the Scrum framework and related ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, retrospectives).

Required – Salesforce Platform Experience

  • Very experienced in Salesforce Sales Cloud, with deep proficiency in Apex, Web Services and Microservices(required)
  • Experience developing custom applications within Salesforce.com (e.g., Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce) (required)
  • Experienced integrating with Salesforce vendors and building custom data integrations between multiple systems (required)
  • Salesforce Developer certification (required); Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Technical Architect certification preferred
  • Experience with CI/CD, source control, and deployment processes (required)
  • Experience or a strong desire to learn, working in an AI-augmented development environment, using AI tools for development and solutioning (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, or other AI-assisted coding tools)
  • Experience with Salesforce DX, sandbox management, and multi-org release processes.
  • Familiarity with additional Salesforce clouds (Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) and tools (Flow, CPQ) a plus.

Rippling is a workforce management system that eliminates the friction from running a business. Today, most companies struggle with everything from routine tasks, like running payroll, to cross-functional planning, like aligning on headcount. If you’re the kind of person who believes that honoring and empowering our nation’s veterans is more than just a cause — that it’s a calling — then we’re ready to meet you.

At WWP™, we recognize our mission cannot be accomplished without our talented teammates, which is why we’re proud to offer benefits such as:

  • A flexible hybrid work schedule (three days in the office, two days’ work from home)

A mission that matters is just the beginning, so if you’re ready to get started, we’re ready for you.

The Wounded Warrior Project (WWP) Salesforce AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, implementing, and optimizing artificial intelligence solutions within the Salesforce ecosystem. This role leverages Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, and generative AI capabilities to improve engagement, service operations, business processes, and teammate productivity. The Salesforce AI Engineer partners with business stakeholders, Salesforce administrators, developers, data teams, and organizational leaders to identify AI opportunities, deliver scalable and secure solutions, and promote responsible AI governance, adoption, and innovation across the organization.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce AI capabilities across Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, and other Salesforce platform technologies to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, teammate productivity, and business outcomes.
  • Design, build, implement, and maintain AI solutions using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, Flow, Apex, and related Salesforce technologies.
  • Configure and support Agentforce agents, conversational AI experiences, and intelligent automation solutions that enhance customer and teammate interactions.
  • Develop and optimize prompt templates, AI workflows, and generative AI solutions in alignment with organizational governance and security standards.
  • Configure and maintain Data Cloud capabilities, including data models, customer profiles, identity resolution, and governance controls that support AI-driven outcomes.
  • Integrate Salesforce AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and third-party technologies.
  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce AI and generative AI technologies, conduct proof-of-concept activities, and recommend innovative solutions that support business objectives.
  • Establish and support AI governance, security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
  • Lead solution design discussions and provide technical expertise on Salesforce AI architecture, implementation approaches, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AI solutions, automations, integrations, data quality, and platform performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, implementation standards, operational procedures, and training materials.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, Salesforce administrators, developers, data teams, security teams, and leadership to deliver scalable, secure, and effective AI solutions.
  • Monitor AI solution performance, user adoption, and business outcomes, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization.
  • Attend and actively participate in required training and/or meetings, including but not limited to New Teammate Orientation, WWP Cares, ASIST Suicide Prevention training, Leadership training, culture/team based training, or departmental huddles.
  • Other related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce platform architecture, AI capabilities, automation tools, reporting solutions, integrations, and data management concepts.
  • Strong understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts, including generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, predictive analytics, and natural language processing.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable AI-enabled Salesforce solutions that improve operational efficiency, customer experiences, and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to design, configure, integrate, and support Salesforce-based solutions.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of Salesforce development, automation, APIs, and integration technologies.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI practices.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and DevOps concepts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and identify effective solutions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Unequivocal commitment to the highest standards of personal and business ethics and conduct.
  • Mission-driven, guided by core values, and a pleasure to work with.

EXPERIENCE

Requirements

  • Four years of experience designing, configuring, developing, or supporting solutions within the Salesforce platform.
  • Two years of experience working with artificial intelligence, machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI, or related technologies.
  • Two years of experience building AI-enabled, agent-based, automated, or multi-step workflows and translating business requirements into technical solutions.

Preferences

  • Experience implementing enterprise AI solutions within Salesforce, including Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or other customer engagement environments.
  • Experience working with Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, AWS AI services, or similar generative AI platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and applying AI governance, responsible AI, privacy, and data management practices.

EDUCATION

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or related field.

Preferences

  • None.

CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSURE

Requirements

  • Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist.
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator.

Preferences

  • Relevant Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I, or similar credentials.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • General office environment; temperature controlled.
  • Sitting for extended periods.
  • Up to 5% travel.

descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Salesforce Developer at Anthropic, you will design, build, and maintain the Salesforce platform that powers our core customer motions and quote-to-cash business.: This includes automation throughout the Salesforce platform ranging from core sales automation to product catalog and pricing, quoting and approvals, order and contract management, and the handoff to billing and provisioning. You'll work both autonomously and collaboratively across RevOps, Order Management, Legal, Billing Engineering, Deal Desk, Finance and Accounting, and Product to translate pricing and packaging requirements into scalable Apex, Flow, and integration solutions, and to extend our capabilities with custom code where necessary. We are an AI-first systems team, and you'll be expected to use Claude and our in-house AI development tooling as a core part of how you write, review, and ship code, always against our house standards for flexibility, maintainability, and scale.

Where you might sit

We're hiring across more than one team. Placement depends on your background and where you can have the most impact.

GTM Systems: Builds and runs the Salesforce platform and connected tools that Anthropic's sellers, sales leaders, and revenue operations teams rely on every day. You'd build the automation behind how deals move through the pipeline, how leads and accounts reach the right owner, and how information flows between our sales tools and the rest of the business. You'll work directly with the analysts and operators who define the process, and see the impact on the people who use what you ship.

QTC Experiences: A vertically integrated team that spans quoting through to provisioning agreements, as well as customer billing experiences over the term of their agreement. You'd build the foundational systems for CPQ, order management, provisioning and billing experiences, envisioning how we make our sellers and ops teams orders of magnitude more efficient with Claude. You'll work cross-functionally with GTM, finance, accounting and other stakeholders. Your work will directly impact seller velocity and our GTM deal making capacity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Apex (triggers, services, selectors, batch/queueable), Lightning Web Components, and Flow automation following our house Apex standards and trigger framework
  • Design and build quote-to-cash infrastructure in Salesforce, including the product catalog and pricing data model, quote and order lifecycle, discount and approval automation, and amendment, renewal, and co-termination flows
  • Extend CPQ and expand into agentic selling with custom pricing and quote-calculation logic, quote and order user experiences, and code built against the package's APIs and data model
  • Build and own integrations between Salesforce and our billing, provisioning, and finance systems, such as Stripe, Metronome, and NetSuite, directly or via middleware
  • Support new product and pricing launches by modeling catalog, SKU, and pricing changes so they can be released quickly and reflected consistently in every downstream system
  • Use Claude and our internal AI development tooling as a first-class part of your build and code-review workflow
  • Partner with Business Systems analysts and Finance to ensure data-model decisions support downstream bookings, forecasting, and revenue reporting
  • Partner with DevOps on release management for your work: sandbox strategy, source control, peer review, and deployment via SFDX/metadata tooling
  • Ensure appropriate controls, test coverage, and documentation are in place for an effective control environment, particularly around pricing, discounting, and contract changes
  • Operate with ambiguity in a rapidly changing business, resolve problems independently, and propose solutions that scale

Minimum Qualifications

  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, SOQL, LWC, Flow) in a production org
  • Experience building or extending CPQ and quote-to-cash functionality in Salesforce (Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, Nue, or similar): product and pricing data models, quote and order lifecycle, approval automation, and amendments and renewals, including custom code written against the CPQ package rather than configuration alone
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with billing, ERP, or provisioning systems via REST/Bulk APIs, middleware (Workato, Mulesoft, or similar), or direct callouts
  • Fluency with SFDX, source-controlled metadata, and a sandbox-to-prod release process with peer review

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Department

This position is within FSU’s Department of Information Technology Services (ITS)

Information Technology Services is the central IT organization for Florida State University, providing IT support and technology leadership to a varied community. ITS is dedicated to delivering an effective, comprehensive and secure technology infrastructure. Within ITS, the Digital Experience and Transformation team delivers custom applications, CRM solutions, web hosting, and a range of community platforms for FSU. The DX DevOps team provides Salesforce application development and support.

Responsibilities

This position is responsible for performing highly specialized work by utilizing consulting, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills to address problems and issues within programming and software. Provides configuration, development, and system administration on customer relationship management and digital engagement technologies.

Responsible for performing highly specialized Information Technology work on the Salesforce platform.

Configures and develops on the Salesforce platform using the suite of Salesforce products including Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Self-Service. Creates custom applications and processes within the CRM, integrates third-party tools and platforms, troubleshoots and solves technical issues. Monitors scheduled and bulk data load jobs and leads the effort to resolve any issues. Works with the integration team to get access and set up the Salesforce environment to receive the required data. Participates in efforts to develop and execute testing, training, and documentation. Provides technical assistance and end-user troubleshooting for bug fixes, enhancements, and "how-to" assistance. Develops with a goal of maintainability in mind. Pro-actively engages in continuous improvement efforts for application design, support, and practice development efforts.

Configures, develops, and maintains FSU's Salesforce Communities and the overall user interface. Customizes visual layouts to provide users with the most relevant experience possible using an array of technologies including Aura components, Lightning Component Framework, Visualforce, Apex, triggers, MVC architecture; may draw from other technologies including CSS, JavaScript, or jQuery.

Contributes to the successful release of all new and changed work items through the development environment. Supports the platform technical lead in scheduling, coordinating, and managing releases across the Salesforce platform. Creates changesets or packages for releases with tools such as XML, Salesforce SFDX tools, VS code, and Ant.

Works with the business analysis section and project management teams to understand and deliver on project plans and provide technical analysis of proposed solutions. Collaborates with colleagues from other functional and technical teams at the University. Analyses usage trends and develops pertinent standards and guidelines. Performs duties in compliance with ITS policies, guidelines, and processes pertaining to support requests, work orders, project management, change management, and incident management. Appropriately utilizes associated tools in accordance with ITS standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, or other appropriate degree and four years' experience or Master's degree and two years of work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator

Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder

University Information

One of the nation's elite research universities, Florida State University preserves, expands, and disseminates knowledge in the sciences, technology, arts, humanities, and professions, while embracing a philosophy of learning strongly rooted in the traditions of the liberal arts and critical thinking. Founded in 1851, Florida State University is the oldest continuous site of higher education in Florida. FSU is a community steeped in tradition that fosters research and encourages creativity. At FSU, there’s the excitement of being part of a vibrant academic and professional community, surrounded by people whose ideas are shaping tomorrow’s news!

Learn more about Florida State University and our campuses.

FSU Total Rewards

FSU offers a robust Total Rewards package. Visit our FSU Total Rewards website to learn more about our Compensation, Benefits, Wellness, Recognition, and Employee Development programs.

Use our FSU Total Compensation Calculator to calculate Total Compensation options based on potential salary, benefits and retirement contributions, earned leave, and other employment-related perks.

How To Apply

If qualified and interested in a specific job opening as advertised, apply through the FSU Careers site (jobs.fsu.edu). If you are a current FSU employee, apply through myFSU Self Service.

Applicants are required to complete the online application with all applicable information. Applications must include all work history up to ten years, and education details even if attaching a resume.

Considerations

This is an A&P position.

This position requires successful completion of a criminal history background check.

Equal Employment Opportunity

FSU is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Title

Junior Salesforce Developer

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 

At KBR, we define the future.

We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, and dreamers.

But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.

Our KBR team is actively hiring a Junior Salesforce Developer to support the implementation, administration, development, and continuous improvement of a new Salesforce environment. This role will support KBR’s internal Growth Operations Excellence organization and will help build scalable Salesforce capabilities that improve customer relationship management, opportunity management, pipeline visibility, business reporting, user adoption, and enterprise growth execution.

The Junior Salesforce Developer will work closely with Growth Operations Excellence, business stakeholders, Salesforce users, IT partners, and technical leads to translate business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions. This position is ideal for a hands-on Salesforce professional who is comfortable supporting both declarative configuration and entry-level development activities in a fast-paced business environment.

No travel is anticipated for this role, though virtual meetings, training sessions, release support, and user adoption activities may be required across U.S. time zones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, administration, and continuous improvement of a new Salesforce environment.
  • Configure and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, record types, Lightning pages, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, permission sets, and user access controls.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce automation using declarative tools such as Flow, with support for Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other programmatic solutions when needed.
  • Assist with Salesforce data migration, data cleanup, deduplication, validation, and ongoing data quality efforts.
  • Support Salesforce reporting and dashboard development to improve visibility into customer, lead, opportunity, pipeline, forecasting, resource planning, and growth execution data.
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce user issues, investigate system defects, document root causes, and coordinate resolution with business or technical stakeholders.
  • Support integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems, including API-based integrations, middleware, reporting tools, and data platforms.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration notes, user guidance, test scripts, deployment notes, and standard operating procedures.
  • Assist with sandbox management, change tracking, deployment preparation, release validation, and production support activities.
  • Follow Salesforce development, security, testing, data governance, and release management best practices.
  • Help ensure Salesforce remains scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Salesforce workflows, governance standards, data standards, and user experience.
  • Work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance from senior team members when appropriate.

Work Environment

  • Location: Remote
  • Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%
  • Working Hours: Standard

Required Qualifications

  • Security clearance requirement: Eligibility to obtain a US Security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience supporting Salesforce administration, Salesforce development, business applications, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration, including standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, profiles, permission sets, and user administration.
  • Experience building or supporting Salesforce automation using Flow, approval processes, or comparable workflow tools.
  • Foundational experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SOQL, or related Salesforce development technologies.
  • Basic understanding of Salesforce data model concepts, security model concepts, role hierarchy, sharing settings, permissions, and data quality practices.
  • Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating requirements into configuration, automation, documentation, or technical tasks.
  • Experience troubleshooting application issues, validating defects, testing fixes, and supporting end users.
  • Ability to create clear documentation, including technical notes, user guidance, test cases, and process instructions.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Experience implementing or administering Salesforce Sales Cloud.
  • Experience supporting a new Salesforce org implementation, migration, or major CRM transformation.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, change sets, Salesforce DX, Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Gearset, Copado, or similar deployment tools.
  • Experience building Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience developing Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, scheduled jobs, or test classes.
  • Experience with REST or SOAP API integrations.
  • Experience with Informatica, Appian, integration middleware, enterprise data platforms, or integration patterns.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, CRM Analytics, or other reporting and dashboarding tools.
  • Experience with data migration tools such as Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, Workbench, or comparable ETL tools.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce dashboards, pipeline reporting, forecasting processes, or business development workflows.
  • Experience working in a government contracting, aerospace, defense, professional services, or highly regulated business environment.
  • Experience with Agile delivery practices, user stories, sprint planning, backlog management, and release coordination.
  • Experience documenting business processes, technical designs, data dictionaries, or system administration procedures.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce security, data governance, access management, and least-privilege access principles.
  • Strong curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to grow into broader Salesforce development and administration responsibilities.

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 hours/week

Basic Compensation

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.

Additional Compensation

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.

KBR Benefits

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Job Summary

Delivers high-quality technical solutions and platform capabilities that enable product delivery teams to build, integrate, and operate solutions on the Salesforce platform. Works as a member of the Salesforce Core Platform Engineering team with responsibility for platform governance, security, DevOps, enablement, monitoring, integration services, and reusable platform components.

This role focuses on evolving the Salesforce platform ecosystem. The engineer develops and supports platform capabilities, integration services, security controls, monitoring solutions, and reusable packages that improve scalability, reliability, and developer productivity across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain reusable Salesforce platform capabilities, packages, services, and automation that support multiple product teams.
  • Support Salesforce platform governance including security controls, access management, compliance requirements, architecture standards, and platform best practices.
  • Design, build, and maintain Salesforce integration capabilities using Salesforce APIs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.
  • Build and support API enablement solutions including exposing Salesforce functionality through custom services deployed on AWS ECS and proxied through API management platforms such as Apigee.
  • Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines, source control strategies, deployment automation, release processes, and environment management practices for Salesforce and related platform services.
  • Implement platform monitoring, telemetry, alerting, observability, and operational dashboards to ensure platform reliability and performance.
  • Develop reusable Apex components, packages, automation, and platform extensions that enable internal engineering teams to deliver solutions efficiently.
  • Partner with solution teams to provide platform guidance, integration support, architectural reviews, and technical enablement.
  • Participate in platform architecture discussions and contribute to platform roadmaps, standards, and technology evaluations.
  • Perform root cause analysis, resolve platform defects, manage technical debt, and continuously improve platform stability and maintainability.
  • Contribute to automated testing frameworks and quality engineering practices that support platform reliability and release confidence.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate across architecture, product, operations, security, and engineering teams.

Mandatory Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting and engineering solutions on the Salesforce Platform with emphasis on governance, security, platform operations, DevOps, integration, and enablement.
  • 2–5 years of software engineering experience developing and supporting enterprise applications in Agile environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Platform technologies including Apex, Lightning Platform, Salesforce APIs, Packaging and deployment frameworks, Platform security and access controls, Salesforce monitoring and operational tooling
  • Experience developing reusable platform services, shared components, managed/unmanaged packages, or enablement capabilities supporting multiple delivery teams.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows for Salesforce and cloud-native applications.
  • Hands-on experience with modern programming languages including Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, or Groovy.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying cloud-native applications on AWS or GCP.
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized workloads using ECS, Kubernetes, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
  • 2+ years of experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integration services.
  • 2+ years of experience with event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, and Kafka.
  • Experience with API management platforms such as Apigee or equivalent platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, telemetry, observability, and operational support practices for enterprise platforms.

COMPETENCIES

  • Understands platform engineering principles and applies best practices for scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Applies software development standards including code reviews, static analysis, secure coding practices, and automated testing.
  • Proficient with Git-based source control, branching strategies, release management, and deployment automation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform security, governance, access controls, and operational best practices.
  • Experienced in DevOps practices including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containerization, configuration management, observability, and monitoring.
  • Effectively troubleshoots complex platform and integration issues using logs, telemetry, and monitoring data.
  • Works collaboratively with architects, developers, product teams, and operational stakeholders to enable platform adoption and success.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly to both engineering and business audiences.
  • Continuously identifies opportunities to improve platform capabilities, developer experience, operational excellence, and team effectiveness.
  • Salesforce Administrator or related Salesforce certifications are preferred.

Join Starr, a global leader in commercial insurance with over a century of expertise. We empower our employees to innovate, make impactful decisions, and build lasting client relationships worldwide. At Starr, you'll work in an entrepreneurial culture alongside accessible leaders, leveraging our financial strength and vast industry experience to deliver solutions for our clients, no matter how complex. Grow your career with a rapidly growing company that invests in its people and their ability to drive real progress.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and technically sophisticated Salesforce Lead Developer to help drive our multi-phased Salesforce transformation. Partnering closely with technical leadership and business stakeholders, this developer will design integrated solutions, implement MDM (Master Data Management) strategies, enhance data governance, and execute client unification initiatives across our CRM landscape. Insurance industry experience is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, configure, customize, and deploy Salesforce CRM solutions to support insurance business processes, including submission creation, triage, clearance, and lead tracking.

  • Develop and maintain client unification solutions (deduplication, client identity and hierarchy management, customer MDM) utilizing Salesforce and enterprise data governance platforms.
  • Integrate MDM and data governance technologies and processes into Salesforce and connected enterprise systems, supporting data quality, ownership, lineage, and stewardship.
  • Mentor junior Salesforce developers and support collaborative development across a technical team (including developers, solution architects, QA engineers, and integration specialists).
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and IT partners to analyze requirements and deliver scalable technical solutions.
  • Participate in the design and implementation of complex integrations between Salesforce and insurance core systems, including Policy Administration, rating, claims management, broker portals, and third-party solutions.
  • Ensure the ongoing performance, security, data integrity, and compliance of the CRM platform.
  • Advocate for best practices in Salesforce configuration, custom development (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce), data modeling, and integration.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational/implementation guides.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for technical troubleshooting, issue resolution, and support processes.
  • Stay up-to-date with Salesforce advancements, MDM and data governance trends, and insurance industry developments to propose and implement technical improvements.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • 7+ years of progressive, hands-on experience designing, developing, and delivering large scale, enterprise Salesforce solutions (Sales/Service Cloud, Lightning Experience).
  • Experience providing technical mentorship and informal leadership to development teams, preferably within insurance or financial services sectors.
  • Proven expertise designing and implementing MDM, data governance frameworks, and client unification (e.g., de-duplication, client identity management, and master data stewardship within Salesforce or integrated environments).
  • In-depth understanding of insurance business processes (submission, lead management, policy administration) and integration with core insurance systems.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce development tools and technologies (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, REST/SOAP APIs), and large-scale data integrations.
  • Certified Salesforce Platform Developer II (Architect certifications a plus).
  • Experience with industry-standard data governance/MDM tools (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Collibra) is a strong plus.
  • Excellent technical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Solid experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern software development best practices.

Starr is an equal opportunity employer, which means we'll consider all suitably qualified applicants regardless of gender identity or expression, ethnic origin, nationality, religion or beliefs, age, sexual orientation, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We recruit and develop our people based on merit and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We offer first class training and development opportunities to all employees. Our aim is to grow our own talent and bring out the best in people.

descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

By applying through this job posting, you will be assessed specifically for Global Public Sector (Government, Nonprofit and/or Education) teams.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

descriptionHtml:
About the team


Our GTM Systems team sits at the center of Klaviyo's go-to-market engine, powering the operational infrastructure that connects marketing, sales, partnerships, and customer success. We build and own the systems that enable our teams to move quickly, trust their data, and focus on what matters most: helping our customers grow.


Our GTM Systems Partner team is a small group of technical builders owning the Salesforce platform and its integrations across our full GTM stack — from lead routing and lifecycle management to the external-facing partner portal and its integrations with partner management and payment systems data.


Klaviyo's operational infrastructure, built and managed by our GTM Systems team, powers our GTM engine. We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to keep those systems reliable, extensible, and ahead of the business so the teams that depend on them can focus on what they do best.


About the role


As a Senior Systems Engineer on the GTM Systems Partner team, you will own the enterprise systems end-to-end — from understanding the business process, to engineering the right solution, to measuring whether it moved the needle. You will own delivery, platform health, and code quality across a GTM stack — including the external-facing partner portal by sizing and building features, maintaining platform health, and shipping reliable integrations across our GTM stack. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role for someone who wants to write great code, drive quality standards, and see their work translate directly to Klaviyo’s goals.


How you'll make an impact


  • Own delivery of Salesforce solutions — Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and integrations — from sprint planning through deployment, applying engineering best practices (DRY, SOLID, KISS) and holding a high bar for code quality through GitHub-based pull request reviews.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM stack, including the external-facing partner portal; ensure reliable, secure data flows across partner management and payments while prioritizing strict access and permission governance.
  • Triage and resolve high-impact platform and data issues quickly, owning the technical fix and communicating status clearly to the Product Owner and business partners.
  • Use AI tools as part of your daily engineering workflow to ship faster, explore unfamiliar systems, and automate repetitive work — and help teammates build the same habits.
  • Partner with the Product Owner and Architect during story refinement to size work accurately, surface technical constraints early, and ensure stories are fully ready before sprint planning.
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, engineering standards, and pairing — accelerating the team's shift to professional-grade, git-based development practices.


Massachusetts Applicants:


It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Our salary range reflects the cost of labor across various U.S. geographic markets. The range displayed below reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all our US locations. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.


In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.


Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your preferred location during the hiring process.


Base Pay Range For US Locations:


$116,000—$174,000 USD


This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.


Get to Know Klaviyo


We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.

AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.

By participating in Klaviyo’s interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.


Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with strong expertise in OmniStudio, Omni-Channel, Salesforce development, integrations, AI, and CI/CD.

Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Demonstrated experience across the full Salesforce development lifecycle: requirements gathering, technical analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

Experience delivering large-scale, end-to-end Salesforce implementations.

Mandatory hands-on experience with Salesforce OmniStudio and Omni-Channel, including configuration, development, and implementation.

Strong experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

Hands-on experience with OmniStudio components, including OmniScript, DataRaptor, FlexCards, and Integration Procedures.

Experience with Omni-Channel routing, queues, skills-based routing, presence/status configuration, and agent workload management.

Good knowledge of Apex, OOP, Triggers, Visualforce, Lightning Experience, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce design patterns.

Experience with Salesforce configuration, security, automation, Knowledge, Experience Cloud, Reports, and Dashboards.

Strong experience designing and developing REST API integrations using MuleSoft, Kafka, or other event-driven integration platforms.

Experience with Salesforce Agentforce and/or AI technologies, including AI-powered agents, generative AI, prompt engineering, AI automation, or integration of AI services with Salesforce.

Understanding of responsible AI practices, AI security, data grounding, and Salesforce AI capabilities is a plus.

Experience designing scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.

Experience establishing CI/CD and Salesforce deployment pipelines using Git, Copado, or similar tools.

Proficiency with Jira, Git, VS Code, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Strong experience with Salesforce testing, debugging, performance optimization, governor limits, bulkification, and asynchronous Apex.
